3	Back [Claude Code](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/overview) with the models
4	served by a **GitHub Copilot subscription** (Claude when entitled; otherwise a
5	role-aware OpenAI fallback), via a local
6	reverse-engineered proxy — the maintained fork
7	[`caozhiyuan/copilot-api`](https://github.com/caozhiyuan/copilot-api)
8	(npm `@jeffreycao/copilot-api`). The original
9	[`ericc-ch/copilot-api`](https://github.com/ericc-ch/copilot-api) is
10	officially unmaintained ([issue #233](https://github.com/ericc-ch/copilot-api/issues/233)
11	points at the fork) but still works via `COPILOT_API_PKG=copilot-api@0.7.0`.
12	Both packages share the same token file
13	(`~/.local/share/copilot-api/github_token`), so switching needs **no re-auth**.
14	
15	- **Shell helpers**: `~/.config/shell/43_copilot_proxy.sh` (`copilot-proxy`,
16	  `claude-copilot`, `codex-copilot`, `copilot-run`, `copilot-here`,
17	  `copilot-model`)
18	- **Runner**: `@jeffreycao/copilot-api` (pinned), installed **once** into
19	  `~/.local/share/copilot-api/pkg` and executed directly from there. Deliberately
20	  **not** `bunx` at launch: bunx re-resolves the package on every start, and bun
21	  stalls forever resolving through a socks `ALL_PROXY` — see
22	  [Gotchas](#start-used-to-hang-at-resolving-dependencies-behind-a-socks-proxy).
23	  A warm start does zero network before it binds the port.
24	- **Not installed by ansible** — installed on first `copilot-proxy start`, so it
25	  stays off the provisioning path. Force a clean re-install with
26	  `copilot-proxy reinstall` (a version bump re-installs on its own).
27	
28	!!! warning "This violates GitHub Copilot's Terms of Service"
29	    Using a Copilot subscription to power a non-GitHub agent is not permitted, and
30	    copilot-api is reverse-engineered/unofficial. It can trigger GitHub's
31	    **abuse detection** and lead to **temporary suspension of Copilot access**.
32	    Claude Code is token-hungry (frequent background calls, large context) —
33	    note the fork has **no rate limiter** (see Gotchas); `COPILOT_PROXY_QUIET=1`
34	    reduces background chatter. Use at your own risk; prefer a personal account
35	    over a corporate seat.
36	
37	## Quick start
38	
39	```sh
40	copilot-proxy auth      # one-time: GitHub device login (stores a ghu_ token)
41	copilot-proxy start
42	copilot-model --auto    # Claude if served; otherwise Sol/Terra/Luna by role
43	
44	claude-copilot          # one-off session on the proxy (auto-starts it; no file writes)
45	claude-copilot-once     # pin THIS project, run one session, then auto-unpin (proxy must be up)
46	codex-copilot           # one-off Codex session; auto-picks OpenAI first
47	codex-copilot-once      # exact alias; neither name writes Codex config
48	
49	copilot-here on         # OR: pin THIS project — plain `claude` uses the proxy
50	copilot-here off        # unpin — back to the real Anthropic backend
51	```
52	
53	## How it works
54	
55	```
56	Claude Code ──Anthropic /v1/messages──▶ copilot-api (localhost:4141)
57	                                          │ Claude: native Messages path
58	                                          │ GPT: Anthropic → Responses translation
59	                                          ▼
60	                                   api.githubcopilot.com  (your Copilot sub)
61	
62	Codex ──OpenAI /v1/responses──────────▶ the same localhost gateway
63	        (provider/model are one-invocation `-c` / `-m` overrides)
64	```
65	
66	- Claude Code speaks only the **Anthropic Messages API** (`/v1/messages`).
67	- The fork uses Copilot's native Anthropic path for Claude ids and translates
68	  Claude Code requests to the **Responses API** for GPT ids. Version `2.1.0`
69	  forwards Claude Code's `output_config.effort` to `reasoning.effort`, preserves
70	  reasoning state, and handles the GPT-5.6 request shape.
71	- The original (`copilot-api@0.7.0`) always translates through
72	  `/chat/completions` — thinking blocks are dropped and WebSearch doesn't work.
73	- Claude Code is pointed at the proxy via `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` — injected either
74	  as per-process env (`claude-copilot`) or via the gitignored
75	  `./.claude/settings.local.json` (`copilot-here on`). See "Settings-layer design".
76	
77	## Settings-layer design (which file gets the proxy config, and why)
78	
79	Claude Code merges settings low → high: `~/.claude/settings.json` (user) →
80	`./.claude/settings.json` (project, committed) → `./.claude/settings.local.json`
81	(local, gitignored) → CLI flags. The
82	[docs](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings) (and third-party writeups)
83	claim shell env vars beat every settings-file `env` block, but **empirically
84	(verified 2026-07) current Claude Code lets the `settings.local.json` `env`
85	block beat inherited shell env** — see Gotchas.
86	
87	Two of those layers are already owned by other tooling and must stay clean:
88	
89	| Layer | Owner | Why proxy config must NOT go here |
90	|---|---|---|
91	| `~/.claude/settings.json` | chezmoi (`dot_claude/modify_settings.json.tmpl`) | always-on for *every* project; fights the chezmoi merge |
92	| `./.claude/settings.json` | `claude-plans-here` (`plansDirectory`) | committed to git — proxy config would leak to the team |
93	
94	So the proxy uses the two layers nobody else owns:
95	
96	| Enable | Mechanism | Scope | Disable |
97	|---|---|---|---|
98	| `claude-copilot` / `copilot-run` | per-process env vars | one session | just run plain `claude` next time |
99	| `claude-copilot-once` | `./.claude/settings.local.json` pin, auto-reverted | one session | automatic — unpins on exit |
100	| `copilot-here on` | `./.claude/settings.local.json` (gitignored) | this project, sticky | `copilot-here off` |
101	
102	```
103	~/.claude/settings.json          .claude/settings.json         shell env                    .claude/settings.local.json
104	(chezmoi: hooks/plugins)    <    (git: plansDirectory)     <   (claude-copilot)         <   (copilot-here on/off)
105	```
106	
107	(Shell env still beats the user- and project-level settings files, so
108	`claude-copilot` works everywhere `copilot-here` is off — it just cannot
109	*override* an active `copilot-here` pin.)
110	
111	## Shell helpers
112	
113	### `copilot-proxy [start|stop|restart|status|doctor [--live]|logs [N]|whoami|auth]`
114	
115	Manages the background proxy on `$COPILOT_PROXY_PORT` (default `4141`).
116	
117	| Env var | Default | Meaning |
118	|---|---|---|
119	| `COPILOT_PROXY_PORT` | `4141` | port the proxy listens on |
120	| `COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY` | `auto` | How Node reaches GitHub `/models` at startup: `auto` attaches `--proxy-env` + `HTTPS_PROXY` when `proxy-status` detects Clash Verge / mihomo / CFW (or macOS System Proxy); `always` same but warns if none found; `never` skips (non-GFW hosts); or an explicit `http://127.0.0.1:PORT`. **Node ignores the macOS System Proxy** — TUN/Mixin used to hide this by capturing all TCP. |
121	| `COPILOT_API_PKG` | `@jeffreycao/copilot-api@2.1.0` | package spec to install (pin / upgrade; `copilot-api@0.7.0` = old original). Changing it re-installs. `2.1.0` is required for Claude Code effort passthrough to GPT-5.6. |
122	| `COPILOT_PROXY_RATE` | `15` | `--rate-limit` seconds — **original package only** (the fork has no rate limiter) |
123	| `COPILOT_PROXY_QUIET` | `0` | `1` = inject extra quota-saving Claude Code env (see below); off by default because it slightly degrades the UX |
124	| `COPILOT_INSTALL_NOPROXY` | `0` | `1` = install the package with the proxy env stripped, skipping the 45s stall on a host where bun cannot resolve through the proxy |
125	
126	Set these in `~/.shellrc.adhoc` (or the per-shell secrets files). `start` refuses
127	to run until `copilot-proxy auth` has stored a token, and waits up to ~20s for the
128	proxy to answer before returning. `start` detects the package flavor from
129	`COPILOT_API_PKG`: only the exact original `copilot-api` gets
130	`--rate-limit`/`--wait` (the fork's `start` doesn't have those flags).
131	
132	The **first** `start` installs the pinned package into
133	`~/.local/share/copilot-api/pkg` (stamped with the spec) and every later start
134	just execs the resulting binary — no registry round-trip, no per-launch resolve.
135	The install tries your ambient env first (needed where the registry is only
136	reachable *through* the proxy) and retries with the proxy stripped if that stalls;
137	either attempt is killed on a timeout, so a stalled install can never keep bun's
138	global cache lock and wedge the next one. If `start` times out it now also **kills
139	the server it spawned**, instead of leaving an orphan behind for every retry.
140	
141	`copilot-proxy whoami` is the real login check: it prints your plan / quota
142	(fails loudly if the token is missing or expired). On the fork it queries the
143	running proxy's `/usage` endpoint (jq-summarized) and falls back to the installed
144	binary's `debug` when the proxy is down; on the original it runs
145	`check-usage`. Use it instead of eyeballing the token file — the token is a
146	plaintext credential and should not be opened in an editor.
147	
148	### `copilot-proxy doctor [--live]` (alias: `test`)
149	
150	Diagnoses the whole path and exits non-zero on any failure. Read-only by default;
151	`--live` adds one real `POST /v1/messages` (`max_tokens: 1`, a non-`[1m]` chat
152	model) that costs one quota unit but is the only check that exercises streaming.
153	
154	Sections, in order: prerequisites (`bun`/`curl`/`jq`) → **package** → token file →
155	proxy and throttle-shim liveness → stale installer → **models** → upstream
156	reachability → local proxy/VPN → **Codex Apps** → live inference probe.
157	
158	The **package** check reports whether the pinned spec is installed in the prefix
159	and where its binary is. "Not installed" is a note, not a failure — the next
160	`start` installs it once.
161	
162	The **stale-installer** check is a safety net for the trap described in
163	[Gotchas](#start-used-to-hang-at-resolving-dependencies-behind-a-socks-proxy): any
164	live `bun add … copilot-api` at rest means an install has stalled (bun hangs
165	resolving through a socks proxy) and is holding bun's global cache lock. The
166	installer now bounds and kills its own attempts, so this should stay empty; if it
167	ever fires, doctor prints the clear-and-restart one-liner.
168	
169	The models section is the one that earns the command. It compares what the proxy
170	serves against what GitHub serves *right now*, which is the only way to separate
171	the two indistinguishable causes of a `400 model_not_supported`:
172	
173	| Proxy has claude? | Upstream has claude? | Verdict | Fix |
174	|---|---|---|---|
175	| no | **yes** | stale cache | `copilot-proxy restart` |
176	| no | no | org policy disables Anthropic | a restart will not help |
177	
178	It validates the main model **and** the Fable/Opus/Sonnet/Haiku aliases against
179	the served list, including `[1m]` aliases. A stale background-role id can make
180	workflows fail with 400 even while ordinary chat succeeds. No Claude entitlement
181	is a warning rather than a failure when the computed OpenAI profile is usable.
182	
183	Upstream reachability probes both `api.enterprise.githubcopilot.com` and
184	`api.githubcopilot.com`, directly *and* through the macOS system proxy when one is
185	set, so a Clash/mihomo rule that black-holes one host shows up immediately. An
186	unauthenticated `400`/`401` counts as reached — only a connect/read failure is a
187	fault. `doctor` never prints your token: it passes credentials to `curl` via
188	`-K -` (stdin), never argv, since argv is readable through `ps`.
189	
190	With `--live`, the Codex Apps section also probes
191	`https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/apps` directly and through the detected
192	HTTP proxy. This GET consumes no model inference quota; it separates a
193	`codex_apps` startup interruption from the localhost Copilot route. Any real
194	HTTP status (including an auth rejection) proves network reachability, while
195	timeouts and TLS certificate failures remain distinct. `codex_apps` is a
196	remote ChatGPT MCP, not an Apple-Silicon-only Codex Desktop bridge.
197	
198	### `claude-copilot [--no-specstory] [claude args...]` — one-off session
199	
200	Layer 1: run a single Claude Code session on the proxy with **zero file
201	writes**. Auto-starts the proxy if it isn't answering, then launches `claude`
202	with the `ANTHROPIC_*` env injected per-process (shell env beats the user- and
203	project-level settings files — but **not** an active `copilot-here` pin in
204	`settings.local.json`; see Gotchas).
205	
206	- Wraps in `specstory run claude` when specstory is installed (markdown
207	  auto-save — same convention as `scode`/`svibe`); opt out with
208	  `--no-specstory`. Extra args reach the claude CLI via specstory's
209	  `-c "custom command"` passthrough: `claude-copilot -c` → continue session.
210	- **The passthrough preserves your `claude_cmd`.** specstory's `-c` *replaces*
211	  the provider command rather than appending to it, so the args are appended to
212	  the effective `claude_cmd` from your specstory config (project
213	  `./.specstory/cli/config.toml` > user `~/.specstory/cli/config.toml` > bare
214	  `claude`). That is what keeps `claude_cmd = "claude --dangerously-skip-permissions"`
215	  in force for `claude-copilot --resume <id>` and not just for a bare
216	  `claude-copilot` — the two used to disagree, see
217	  [`pitfalls/specstory-custom-command-drops-configured-flags.md`](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dotfiles/blob/main/pitfalls/specstory-custom-command-drops-configured-flags.md).
218	  `--no-specstory` deliberately does *not* inherit it (opting out of specstory
219	  opts out of its config too).
220	- Revert = nothing to revert; plain `claude` next time is untouched.
221	
222	### `claude-copilot-once [--no-specstory] [claude args...]` — one-shot pinned session
223	
224	Layer 1's ephemerality with Layer 2's reliability: pin **this project** via
225	`copilot-here on`, run one `claude-copilot` session, then `copilot-here off` on
226	exit — even on Ctrl-C. Use it when pure env injection isn't enough because
227	`settings.local.json` outranks shell env (see Gotchas), but you don't want to
228	leave a sticky pin behind.
229	
230	- **Precondition:** the proxy must already be running — unlike `claude-copilot`
231	  this does **not** auto-start it; it prints a `copilot-proxy start` hint and
232	  returns non-zero if the proxy isn't answering.
233	- **Prior-pin safe:** if `copilot-here` is already `on` here, the existing pin is
234	  left in place on exit (nothing is unpinned that you didn't ask for). If that
235	  pin has gone **stale** — it differs from what `copilot-here on` would write
236	  now, e.g. an unavailable Claude id after the account moved to the OpenAI
237	  fallback, or a pin written before the Fable key was added — it prints the
238	  drift and asks whether to refresh it in place (`copilot-here on`) or keep it.
239	  The answer defaults to **keep** (and keeps automatically on a non-interactive
240	  stdin). Drift is computed by diffing the live file against the exact env block
241	  `copilot-here on` would merge (`_copilot_env_json`, the single source of truth
242	  for both), so it is precisely "the keys `on` would change" — no hand-picked
243	  subset that can silently fall behind. Keys present in the file but not in that
244	  block are *not* drift: `on` merges and never removes (only `off` removes).
245	  `copilot-here status` prints the same drift report.
246	- The session itself is just `claude-copilot "$@"`, so specstory auto-save,
247	  `--no-specstory`, and `-c` (continue) all work the same way.
248	- On exit it reminds you the proxy is still up and how to `copilot-proxy stop`.
249	
250	### `copilot-run <cmd...>` — generic env injector
251	
252	The building block under `claude-copilot`: auto-starts the proxy and runs *any*
253	command with the proxy env. Useful for other Anthropic-compatible tools or a
254	custom specstory invocation:
255	
256	```sh
257	copilot-run specstory run claude    # exactly what claude-copilot does
258	copilot-run claude --resume         # raw claude, no specstory
259	```
260	
261	### `codex-copilot [--no-specstory] [codex args...]` — one-off Codex session
262	
263	`codex-copilot` and `codex-copilot-once` are identical, zero-persistence
264	launchers. They start the gateway/shim when necessary and pass a custom
265	`copilot_api` Responses provider to Codex as CLI `-c` overrides. They never edit
266	`~/.codex/config.toml` or `.codex/config.toml`, so plain `codex` remains on its
267	normal provider.
268	
269	Codex always uses the shim on `localhost:4142`, even when the persisted
270	throttling toggle is off. Besides throttling, that boundary normalizes blank
271	descriptions in Codex `mcp_list_tools` Responses items. GitHub Copilot rejects
272	those with `Invalid 'input[0].tools[0].description': empty string`, while MCP
273	servers and the native Codex path may omit them. The shim fills only those tool
274	definition fields and leaves prompts, schemas, and tool names unchanged.
275	Codex currently zstd-compresses these requests; the shim decodes only the
276	Responses body it must repair, forwards ordinary JSON, and removes the stale
277	`content-encoding` header.
278	
279	This is a separate picker from Claude Code's `copilot-model --auto`: that path
280	remains Claude-first, while only this Codex launcher is OpenAI-first.
281	
282	- If the caller supplies `-m` / `--model`, that value wins. Otherwise the live
283	  raw gateway catalog is ranked as OpenAI/Codex first (`Sol > Terra > GPT-5.5 >
284	  GPT-5.4 > GPT-5.3 Codex > Luna > mini`), then Claude, Gemini, and any remaining
285	  chat model. Embedding and disabled models are excluded.
286	- The launcher supplies the selected model's live context and prompt limits and
287	  pins `model_catalog_json` to a versioned cache of `codex debug models
288	  --bundled`. Codex's global `~/.codex/models_cache.json` is not provider-scoped;
289	  a gateway refresh can otherwise replace first-party entries with the smaller
290	  adapter subset and trigger fallback-metadata warnings for bundled models such
291	  as `gpt-5.6-sol`. The cache lives under
292	  `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/copilot-proxy/codex-models/` (default
293	  `~/.cache/copilot-proxy/codex-models/`) and regenerates after a Codex version
294	  change. Explicit later `-c model_catalog_json=...` still wins.
295	- Claude/Gemini fallback uses the gateway's Responses Lite translation. Basic
296	  tools, compaction and multi-agent orchestration remain available, but Responses
297	  `tool_search` is not supported on that path. Auto selection therefore keeps
298	  native Responses OpenAI models ahead of Anthropic.
299	- The launcher enables gateway-backed remote compaction and excludes the
300	  `mcp__codex_apps__sites` namespace that depends on unavailable `tool_search`.
301	  Explicit later `-c` arguments can still override either per invocation.
302	- When SpecStory is installed, the launcher defaults to `specstory run codex`.
303	  It preserves the effective `codex_cmd` (project config > user config > bare
304	  `codex`) before appending provider/model/user arguments. Use
305	  `--no-specstory` for raw Codex.
306	
307	Codex intentionally does not get a `copilot-here` equivalent. Official Codex
308	configuration allows project `.codex/config.toml` for trusted project settings,
309	but ignores `model_provider`, `model_providers`, provider auth and other
310	host-owned metadata at project scope. An explicit launcher is therefore the
311	project/session boundary without changing the user-wide default. See the
312	[configuration reference](https://developers.openai.com/codex/config-reference)
313	and [configuration basics](https://developers.openai.com/codex/config-basic).
314	
315	#### Experimental direct provider (not used by the helper)
316	
317	This skips localhost and is useful only when the account's GitHub credential can
318	authenticate directly to the matching Copilot endpoint:
319	
320	```toml
321	[model_providers.copilot-enterprise]
322	name = "GitHub Copilot Enterprise"
323	base_url = "https://api.enterprise.githubcopilot.com"
324	wire_api = "responses"
325	http_headers = { "Copilot-Integration-Id" = "vscode-chat", "Editor-Version" = "vscode/1.99.0", "Editor-Plugin-Version" = "copilot-chat/0.0.1", "User-Agent" = "GithubCopilot/1.0" }
326	
327	[model_providers.copilot-enterprise.auth]
328	command = "gh"
329	args = ["auth", "token", "--hostname", "github.com"]
330	timeout_ms = 5000
331	refresh_interval_ms = 300000
332	```
333	
334	This is an example, not managed config. On the tested EMU/Enterprise account,
335	the raw `gh auth token` produced `421 Misdirected Request` at the enterprise API
336	and could not perform the Copilot token exchange (`403`). The token saved by
337	`copilot-proxy auth`, followed by the normal short-lived Copilot token exchange,
338	did work. Endpoint routing also comes from that exchange; hard-coding personal
339	versus enterprise hosts is not portable. For those reasons the supported helper
340	uses the already authenticated localhost gateway.
341	
342	### `copilot-here [on|off|status]` — sticky per-project toggle
343	
344	Layer 2: pin **this project** to the proxy via `./.claude/settings.local.json`
345	so plain `claude` (and `scode`/`svibe` panes, which just run
346	`specstory run claude`) uses the proxy until you turn it off. Requires `jq`.
347	
348	- `on` — jq-merges the proxy `env` block into `settings.local.json` (creates it
349	  if missing) and makes sure git ignores the file (via `.git/info/exclude`;
350	  Claude Code only auto-gitignores files *it* creates). The committed
351	  `.claude/settings.json` (`plansDirectory` etc.) is never touched.
352	- `off` — removes exactly the env keys `on` added; other content you put in
353	  `settings.local.json` survives, and the file is deleted if it becomes empty.
354	- `status` — pinned? which base URL / model? Flags a **stale** pin (model/base
355	  drifted from the current defaults) with the exact diff and a `copilot-here on`
356	  refresh hint, and warns when the proxy isn't running.
357	
358	### `copilot-model [<id>|-l|-c|--auto]`
359	
360	Switches the pinned Copilot model. Requires `jq`. Write target — never the
361	committed `.claude/settings.json`:
362	
363	- `copilot-here` is ON in the current project → edits
364	  `./.claude/settings.local.json`.
365	- otherwise → writes the global state file
366	  `~/.local/state/copilot-proxy/model`, which `claude-copilot`, `copilot-run`
367	  and the next `copilot-here on` pick up. (`$COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL` overrides
368	  the state file; final fallback is `gpt-5.6-sol[1m]`.)
369	
370	Behavior:
371	
372	- Fuzzy id: `copilot-model opus-4-8` resolves to `claude-opus-4-8`; dotted
373	  input is normalized (`opus-4.8` works too).
374	- `[1m]` is a Claude Code-only context hint. The helper now derives it from
375	  live `/v1/models` `max_context_window_tokens` metadata for every provider;
376	  manual explicit suffixes remain usable while offline.
377	- Validated against the live proxy `/v1/models` (a static discovery list remains
378	  available for manual picking while offline); typos and ambiguous prefixes are
379	  rejected. `--auto` never writes from that offline list.
380	- `--auto` / `-a` requires a live catalog. It prefers Claude
381	  (`Fable > Opus > Sonnet > Haiku`), then ranks OpenAI by capability:
382	  `Sol > Terra > GPT-5.5 > GPT-5.4 > GPT-5.3 Codex > Luna > mini`, then Gemini.
383	  Luna deliberately follows older flagships because it is the lightweight tier.
384	  The Sol/Terra/Luna intent follows OpenAI's
385	  [current model guidance](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/latest-model).
386	- No argument → `fzf` picker. `-c` prints the main model, source layer, and
387	  the complete role profile.
388	- A local pin writes the complete role set. For an OpenAI profile:
389	  Main/Fable/Opus = Sol, Sonnet = Terra, Haiku/background = Luna. Missing tiers
390	  fall back to the selected main, never an unserved hard-coded id.
391	- The global state file stays a backward-compatible one-line main id; wrappers
392	  derive the live role profile when they inject env. Changes take effect on the
393	  next `claude` launch and do **not** require restarting the proxy.
394	
395	Recommended sequence:
396	
397	```sh
398	copilot-proxy start
399	copilot-model --auto        # save the main model / refresh a live project pin
400	copilot-model -c            # inspect main + Fable/Opus/Sonnet/Haiku
401	copilot-here on             # sticky project, or use claude-copilot-once
402	```
403	
404	`claude-copilot-once` temporarily writes the same full profile and restores the
405	previous local state. An existing `copilot-here` pin still outranks shell env;
406	refresh it with `copilot-model --auto` or `copilot-here on`.
407	
408	The role variables are read at Claude Code startup, so
409	  **the change only takes effect on the next `claude` launch** (env is read at
410	  startup).
411	
412	## Injected env (what both layers set)
413	
414	```json
415	{
416	  "env": {
417	    "ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL": "http://localhost:4141",
418	    "ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN": "dummy",
419	    "ANTHROPIC_MODEL": "gpt-5.6-sol[1m]",
420	    "ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL": "gpt-5.6-sol[1m]",
421	    "ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL": "gpt-5.6-sol[1m]",
422	    "ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL": "gpt-5.6-terra[1m]",
423	    "ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL": "gpt-5.6-luna[1m]",
424	    "ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL": "gpt-5.6-luna[1m]",
425	    "CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC": "1"
426	  }
427	}
428	```
429	
430	`ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` is ignored by the proxy but must be set.
431	`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC=1` cuts background chatter (helps with
432	rate limits). Do **not** paste this into the committed `.claude/settings.json` —
433	use `copilot-here on` instead.
434	
435	With `COPILOT_PROXY_QUIET=1` (opt-in, default off), both layers additionally
436	inject the fork-README quota savers:
437	
438	| Extra env | Effect | UX cost |
439	|---|---|---|
440	| `CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER=0` | no billing/version info in system prompts → avoids prompt-cache invalidation | none noticeable |
441	| `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_PROMPT_SUGGESTION=false` | no prompt-suggestion calls | no suggestions |
442	| `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AWAY_SUMMARY=0` | no away-summary calls | no away summaries |
443	| `DISABLE_NON_ESSENTIAL_MODEL_CALLS=1` | fewer background model calls | fewer niceties (haiku flavor text etc.) |
444	
445	`copilot-here off` removes these keys regardless of the current
446	`COPILOT_PROXY_QUIET` value.
447	
448	## Claude Code feature compatibility through the proxy
449	
450	The important split is **local orchestration vs Anthropic cloud services**:
451	
452	| Feature | Through Copilot + GPT | Notes |
453	|---|---|---|
454	| CLI, tools, hooks, skills, memory, plugins, MCP, checkpoints, sandboxing | Yes | These are local Claude Code features; model behavior can still differ because GPT receives translated Claude prompts/tool schemas. |
455	| Subagents and dynamic workflows | Yes | Do not set `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL` globally here, so workflow scripts/frontmatter retain normal routing. [Workflow docs](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/workflows) |
456	| `ultracode` | Yes on `2.1.0` | Ultracode is xhigh effort plus dynamic workflows, not a separate model. The upgraded fork forwards the requested effort to GPT-5.6. |
457	| Thinking/reasoning | Translated | GPT uses Responses reasoning rather than Anthropic-native thinking semantics. Persisted reasoning support is proxy-dependent. |
458	| Web search, fast/auto mode, MCP tool search | Provider-dependent | The base-URL gateway and Copilot endpoint decide availability; non-first-party tool search may require an extra bridge/plugin. |
459	| Ultrareview, Remote Control, Chrome, cloud Code Review, routines, web/mobile/Slack sessions | No | These require Claude.ai authentication/cloud services; a local API gateway cannot supply the subscription identity. `ultrareview` is unrelated to `ultracode`. |
460	
461	See Claude Code's [feature availability](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/feature-availability),
462	[model configuration](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config),
463	[gateway protocol](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/llm-gateway-protocol), and
464	[Ultrareview](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/ultrareview) references.
465	
466	## Gotchas (these cost real debugging time)
467	
468	### `start` used to hang at "Resolving dependencies" behind a socks proxy
469	
470	**Fixed** (the runner no longer resolves at launch), but worth understanding
471	because the failure mode is so misleading — and because it will bite any *other*
472	`bunx`-based tool on a proxied host.
473	
474	`start` used to run `bunx <pkg> start`, and bunx re-resolves the package on every
475	launch. **bun hangs indefinitely resolving through a socks `ALL_PROXY`** — while
476	`curl` through that same proxy reaches the registry in under half a second. So
477	every obvious check passes and nothing points at the installer. All you get is:
478	
479	```
480	copilot-proxy: did not come up in time — check 'copilot-proxy logs'.
481	$ copilot-proxy logs
482	nohup: ignoring input
483	Resolving dependencies
484	```
485	
486	Two things turned one stall into a permanent wedge: the stalled `bun add` kept
487	bun's **global install-cache lock**, so the next `start` hung on the lock too; and
488	`start`'s timeout returned without killing what it spawned, so each retry left
489	another orphan (five, in the wild) and none ever bound the port.
490	
491	The runner now installs the pinned package **once** into
492	`~/.local/share/copilot-api/pkg` and execs that binary, so a warm start does no
493	network at all. The install itself is bounded and killed on timeout, falls back to
494	a proxy-stripped retry, and finally uses npm's CA stack if Bun reports
495	`UNKNOWN_CERTIFICATE_VERIFICATION_ERROR`. TLS verification stays enabled; this
496	works around the observed Bun-vs-Node CA-store difference rather than disabling
497	certificate checks. Note the registry here is npmmirror (a domestic mirror,
498	set in `~/.bunfig.toml` for GFW speed) — routing it through the proxy buys nothing
499	and is exactly what breaks bun.
500	
501	Full post-mortem, with the verbatim symptoms to grep:
502	[`pitfalls/copilot-proxy-start-hangs-at-resolving-dependencies.md`](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dotfiles/blob/main/pitfalls/copilot-proxy-start-hangs-at-resolving-dependencies.md).
503	
504	### The model list is fetched ONCE at startup — geo + flaky fetches poison the session
505	
506	`copilot-api` fetches `/models` from GitHub when the process starts, caches the
507	result for its whole lifetime, and never re-fetches. Two common ways that one
508	request returns a **Claude-less** catalog:
509	
510	1. **Egress geo-filter (GFW hosts, post-TUN)** — GitHub serves Claude ids when the
511	   request egresses overseas (e.g. Singapore VLESS), and omits them on direct/CN
512	   egress. **Node does not honor the macOS System Proxy**, so with only
513	   System Proxy / no TUN, `copilot-api` and OpenCode fetch the direct catalog
514	   (0 Claude) while `curl` through Clash still sees Claude. Fix: `copilot-proxy
515	   start` with `COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=auto` (default) attaches `--proxy-env` +
516	   `HTTPS_PROXY` when `proxy-status` finds a local proxy. OpenCode needs the
517	   same env in its launch environment.
518	2. **Flaky node** — a degraded Clash node returns a truncated list; restart after
519	   the node is healthy.
520	
521	The tell is in the startup banner:
522	
523	```
524	ℹ Models refresh: 17 new     ← often the direct/CN catalog (no claude ids)
525	ℹ Models refresh: 25 new     ← healthy via overseas proxy (includes claude-*)
526	```
527	
528	`copilot-proxy doctor` A/Bs **upstream direct** vs **upstream via proxy** vs the
529	**served** cache so it no longer mis-labels geo-filter as "org entitlement".
530	Full write-up:
531	[`pitfalls/copilot-api-caches-degraded-model-list-at-startup.md`](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dotfiles/blob/main/pitfalls/copilot-api-caches-degraded-model-list-at-startup.md).
532	
533	### `settings.local.json` env beats shell env (docs say otherwise)
534	
535	Verified empirically (2026-07): current Claude Code lets the `env` block of
536	`./.claude/settings.local.json` **override inherited shell env vars** — the
537	opposite of what the official settings docs imply. Consequences:
538	
539	- `claude-copilot` / `copilot-run` **cannot** redirect a project where
540	  `copilot-here on` is active (harmless when both point at the same proxy,
541	  silently wrong when they don't).
542	- Trialing another proxy/port via the wrapper requires `copilot-here off`
543	  first.
544	
545	### OpenAI models go silent while they think — the shim keeps the socket warm
546	
547	`copilot-api` does **not** open the SSE stream early: measured against `:4141`
548	with `gpt-5.6-sol`, the response *headers* arrive at 8.11s and the first body
549	chunk at 8.12s, so a reasoning model's whole think time is spent inside one
550	`fetch()` with zero bytes on the wire. Real Anthropic streams cover that with
551	periodic `ping` events; this gateway emits none. Add the shim's concurrency
552	queue on top (`COPILOT_SHIM_MAX`, default 4 — request 5 waits in total silence)
553	and any idle timer in the path is free to reap a perfectly healthy connection.
554	The agent then hangs with no error, and the only way out is Esc + `continue`.
555	
556	So for client-requested streams the shim commits the `text/event-stream`
557	response itself after `COPILOT_SHIM_PING_AFTER_MS` of silence and emits SSE
558	*comment* frames (`: copilot-shim keepalive`, discarded by every spec-compliant
559	parser, so invisible to both the Anthropic and OpenAI SDKs) every
560	`COPILOT_SHIM_PING_MS` until real bytes arrive — covering queue time, think
561	time, and mid-stream reasoning gaps alike. `COPILOT_SHIM_STALL_MS` bounds each
562	attempt: a pre-header stall is aborted and retried transparently (nothing but
563	comment frames has reached the client), a mid-stream stall fails the response
564	with a real error instead of hanging.
565	
566	| Env | Default | Meaning |
567	|---|---|---|
568	| `COPILOT_SHIM_PING_MS` | `15000` | keepalive interval; `0` disables |
569	| `COPILOT_SHIM_PING_AFTER_MS` | `10000` | silence tolerated before the SSE response is committed early |
570	| `COPILOT_SHIM_STALL_MS` | `240000` | silence that counts as a wedged upstream; `0` disables |
571	
572	Requests answered inside the grace window are untouched — real status code, real
573	headers — which is what keeps a fast `400 model_not_supported` or `401 IDE token
574	expired` reporting itself properly. Beware the flip side: once the SSE response
575	is committed, a late non-2xx can only be delivered as an SSE `error` event, so
576	don't shrink `COPILOT_SHIM_PING_AFTER_MS` to zero.
577	
578	`0 tok` in FleetView is **not** evidence of this bug — that counter is only
579	filled in when an agent finishes. Check `agent-<id>.jsonl` for growing
580	`assistant` entries first. Full diagnosis:
581	[`pitfalls/copilot-proxy-openai-model-silent-stall.md`](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dotfiles/blob/main/pitfalls/copilot-proxy-openai-model-silent-stall.md).
582	
583	### The fork has no rate limiter
584	
585	The fork's `start` dropped `--rate-limit`/`--wait`. Its README's mitigation is
586	reducing Claude Code's chatter instead — that's exactly what
587	`COPILOT_PROXY_QUIET=1` injects (off by default here; we prioritize UX over
588	Copilot quota). If you really want request throttling, fall back to the
589	original: `COPILOT_API_PKG=copilot-api@0.7.0`.
590	
591	### Context management is translated, not Anthropic-native
592	
593	Older fork releases could forward Claude Code's `context_management` field to
594	an endpoint that rejected it with 400
595	([caozhiyuan#305](https://github.com/caozhiyuan/copilot-api/issues/305)). The
596	`2.1.0` GPT-5.6 path suppresses that incompatible field and relies on Responses
597	reasoning/context handling instead. This avoids the 400, but Anthropic's exact
598	context-editing and prompt-cache semantics are not reproduced; long-session
599	behavior remains a compatibility surface to watch.
600	
601	### Do not use Claude Code's `/model` picker
602	
603	It sends Anthropic's *official* dated ids (e.g. `claude-opus-4-8-YYYYMMDD`),
604	which the Copilot backend rejects:
605	
606	```
607	API Error: 400 {"error":{"message":"The requested model is not supported.",
608	"code":"model_not_supported", ...}}
609	```
610	
611	Pin the model with `copilot-model` instead — undated hyphenated ids
612	(`claude-opus-4-8`) work; only the picker's dated ids fail.
613	
614	### Dotted ids cause the "[Opus 4] retired" warning and a >100% context HUD
615	
616	Historic gotcha, fixed by the hyphenated defaults. With a **dotted** id
617	(`claude-opus-4.8`, the only shape the original proxy accepted), Claude Code
618	fails to match its built-in model table, so it:
619	
620	- displays `[Opus 4]` and warns *"Claude Opus 4 was retired"* (falls back to
621	  the nearest known, retired name), and
622	- assumes a **200k** context window, while Copilot actually serves opus-5 /
623	  opus-4-8 / sonnet-5 with **1M** (`max_context_window_tokens: 1000000` in `/v1/models`)
624	  — so HUD/statusline context can read >100% and compaction triggers on the
625	  wrong budget.
626	
627	The helpers use hyphenated ids and derive `[1m]` from each live model's context
628	metadata. That applies to GPT ids too (`gpt-5.6-sol[1m]`, for example). Claude
629	Code strips the suffix before sending; a raw API client must use the plain id.
630	
631	### The token gotcha: `gho_` vs `ghu_`
632	
633	There are two different GitHub tokens, and they are **not** interchangeable:
634	
635	| Source | Prefix | `copilot_internal/v2/token` exchange |
636	|---|---|---|
637	| OpenCode's stored auth | `gho_` | **fails (404)** |
638	| `copilot-proxy auth` (device login) | `ghu_` | **works** |
639	
640	## Available models and role discovery
641	
642	Treat `GET /v1/models` as live truth: GitHub can change the catalog by account,
643	organization policy, rollout and egress. Current Claude Code recognizes Fable,
644	Opus, Sonnet and Haiku roles; `copilot-model --auto` maps only ids actually in
645	that catalog. Use `copilot-model -l` for raw served ids and `copilot-model -c`
646	for the effective role mapping. Do not copy a dated Anthropic id or manually
647	guess which models have 1M context.
648	
649	## Useful commands
650	
651	```sh
652	claude-copilot                       # one-off proxy session (specstory-wrapped)
653	claude-copilot-once                  # one-shot session via the settings.local.json pin (auto-reverted)
654	copilot-here status                  # is this project pinned to the proxy?
655	copilot-model -c                     # current model + which layer it came from
656	copilot-proxy status                 # up? which Claude models?
657	copilot-proxy whoami                 # validate token → account / plan / quota
658	copilot-proxy logs 60                # tail the proxy log
659	# usage dashboard (bundled locally by the fork):
660	#   http://localhost:4141/usage-viewer?endpoint=http://localhost:4141/usage
661	```

33	## 快速開始
34	
35	```sh
36	copilot-proxy auth      # 一次性：GitHub 裝置登入 (device login)（儲存 ghu_ token）

39

41	claude-copilot-once     # 釘住「這個專案」跑一次 session，結束自動解除（代理需已啟動）
42	codex-copilot           # 一次性 Codex session；auto 優先選 OpenAI
43	codex-copilot-once      # 完全相同的 alias；兩者都不寫 Codex config
44	
45	copilot-here on         # 或者：釘選「這個專案」—— 之後直接跑 `claude` 就走代理
46	copilot-here off        # 取消釘選 —— 回到真正的 Anthropic 後端
47	```
48	
49	## 運作原理
50	
51	```
52	Claude Code ──Anthropic /v1/messages──▶ copilot-api (localhost:4141)
53	                                          │ Claude：native Messages path
54	                                          │ GPT：Anthropic → Responses 轉譯
55	                                          ▼
56	                                   api.githubcopilot.com  （你的 Copilot 訂閱）
57	
58	Codex ──OpenAI /v1/responses──────────▶ 同一個 localhost gateway
59	        （provider/model 只透過本次啟動的 `-c` / `-m` 覆寫）
60	```
61	
62	- Claude Code 只講 **Anthropic Messages API**（`/v1/messages`）。
63	- fork 對 Claude id 使用 Copilot native Anthropic path；對 GPT id 把 Claude Code
64	  request 轉成 **Responses API**。`2.1.0` 會把 `output_config.effort` 正確轉成
65	  `reasoning.effort`，並支援 GPT-5.6 request shape 與 reasoning state。
66	- Claude Code 透過 `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` 被指向代理 —— 注入方式有兩種：
67	  per-process 環境變數（`claude-copilot`），或 gitignore 掉的
68	  `./.claude/settings.local.json`（`copilot-here on`）。見「設定分層設計」。
69	
70	## 設定分層設計（代理設定該放哪一層、為什麼）
71	
72	Claude Code 由低到高合併設定：`~/.claude/settings.json`（user）→
73	`./.claude/settings.json`（project，會 commit）→ `./.claude/settings.local.json`
74	（local，gitignored）→ CLI flags。實測中 `settings.local.json` 的 `env` 可以蓋過繼承的
75	shell env，所以已開 `copilot-here` 時，`claude-copilot` 不會強行覆蓋它。
76	
77	其中兩層已有其他工具負責，必須保持乾淨：
78	
79	| 層 | 擁有者 | 為什麼代理設定「不能」放這裡 |
80	|---|---|---|
81	| `~/.claude/settings.json` | chezmoi（`dot_claude/modify_settings.json.tmpl`） | 會讓 *每個* 專案永遠走代理；還會跟 chezmoi 的合併打架 |
82	| `./.claude/settings.json` | `claude-plans-here`（`plansDirectory`） | 會 commit 進 git —— 代理設定會外洩給整個團隊 |
83	
84	所以代理使用沒人佔用的兩層：
85	
86	| 啟用 | 機制 | 範圍 | 停用 |
87	|---|---|---|---|
88	| `claude-copilot` / `copilot-run` | per-process 環境變數 | 單一 session | 下次直接跑 `claude` 即可 |
89	| `claude-copilot-once` | 暫時 `settings.local.json` pin | 單一 session | session 結束自動還原 |
90	| `copilot-here on` | `./.claude/settings.local.json`（gitignored） | 這個專案、持續生效 | `copilot-here off` |
91	
92	```
93	~/.claude/settings.json          .claude/settings.json         .claude/settings.local.json      shell env
94	(chezmoi: hooks/plugins)    <    (git: plansDirectory)     <   (copilot-here on/off)        <   (claude-copilot)
95	```
96	
97	## Shell helpers
98	
99	### `copilot-proxy [start|stop|restart|status|doctor [--live]|logs [N]|whoami|auth]`
100	
101	在 `$COPILOT_PROXY_PORT`（預設 `4141`）管理背景代理。
102	
103	| 環境變數 | 預設 | 意義 |
104	|---|---|---|
105	| `COPILOT_PROXY_PORT` | `4141` | 代理監聽的 port |
106	| `COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY` | `auto` | GitHub `/models` 用的上游 HTTP proxy：`auto`（本機 Clash/Verge/mihomo 有在聽就帶 `--proxy-env`）、`never`（直連）、`always`（一定要偵測到 proxy）、或明確 URL |
107	| `COPILOT_API_PKG` | `@jeffreycao/copilot-api@2.1.0` | 要安裝的套件規格（釘選/升級）。`2.1.0` 才會把 Claude Code effort 傳到 GPT-5.6。 |
108	| `COPILOT_PROXY_RATE` | `15` | 僅舊版 `copilot-api@0.7.0` 使用；fork 沒有 rate limiter |
109	| `COPILOT_PROXY_QUIET` | `0` | `1` 減少背景模型呼叫，但會犧牲部分 UX |
110	| `COPILOT_INSTALL_NOPROXY` | `0` | `1` = 安裝時把 proxy 環境變數拿掉，跳過「bun 無法透過 proxy 解析」那 45 秒的卡頓 |
111	
112	這些設在 `~/.shellrc.adhoc`（或 per-shell secrets 檔案）。在 `copilot-proxy auth`
113	儲存 token 之前，`start` 會拒絕執行；啟動後最多等 ~20 秒直到代理能回應才返回。
114	
115	**第一次** `start` 會把釘選的套件安裝到 `~/.local/share/copilot-api/pkg`（並寫下 spec
116	戳記），之後每次啟動只是直接執行那個 binary —— 不打 registry、不做啟動時解析。安裝時會
117	先用你當下的環境變數（在「registry 只能透過 proxy 連到」的機器上必要），卡住就改用拿掉
118	proxy 的重試；兩種嘗試都有 timeout 並會被殺掉，所以卡死的安裝再也不可能占住 bun 的全域
119	快取鎖而拖垮下一次。`start` 逾時的時候現在也會**把自己啟動的 server 殺掉**，不會像以前
120	那樣每重試一次就留下一個孤兒程序。
121	
122	`copilot-proxy whoami` 是真正的登入檢查：它拿儲存的 token 對 GitHub 交換，並印出你的
123	帳號 / plan / quota（token 缺失或過期時會明確報錯）。用它取代直接看 token 檔案 —— token
124	是明文憑證 (plaintext credential)，不應在編輯器裡打開。
125	
126	### `copilot-proxy doctor [--live]`（別名：`test`）
127	
128	診斷整條路徑，任何一項失敗就以非零狀態結束。預設**唯讀**；加上 `--live` 會多送一個真實的
129	`POST /v1/messages`（`max_tokens: 1`、挑一個非 `[1m]` 的 chat model），會消耗一個 quota
130	單位，但那是唯一能驗證 streaming 的檢查。
131	
132	檢查順序：前置工具（`bun`/`curl`/`jq`）→ **套件 (package)** → token 檔案 → 代理與
133	throttle shim 是否存活 → 安裝殘留（stale installer）→ **模型**→ 上游連線 →
134	本機代理 / VPN → **Codex Apps** → live inference probe。
135	
136	**套件 (package)** 這一段報告釘選的 spec 是否已安裝在 prefix 裡、binary 在哪。顯示
137	「未安裝」不算失敗 —— 下一次 `start` 會自動裝一次。
138	
139	**安裝殘留（stale installer）** 是[陷阱](#start-used-to-hang-at-resolving-dependencies-behind-a-socks-proxy)
140	那個坑的保險絲：平常若還有存活的 `bun add … copilot-api`，就代表某次安裝卡死了（bun 透過
141	socks proxy 解析相依會卡住），而且正占著 bun 的全域快取鎖。現在安裝流程自己會設 timeout
142	並殺掉卡死的程序，所以這一項應該永遠是空的；萬一真的觸發，doctor 會印出「清掉再重啟」的
143	一行指令。
144	
145	其中「模型」這一段才是這個指令的價值所在。它把代理**目前提供的**模型清單，跟 GitHub
146	**此刻真正提供的**清單相比對 —— 這是唯一能區分 `400 model_not_supported` 兩種成因的方法：
147	
148	| 代理有 claude？ | 上游有 claude？ | 判定 | 修法 |
149	|---|---|---|---|
150	| 沒有 | **有** | 快取過期 (stale cache) | `copilot-proxy restart` |
151	| 沒有 | 沒有 | 組織政策停用 Anthropic | 重啟**沒有用** |
152	
153	它會同時驗證 main 與 Fable/Opus/Sonnet/Haiku aliases，包括 `[1m]` alias。某個過期的
154	background role id，會造成普通對話成功、workflow 卻 400。沒有 Claude entitlement 在可用的
155	OpenAI profile 存在時是 warning，不是整體失敗。
156	
157	上游連線會同時探測 `api.enterprise.githubcopilot.com` 與 `api.githubcopilot.com`，直連
158	**以及**（若有設定）走 macOS 系統代理，所以 Clash/mihomo 規則黑洞掉其中一個 host 時會立刻
159	顯現。未帶認證的 `400`/`401` 算「連得到」—— 只有連線/讀取失敗才算故障。`doctor` 絕不會印出你的
160	token：憑證是透過 `curl -K -`（stdin）傳入，而非 argv，因為 argv 可被 `ps` 讀到。
161	
162	使用 `--live` 時，Codex Apps 段落還會對
163	`https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/apps` 分別做 direct 與 detected HTTP
164	proxy probe。這個 GET 不消耗 model inference quota，可把 `codex_apps` 啟動中斷與
165	localhost Copilot 路由拆開診斷。任何真實 HTTP status（包含 auth rejection）都代表
166	網路可達；timeout 與 TLS certificate failure 會分開顯示。`codex_apps` 是遠端
167	ChatGPT MCP，不是只供 Apple Silicon Codex Desktop 使用的 bridge。
168	
169	### `claude-copilot [--no-specstory] [claude args...]` —— 一次性 session
170	
171	第一層：跑一次走代理的 Claude Code session，**完全不寫檔案**。代理沒回應時會自動
172	啟動它，然後以 per-process 的 `ANTHROPIC_*` 環境變數啟動 `claude`（shell 環境變數
173	蓋過所有 settings 檔的 `env` 區塊，所以即使專案沒開 `copilot-here` 也會生效）。
174	
175	- 有安裝 specstory 時自動包成 `specstory run claude`（markdown 自動存檔 ——
176	  跟 `scode`/`svibe` 同一套慣例）；用 `--no-specstory` 退出。額外參數透過
177	  specstory 的 `-c "custom command"` 傳給 claude CLI：`claude-copilot -c`
178	  → 繼續上一個 session。
179	- **傳參數時會保留你設定的 `claude_cmd`。** specstory 的 `-c` 是「**取代**」
180	  provider 指令而不是「附加」，所以這裡會先取出 specstory 設定檔中生效的
181	  `claude_cmd`（專案 `./.specstory/cli/config.toml` > 使用者
182	  `~/.specstory/cli/config.toml` > 裸 `claude`），再把參數接在後面。這正是讓
183	  `claude_cmd = "claude --dangerously-skip-permissions"` 對
184	  `claude-copilot --resume <id>` 也生效、而不是只對沒帶參數的 `claude-copilot`
185	  生效的原因 —— 這兩者以前行為並不一致，詳見
186	  [`pitfalls/specstory-custom-command-drops-configured-flags.md`](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dotfiles/blob/main/pitfalls/specstory-custom-command-drops-configured-flags.md)。
187	  `--no-specstory` 刻意不繼承（既然退出 specstory，就一併退出它的設定）。
188	- 還原 = 不用還原；下次直接跑 `claude` 完全不受影響。
189	
190	### `claude-copilot-once [--no-specstory] [claude args...]` —— 一次性釘選 session
191	
192	第一層的用完即丟 + 第二層的可靠度：用 `copilot-here on` 釘住 **這個專案**，跑一個
193	`claude-copilot` session，結束時 `copilot-here off` —— 連 Ctrl-C 也會還原。當純環境變數
194	注入不夠力（因為 `settings.local.json` 位階高於 shell env，見陷阱章節）、但你又不想留下
195	一個黏著的 pin 時就用它。
196	
197	- **前提條件：** 代理必須**已經**在跑 —— 跟 `claude-copilot` 不同，它**不會**自動啟動；
198	  代理沒回應時它只印出 `copilot-proxy start` 提示並回傳非零。
199	- **不動既有 pin：** 如果這個專案的 `copilot-here` 本來就是 `on`，結束時會原樣保留
200	  （不會去解除你沒要求解除的 pin）。如果那個 pin **過期了** —— 跟現在 `copilot-here on`
201	  會寫入的內容不一致，例如帳號已改走 OpenAI fallback、pin 還停在不可用的 Claude id，
202	  或是 pin 建立時還沒有 Fable key —— 它會印出差異，並詢問要
203	  就地更新（`copilot-here on`）還是保留。預設答案是**保留**（stdin 非互動時自動保留）。
204	  差異的計算方式是拿現檔去 diff `copilot-here on` 會合併的那份 env 區塊
205	  （`_copilot_env_json`，兩邊共用的唯一來源），所以它精確等於「`on` 會改動的 key」——
206	  不是一份會默默落後的手挑清單。檔案裡有、但不在那份區塊裡的 key **不算**差異：
207	  `on` 只合併、從不移除（只有 `off` 會移除）。`copilot-here status` 會印出同一份差異報告。
208	- session 本身就是 `claude-copilot "$@"`，所以 specstory 自動存檔、`--no-specstory`、
209	  `-c`（繼續）的行為完全一致。
210	- 結束時會提醒你代理還開著，以及怎麼 `copilot-proxy stop`。
211	
212	### `copilot-run <cmd...>` —— 泛用環境變數注入器
213	
214	`claude-copilot` 底下的積木：自動啟動代理，然後帶著代理 env 執行 *任意* 指令。
215	適合其他 Anthropic 相容工具或自訂的 specstory 呼叫：
216	
217	```sh
218	copilot-run specstory run claude    # 等同 claude-copilot 做的事
219	copilot-run claude --resume         # 裸 claude，不經 specstory
220	```
221	
222	### `codex-copilot [--no-specstory] [codex args...]` —— 一次性 Codex session
223	
224	`codex-copilot` 與 `codex-copilot-once` 是完全相同、零持久化的 launcher。
225	它們會視需要啟動 gateway/shim，並用 CLI `-c` overrides 把自訂的
226	`copilot_api` Responses provider 傳給 Codex；不會編輯 `~/.codex/config.toml`
227	或 `.codex/config.toml`，所以 plain `codex` 仍走原本 provider。
228	
229	Codex 一律走 `localhost:4142` shim，即使持久化的 throttling 開關是 off。
230	這一層除了限流，也會正規化 Codex `mcp_list_tools` Responses item 裡的空白
231	description。MCP server 與原生 Codex path 可以省略描述，但 GitHub Copilot 會以
232	`Invalid 'input[0].tools[0].description': empty string` 拒絕請求。shim 只補這些
233	tool definition 欄位，不改 prompt、schema 或 tool name。
234	目前 Codex 會以 zstd 壓縮這些請求；shim 只解壓需要修補的 Responses body，改以
235	普通 JSON 轉送，並移除已不適用的 `content-encoding` header。
236	
237	這是與 Claude Code `copilot-model --auto` 分開的 picker：後者保持
238	Claude-first，只有這個 Codex launcher 是 OpenAI-first。
239	
240	- 呼叫者明確傳入 `-m` / `--model` 時永遠優先。否則從即時 raw catalog
241	  依序選 OpenAI/Codex（`Sol > Terra > GPT-5.5 > GPT-5.4 > GPT-5.3 Codex >
242	  Luna > mini`），再退到 Claude、Gemini、其他 chat model；embedding 與 disabled
243	  model 會排除。
244	- launcher 會把所選 model 的即時 context/prompt limit 傳給 Codex，並把
245	  `model_catalog_json` 指向 `codex debug models --bundled` 產生的版本化快取。
246	  Codex 的全域 `~/.codex/models_cache.json` 不會依 provider 分區；gateway refresh
247	  可能把 first-party entries 換成較小的 adapter subset，讓 `gpt-5.6-sol` 這類
248	  bundled model 出現 fallback-metadata warning。快取位於
249	  `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/copilot-proxy/codex-models/`（預設
250	  `~/.cache/copilot-proxy/codex-models/`），Codex 版本改變時會自動重建；呼叫者
251	  後續明確傳入的 `-c model_catalog_json=...` 仍優先。
252	- Claude/Gemini fallback 經 Responses Lite 轉譯；基本 tools、compaction、
253	  multi-agent orchestration 可用，但這條路不支援 Responses `tool_search`，因此
254	  auto 會把 native Responses OpenAI models 排在 Anthropic 前。
255	- Launcher 會啟用 gateway-backed remote compaction，並排除依賴不可用
256	  `tool_search` 的 `mcp__codex_apps__sites` namespace；使用者後續傳入的 `-c`
257	  仍可在單次呼叫覆寫這兩項。
258	- 有安裝 SpecStory 時預設執行 `specstory run codex`，並保留實際生效的
259	  `codex_cmd`（project config > user config > 裸 `codex`），再附加 provider、
260	  model 與使用者參數。`--no-specstory` 直接跑 Codex。
261	
262	Codex 刻意不提供 `copilot-here` 對應物。官方 Codex config 允許 trusted project
263	使用 `.codex/config.toml`，但 project scope 會忽略 `model_provider`、
264	`model_providers`、provider auth 等 host-owned metadata。因此顯式 launcher 才能在
265	不改 user-wide default 的前提下，提供 project/session 邊界。參考
266	[configuration reference](https://developers.openai.com/codex/config-reference) 與
267	[configuration basics](https://developers.openai.com/codex/config-basic)。
268	
269	#### 實驗性 direct provider（正式 helper 不使用）
270	
271	以下設定會跳過 localhost；只有帳號 credential 能直接驗證到相符 Copilot endpoint
272	時才可用：
273	
274	```toml
275	[model_providers.copilot-enterprise]
276	name = "GitHub Copilot Enterprise"
277	base_url = "https://api.enterprise.githubcopilot.com"
278	wire_api = "responses"
279	http_headers = { "Copilot-Integration-Id" = "vscode-chat", "Editor-Version" = "vscode/1.99.0", "Editor-Plugin-Version" = "copilot-chat/0.0.1", "User-Agent" = "GithubCopilot/1.0" }
280	
281	[model_providers.copilot-enterprise.auth]
282	command = "gh"
283	args = ["auth", "token", "--hostname", "github.com"]
284	timeout_ms = 5000
285	refresh_interval_ms = 300000
286	```
287	
288	這只是範例，不是受管設定。在本次 EMU/Enterprise 帳號實測，裸
289	`gh auth token` 對 enterprise API 回 `421 Misdirected Request`，而 Copilot token
290	exchange 回 `403`；`copilot-proxy auth` 保存的 token 經正常短效 Copilot token
291	exchange 則可用。Endpoint 也由 exchange 結果決定，hard-code personal/enterprise
292	host 不具可攜性。因此正式 helper 沿用已認證的 localhost gateway。
293	
294	### `copilot-here [on|off|status]` —— 專案級持續開關
295	
296	第二層：透過 `./.claude/settings.local.json` 把 **這個專案** 釘在代理上 ——
297	之後直接跑 `claude`（以及 `scode`/`svibe` 的窗格，它們就是跑
298	`specstory run claude`）都走代理，直到你關掉。需要 `jq`。
299	
300	- `on` —— 用 jq 把代理的 `env` 區塊合併進 `settings.local.json`（不存在就建立），
301	  並確保 git 忽略該檔（寫入 `.git/info/exclude`；Claude Code 只會自動 gitignore
302	  *它自己* 建立的檔案）。會 commit 的 `.claude/settings.json`（`plansDirectory`
303	  等）完全不碰。
304	- `off` —— 只移除 `on` 加入的那些 env key；你自己放進 `settings.local.json`
305	  的其他內容會保留，檔案清空時才刪除。
306	- `status` —— 有沒有釘選？base URL / 模型是什麼？代理沒在跑時會警告。
307	
308	### `copilot-model [<id>|-l|-c|--auto]`
309	
310	切換釘選的 Copilot 模型。需要 `jq`。寫入目標 —— 永遠不是會 commit 的
311	`.claude/settings.json`：
312	
313	- 目前專案的 `copilot-here` 是 ON → 編輯 `./.claude/settings.local.json`。
314	- 否則 → 寫入全域狀態檔 `~/.local/state/copilot-proxy/model`，由
315	  `claude-copilot`、`copilot-run` 與下一次 `copilot-here on` 讀取。
316	  （`$COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL` 可覆寫狀態檔；最終預設是 `gpt-5.6-sol[1m]`。）
317	
318	行為：
319	
320	- 模糊 id：`copilot-model opus-4-8` 會解析成 `claude-opus-4-8`；點號寫法也會被
321	  正規化（`opus-4.8` 一樣可用）。
322	- `[1m]` 是只給 Claude Code 看的 context 提示。helper 會依 live `/v1/models`
323	  的 `max_context_window_tokens` 對每個 provider 自動決定，不再靠模型名寫死。
324	- 會對照即時的代理 `/v1/models` 驗證（離線時仍提供靜態 discovery 清單供手動選擇）；
325	  打錯字與不明確的前綴會被拒絕，`--auto` 絕不從離線清單寫入 pin。
326	- `--auto` / `-a` 必須讀到 live catalog。先選 Claude
327	  (`Fable > Opus > Sonnet > Haiku`)；沒有 Claude 時依能力排序：
328	  `Sol > Terra > GPT-5.5 > GPT-5.4 > GPT-5.3 Codex > Luna > mini`，再才是 Gemini。
329	  Luna 雖然是 5.6 世代，但定位是輕量快速，所以排在舊旗艦後面。
330	  Sol/Terra/Luna 的角色意圖依照 OpenAI 的
331	  [current model guidance](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/latest-model)。
332	- OpenAI 角色 profile：Main/Fable/Opus = Sol，Sonnet = Terra，Haiku/background = Luna。
333	  某層沒有 served 模型時退回 main，不會寫入不存在的硬編碼 id。
334	- 無參數 → `fzf` 選單。`-c` 印出 main 來源與 Fable/Opus/Sonnet/Haiku 完整對映。
335	- global state 仍是向後相容的單行 main id；wrapper 在啟動時依 live catalog 產生角色
336	  profile。Local pin 會寫入完整角色組。切換後只需重開 Claude Code，不用重啟 proxy。
337	
338	建議順序：
339	
340	```sh
341	copilot-proxy start
342	copilot-model --auto        # 儲存 main／更新目前 project pin
343	copilot-model -c            # 檢查完整角色組
344	copilot-here on             # 黏著本專案，或改用 claude-copilot-once
345	```
346	
347	`claude-copilot-once` 會暫時寫入同一組 profile，session 後還原。已存在的
348	`copilot-here` pin 仍會蓋過 shell env；用 `copilot-model --auto` 或 `copilot-here on`
349	更新它。
350	
351	## 注入的 env（兩層設定的內容相同）
352	
353	```json
354	{
355	  "env": {
356	    "ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL": "http://localhost:4141",
357	    "ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN": "dummy",
358	    "ANTHROPIC_MODEL": "gpt-5.6-sol[1m]",
359	    "ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL": "gpt-5.6-sol[1m]",
360	    "ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL": "gpt-5.6-sol[1m]",
361	    "ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL": "gpt-5.6-terra[1m]",
362	    "ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL": "gpt-5.6-luna[1m]",
363	    "ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL": "gpt-5.6-luna[1m]",
364	    "CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC": "1"
365	  }
366	}
367	```
368	
369	`ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` 會被代理忽略，但必須設定。
370	`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC=1` 可減少背景流量（有助於速率限制）。
371	**不要** 把這段貼進會 commit 的 `.claude/settings.json` —— 改用 `copilot-here on`。
372	
373	## Claude Code 功能相容性
374	
375	關鍵分界是**本機編排 (local orchestration)** 與 **Anthropic cloud service**：
376	
377	| 功能 | 透過 Copilot + GPT | 說明 |
378	|---|---|---|
379	| CLI、tools、hooks、skills、memory、plugins、MCP、checkpoints、sandboxing | 可以 | 這些是本機 Claude Code 功能；GPT 收到的是經過轉譯的 Claude prompt/tool schema，行為可能不完全一樣。 |
380	| subagents、dynamic workflows | 可以 | 不強制 `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL`，保留 workflow/frontmatter 的 routing。[Workflow 文件](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/workflows) |
381	| `ultracode` | `2.1.0` 可以 | Ultracode 是 xhigh effort + dynamic workflows，不是單獨模型；2.1.0 會把 effort 傳到 GPT-5.6。 |
382	| thinking/reasoning | 轉譯後可用 | GPT 使用 Responses reasoning，不是 Anthropic-native thinking semantics。 |
383	| Web Search、fast/auto mode、MCP tool search | 依 provider | 由 base-URL gateway 與 Copilot endpoint 能力決定；non-first-party tool search 可能需要額外 bridge/plugin。 |
384	| Ultrareview、Remote Control、Chrome、cloud Code Review、routines、web/mobile/Slack session | 不可以 | 這些需要 Claude.ai auth/cloud identity；local API gateway 無法取代。`ultrareview` 和 `ultracode` 無關。 |
385	
386	官方參考：[feature availability](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/feature-availability)、
387	[model configuration](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config)、
388	[gateway protocol](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/llm-gateway-protocol)、
389	[Ultrareview](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/ultrareview)。
390	
391	## 陷阱 (gotchas)（這些都花了實際 debug 時間）
392	
393	### `start` used to hang at "Resolving dependencies" behind a socks proxy
394	
395	（`start` 曾經卡在「Resolving dependencies」—— socks proxy 造成）
396	
397	**已修正**（runner 啟動時不再解析套件），但仍值得理解，因為它的失敗樣態極具誤導性 ——
398	而且在有 proxy 的機器上，任何其他用 `bunx` 的工具都會踩到同一個坑。
399	
400	`start` 以前跑的是 `bunx <pkg> start`，而 bunx **每次啟動都會重新解析套件**。
401	**bun 透過 socks `ALL_PROXY` 解析相依會無限期卡住** —— 但 `curl` 走同一個 proxy 連
402	registry 卻不到 0.5 秒就回來。所以每一項明顯的檢查都會過，沒有任何線索指向安裝程序。
403	你只會看到：
404	
405	```
406	copilot-proxy: did not come up in time — check 'copilot-proxy logs'.
407	$ copilot-proxy logs
408	nohup: ignoring input
409	Resolving dependencies
410	```
411	
412	有兩件事把「一次卡住」變成「永久卡死」：卡死的 `bun add` 會占住 bun 的**全域安裝快取鎖**，
413	所以下一次 `start` 也卡在那把鎖上；而 `start` 逾時後直接 return、沒有殺掉自己啟動的程序，
414	於是每重試一次就多留一個孤兒（實際上疊了 5 個），而且沒有任何一個綁上 port。
415	
416	現在 runner 會把釘選的套件**只安裝一次**到 `~/.local/share/copilot-api/pkg` 並直接執行該
417	binary，所以熱啟動完全不碰網路。安裝本身有 timeout 且逾時會被殺掉，先退回「拿掉 proxy」
418	的重試；若 Bun 明確回 `UNKNOWN_CERTIFICATE_VERIFICATION_ERROR`，最後再改用 npm 的 CA stack。
419	TLS 驗證仍保持開啟，這是在繞過已觀察到的 Bun/Node CA-store 差異，不是關閉憑證檢查。
420	注意這裡的 registry 是 npmmirror（國內鏡像，為了 GFW 速度設在 `~/.bunfig.toml`）
421	—— 把它繞進 proxy 一點好處也沒有，而那正是弄壞 bun 的原因。
422	
423	完整事後檢討與可 grep 的原始症狀：
424	[`pitfalls/copilot-proxy-start-hangs-at-resolving-dependencies.md`](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dotfiles/blob/main/pitfalls/copilot-proxy-start-hangs-at-resolving-dependencies.md)。
425	
426	### 模型清單只在啟動時抓一次 —— 直連被 geo-filter / 一次抓壞，整個 session 就毀了
427	
428	`copilot-api` 只在**行程啟動時**向 GitHub 抓一次 `/models`，然後快取整個生命週期。
429	有兩種看起來一樣的壞法：
430	
431	1. **Egress geo-filter（離開 TUN 後最常見）** — 同一組 token，直連／CN 出口 Claude = 0，
432	   走海外 Clash 節點 Claude = 8。Node / OpenCode **不讀** macOS System Proxy；以前
433	   Clash for Windows 的 TUN / Mixin 把所有 TCP 抓進去所以沒感覺，換成只有 System Proxy
434	   （Clash Verge）就會啟動成「沒有 Claude」的清單。預設 `COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=auto` 會在
435	   偵測到本機 proxy 時自動帶 `--proxy-env`。
436	2. **節點抖一下** — 那一次請求碰上壞 hop，快取成截斷清單。
437	
438	線索在啟動 banner：
439	
440	```
441	ℹ Models refresh: 13 new     ← 壞掉：底下的清單裡沒有任何 claude id
442	ℹ Models refresh: 21 new     ← 正常
443	```
444	
445	`copilot-proxy doctor` 會做 **直連 vs 走 proxy** 的上游 A/B，並對照代理已服務的清單，
446	避免再把 geo-filter 誤判成「組織停用 Claude」。完整說明：
447	[`pitfalls/copilot-api-caches-degraded-model-list-at-startup.md`](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dotfiles/blob/main/pitfalls/copilot-api-caches-degraded-model-list-at-startup.md)。
448	
449	### `settings.local.json` 的 env 蓋過 shell env（官方文件說法相反）
450	
451	實測確認（2026-07）：目前版本的 Claude Code 會讓 `./.claude/settings.local.json` 的
452	`env` 區塊 **蓋過繼承而來的 shell 環境變數** —— 跟官方 settings 文件暗示的順序相反。
453	後果：
454	
455	- `claude-copilot` / `copilot-run` **無法**改寫一個已經 `copilot-here on` 的專案
456	  （兩邊指向同一個代理時無害，指向不同時就會靜默地用錯設定）。
457	- 想透過 wrapper 試另一個代理／port，必須先 `copilot-here off`。
458	
459	### OpenAI 模型思考時整條線是靜默的 —— shim 用心跳把 socket 撐住
460	
461	`copilot-api` **不會**提早開啟 SSE stream：對 `:4141` 用 `gpt-5.6-sol` 實測，
462	response *headers* 在 8.11s 才到、第一個 body chunk 在 8.12s，也就是 reasoning
463	model 的整段思考時間都耗在同一個 `fetch()` 裡，線上一個 byte 都沒有。真正的
464	Anthropic stream 會用週期性的 `ping` event 蓋住這段，這個 gateway 一個都不送。
465	再加上 shim 的併發佇列（`COPILOT_SHIM_MAX`，預設 4 —— 第 5 個請求在完全靜默中
466	排隊），路徑上任何一個 idle timer 都可以合法回收一條其實健康的連線。agent 這端
467	不會收到錯誤、只會一直等，最後只能 Esc + `continue`。
468	
469	因此對「client 要求 streaming」的請求，shim 會在靜默達
470	`COPILOT_SHIM_PING_AFTER_MS` 後自己先 commit `text/event-stream` response，
471	並每 `COPILOT_SHIM_PING_MS` 送出 SSE *comment* frame
472	（`: copilot-shim keepalive`，符合規範的 parser 一律丟棄，所以對 Anthropic 與
473	OpenAI SDK 都是隱形的），直到真正的 bytes 出現 —— 排隊時間、思考時間、串流中途
474	的 reasoning 間隔都一併涵蓋。`COPILOT_SHIM_STALL_MS` 則替每次嘗試設上限：
475	headers 前卡死會 abort 並透明重試（此時 client 只收過 comment frame），
476	串流中途卡死則以真正的錯誤結束回應，而不是無限等待。
477	
478	| Env | 預設 | 意義 |
479	|---|---|---|
480	| `COPILOT_SHIM_PING_MS` | `15000` | 心跳間隔；`0` 關閉 |
481	| `COPILOT_SHIM_PING_AFTER_MS` | `10000` | 提早 commit SSE 前容忍的靜默時間 |
482	| `COPILOT_SHIM_STALL_MS` | `240000` | 判定上游卡死的靜默時間；`0` 關閉 |
483	
484	在 grace window 內回應的請求完全不受影響 —— 真正的 status code、真正的 headers ——
485	這正是讓快速失敗的 `400 model_not_supported`、`401 IDE token expired` 仍能正確
486	回報的原因。反面代價是：SSE response 一旦 commit，之後才出現的 non-2xx 只能以
487	SSE `error` event 送出，所以不要把 `COPILOT_SHIM_PING_AFTER_MS` 調成 0。
488	
489	FleetView 顯示 `0 tok` **不是**這個 bug 的證據 —— 那個計數器只在 agent 結束時才
490	回填。先去看 `agent-<id>.jsonl` 的 `assistant` 筆數有沒有在長。完整診斷：
491	[`pitfalls/copilot-proxy-openai-model-silent-stall.md`](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dotfiles/blob/main/pitfalls/copilot-proxy-openai-model-silent-stall.md)。
492	
493	### fork 沒有速率限制器
494	
495	fork 的 `start` 拿掉了 `--rate-limit`/`--wait`。它 README 給的緩解方式是改成減少
496	Claude Code 的背景雜訊 —— 那正是 `COPILOT_PROXY_QUIET=1` 注入的東西（這裡預設關閉；
497	我們優先保 UX 而不是 Copilot quota）。真的需要請求節流的話，退回原始套件：
498	`COPILOT_API_PKG=copilot-api@0.7.0`。
499	
500	### Context management 是轉譯，不是 Anthropic-native
501	
502	舊 fork 可能把 Claude Code 的 `context_management` 原樣送到會回 400 的 endpoint
503	（[caozhiyuan#305](https://github.com/caozhiyuan/copilot-api/issues/305)）。`2.1.0` 的
504	GPT-5.6 path 會壓掉這個不相容欄位，改依 Responses reasoning/context handling。這避開 400，
505	但不會完整重現 Anthropic 的 context editing 與 prompt-cache semantics；長 session 仍需觀察。
506	
507	### 不要使用 Claude Code 內建的 `/model` 選單
508	
509	它送出的是 Anthropic 的 *官方* 帶日期 id（例如 `claude-opus-4-8-YYYYMMDD`），會被 Copilot
510	後端拒絕：
511	
512	```
513	API Error: 400 {"error":{"message":"The requested model is not supported.",
514	"code":"model_not_supported", ...}}
515	```
516	
517	改用 `copilot-model` 釘選模型 —— 不帶日期的連字號 id（`claude-opus-4-8`）可以正常運作，
518	只有選單送出的帶日期 id 會失敗。
519	
520	### 點號 id 會造成「Opus 4 retired」警告與 >100% 的 context HUD
521	
522	歷史陷阱，已由連字號預設值修掉。使用 **點號** id（`claude-opus-4.8`，也就是舊版原始代理
523	唯一接受的形狀）時，Claude Code 無法對應到它內建的模型表，於是：
524	
525	- 顯示 `[Opus 4]` 並警告 *"Claude Opus 4 was retired"*（退回最接近的、已退役的名稱），且
526	- 假設 context window 是 **200k**，但 Copilot 實際上以 **1M** 提供 opus-5 / opus-4-8 /
527	  sonnet-5（`/v1/models` 裡的 `max_context_window_tokens: 1000000`）—— 所以 HUD/statusline
528	  的 context 可能顯示超過 100%，compaction 也會用錯誤的預算觸發。
529	
530	helper 會使用連字號 id，並依每個 live model 的 context metadata 自動加 `[1m]`；GPT id 也適用，
531	例如 `gpt-5.6-sol[1m]`。Claude Code 送出前會剝掉 suffix；raw API client 必須使用 plain id。
532	
533	### Token 陷阱：`gho_` vs `ghu_`
534	
535	有兩個不同的 GitHub token，且 **不可** 互換：
536	
537	| 來源 | 前綴 | `copilot_internal/v2/token` 交換 |
538	|---|---|---|
539	| OpenCode 儲存的 auth | `gho_` | **失敗 (404)** |
540	| `copilot-proxy auth`（裝置登入） | `ghu_` | **成功** |
541	
542	OpenCode 的 `gho_` token（OAuth App）只有在 *直接* 當 Bearer 打 `api.githubcopilot.com`
543	時能用；它無法完成 copilot-api 的傳統 token 交換步驟。**讓 `copilot-proxy auth` 產生它自己的
544	`ghu_` token —— 不要重用 OpenCode 的。** Token 儲存在
545	`~/.local/share/copilot-api/github_token`。
546	
547	## 可用模型與角色 discovery
548	
549	以 `GET /v1/models` 為 live truth：GitHub 會依帳號、組織政策、rollout 與 egress 改變 catalog。
550	Claude Code 現在有 Fable、Opus、Sonnet、Haiku 角色；`copilot-model --auto` 只會映射 catalog
551	裡實際存在的 id。`copilot-model -l` 顯示 raw served ids，`copilot-model -c` 顯示生效中的
552	角色 profile。不要複製帶日期的 Anthropic id，也不要手猜哪些模型有 1M context。
553	
554	## 實用指令
555	
556	```sh
557	claude-copilot                       # 一次性代理 session（specstory 包裝）
558	claude-copilot-once                  # 透過 settings.local.json pin 跑一次 session（自動還原）
559	copilot-here status                  # 這個專案有釘在代理上嗎？
560	copilot-model -c                     # 目前模型 + 來自哪一層
561	copilot-proxy status                 # 有沒有在跑？提供哪些 Claude 模型？
562	copilot-proxy whoami                 # 驗證 token → 帳號 / plan / quota
563	copilot-proxy logs 60                # tail 代理的 log
564	# 用量儀表板 (dashboard)（fork 已在本地內建）：
565	#   http://localhost:4141/usage-viewer?endpoint=http://localhost:4141/usage
566	```

1719	# --- specstory `-c` passthrough (why the base command must come from config) ---
1720	#
1721	# specstory's `-c/--command` REPLACES the provider's configured command — it does
1722	# NOT append to it. The shipped config says as much: "Use of these is equivalent
1723	# to -c \"custom command\"" — same slot, last write wins. So a hardcoded
1724	# `-c "claude $args"` silently drops every flag in `claude_cmd` the moment
1725	# claude-copilot has args to pass through, which made these two disagree:
1726	#
1727	#   claude-copilot-once             -> bypass-permissions  (no -c branch)
1728	#   claude-copilot-once --resume X  -> ~/.claude defaultMode "auto"
1729	#
1730	# Deriving the base command from the config keeps specstory the single source of
1731	# truth for BOTH branches. `--no-specstory` deliberately does NOT inherit it.
1732	
1733	# Effective `claude_cmd`, honouring specstory's own precedence:
1734	#   project ./.specstory/cli/config.toml > user ~/.specstory/cli/config.toml > `claude`
1735	# Matches UNCOMMENTED assignments only — both shipped configs carry a commented
1736	# `# claude_cmd = "claude"` example, and matching that would re-introduce the very
1737	# bug this exists to fix. Handles TOML's double- and single-quoted strings.
1738	function script:Get-SpecstoryClaudeCmd {
1739	    foreach ($f in '.specstory/cli/config.toml', (Join-Path $HOME '.specstory/cli/config.toml')) {
1740	        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f)) { continue }
1741	        foreach ($line in (Get-Content -LiteralPath $f -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
1742	            if ($line -match '^\s*claude_cmd\s*=\s*(?:"([^"]*)"|''([^'']*)'')') {
1743	                $v = if ($Matches[1]) { $Matches[1] } else { $Matches[2] }
1744	                if ($v) { return $v }
1745	            }
1746	        }
1747	    }
1748	    'claude'
1749	}
1750	
1751	# Single-quote ONE argument for embedding in specstory's `-c` command STRING.
1752	# specstory shell-splits that string honouring quotes, so quoting is both possible
1753	# and necessary — an unquoted join flattens `-p "two words"` into two arguments.
1754	# POSIX escape for an embedded quote: close, \', reopen.
1755	function script:ConvertTo-CopilotShQuote {
1756	    param([string] $Value)
1757	    "'" + ($Value -replace "'", "'\''") + "'"
1758	}

1762	    [CmdletBinding()]
1763	    param([Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments)] [string[]] $Argv)
1764	    $ss = 'auto'
1765	    if ($Argv -and $Argv[0] -eq '--no-specstory') { $ss = 'never'; $Argv = $Argv[1..($Argv.Count - 1)] }
1766	    elseif ($Argv -and $Argv[0] -eq '--specstory') { $Argv = $Argv[1..($Argv.Count - 1)] }
1767	    elseif ($Argv -and $Argv[0] -in '-h', '--help') {
1768	        Write-Host "Usage: claude-copilot [--no-specstory] [claude args...]"
1769	        Write-Host "  One-off Claude Code session on the Copilot proxy. Sticky: copilot-here on"
1770	        Write-Host "  Runs claude with --dangerously-skip-permissions (hands-off proxy flow)."

1840	function script:Confirm-CopilotAction {
1841	    param([string] $Message = 'Proceed? [y/N]')
1842	    if (-not [Environment]::UserInteractive -or [Console]::IsInputRedirected) { return $false }
1843	    $ans = Read-Host -Prompt $Message
1844	    $ans -match '^\s*y(es)?\s*$'

1847	# Has THIS project's copilot-here pin drifted from what `copilot-here on` would
1848	# write now (default model bumped, proxy moved, a key added since the pin was
1849	# written)? Returns one "  KEY : old -> new" line per drifted key, or nothing.
1850	#
1851	# Drift is defined as "the set of keys `copilot-here on` would actually CHANGE",
1852	# computed by diffing the live file against Get-CopilotEnvBlock — not a hand-picked
1853	# subset (that is how three keys silently went unchecked). The asymmetry is
1854	# deliberate: keys present in the file but absent from the want-set are NOT drift,
1855	# because `on` merges and never removes them (only `off` does).
1856	function script:Get-CopilotHereDrift {
1857	    $settings = '.claude/settings.local.json'
1858	    if (-not (Test-Path $settings)) { return @() }
1859	    try { $obj = Get-Content -Raw $settings | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { return @() }
1860	    # ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL is only set while the pin is ON — absent -> nothing to do.
1861	    if (-not $obj.env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL) { return @() }
1862	
1863	    $want = Get-CopilotEnvBlock -Pinned
1864	    $out = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
1865	    foreach ($k in $want.Keys) {
1866	        $cur = if ($obj.env.PSObject.Properties[$k]) { $obj.env.$k } else { '(unset)' }
1867	        if ($cur -ne $want[$k]) { $out.Add("  $k : $cur -> $($want[$k])") }
1868	    }
1869	    $out
1870	}

1872	function copilot-here {
1873	    [CmdletBinding()]
1874	    param([Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments)] [string[]] $Argv)
1875	    $settings = '.claude/settings.local.json'
1876	    $action = if ($Argv -and $Argv.Count -ge 1) { $Argv[0] } else { 'status' }
1877	    switch ($action) {
1878	        'on' {
1879	            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path '.claude' | Out-Null
1880	            $obj = if (Test-Path $settings) { try { Get-Content -Raw $settings | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { [pscustomobject]@{} } } else { [pscustomobject]@{} }
1881	            if (-not $obj.PSObject.Properties['env']) { $obj | Add-Member -NotePropertyName env -NotePropertyValue ([pscustomobject]@{}) }
1882	            # Single source of truth, shared with copilot-run and the drift check.
1883	            $envSet = Get-CopilotEnvBlock -Pinned
1884	            $model = $envSet.ANTHROPIC_MODEL
1885	            foreach ($k in $envSet.Keys) {
1886	                if ($obj.env.PSObject.Properties[$k]) { $obj.env.$k = $envSet[$k] }
1887	                else { $obj.env | Add-Member -NotePropertyName $k -NotePropertyValue $envSet[$k] }
1888	            }
1889	            $obj | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $settings -Encoding utf8
1890	            # Belt-and-braces gitignore via .git/info/exclude (un-anchored **/ form).
1891	            $gitDir = git rev-parse --git-dir 2>$null
1892	            if ($gitDir) {
1893	                git check-ignore -q $settings 2>$null
1894	                if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
1895	                    $exclude = Join-Path $gitDir 'info/exclude'
1896	                    Add-Content -Path $exclude -Value '**/.claude/settings.local.json'
1897	                }
1898	            }
1899	            Write-Host "copilot-here: ON — $settings pins Claude Code to $(Get-CopilotBase) (model: $model)"
1900	            if (-not (Test-CopilotAlive)) { Write-Host "  WARNING proxy not running — start it: copilot-proxy start" }
1901	        }
1902	        'off' {
1903	            if (-not (Test-Path $settings)) { Write-Host "copilot-here: already off (no $settings)"; return }
1904	            try { $obj = Get-Content -Raw $settings | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { Write-Error "copilot-here: $settings is not valid JSON"; return }
1905	            if ($obj.env) {
1906	                foreach ($k in $script:CopilotHereKeys) { if ($obj.env.PSObject.Properties[$k]) { $obj.env.PSObject.Properties.Remove($k) } }
1907	                if (-not $obj.env.PSObject.Properties) { $obj.PSObject.Properties.Remove('env') }
1908	            }
1909	            if (-not $obj.PSObject.Properties.Name) {
1910	                Remove-Item $settings -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
1911	                Write-Host "copilot-here: OFF — removed $settings (it held only proxy config)"
1912	            } else {
1913	                $obj | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $settings -Encoding utf8
1914	                Write-Host "copilot-here: OFF — proxy env removed from $settings (other content kept)"
1915	            }
1916	        }
1917	        'status' {
1918	            if (Test-Path $settings) {
1919	                try { $obj = Get-Content -Raw $settings | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { $obj = $null }
1920	                if ($obj.env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL) {
1921	                    Write-Host "copilot-here: ON  (base: $($obj.env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL), model: $($obj.env.ANTHROPIC_MODEL))"
1922	                    $drift = Get-CopilotHereDrift
1923	                    if ($drift) {
1924	                        Write-Host '  ! stale vs current defaults:'
1925	                        $drift | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ }
1926	                        Write-Host '  refresh in place: copilot-here on'
1927	                    }
1928	                    if (-not (Test-CopilotAlive)) { Write-Host "  WARNING proxy not running — start it: copilot-proxy start" }
1929	                    return
1930	                }
1931	            }
1932	            Write-Host "copilot-here: off  (enable: copilot-here on; one-off: claude-copilot)"
1933	        }
1934	        default { Write-Host "Usage: copilot-here [on|off|status]" }
1935	    }
1936	}

1938	# Pick the best raw served id for the main Claude Code model. Claude remains the
1939	# first choice when entitled. Without Claude, rank OpenAI by capability tier and
1940	# deliberately place lightweight Luna behind older flagship/coding tiers.
1941	function script:Select-CopilotBestModel {
1942	    param([string[]] $Model)
1943	    if (-not $Model -or $Model.Count -eq 0) { return $null }
1944	    $Model = @($Model | ForEach-Object { Remove-CopilotContextHint $_ } | Sort-Object -Unique)
1945	
1946	    foreach ($preferred in 'claude-fable-5',
1947	                           'claude-opus-5', 'claude-opus-4-8', 'claude-opus-4-7', 'claude-opus-4-6',
1948	                           'claude-sonnet-5', 'claude-sonnet-4-6', 'claude-sonnet-4-5',
1949	                           'claude-opus-4-5', 'claude-haiku-4-5') {
1950	        if ($Model -contains $preferred) { return $preferred }
1951	    }
1952	    $pick = { param($re, $exclude)
1953	        $c = @($Model | Where-Object { $_ -match $re -and (-not $exclude -or $_ -notmatch $exclude) } | Sort-Object)
1954	        if ($c.Count -gt 0) { $c[-1] } else { $null }
1955	    }
1956	    $r = & $pick '^claude-' $null
1957	    if ($r) { return $r }
1958	
1959	    foreach ($preferred in 'gpt-5.6-sol', 'gpt-5.6-terra', 'gpt-5.5', 'gpt-5.4', 'gpt-5.3-codex') {
1960	        if ($Model -contains $preferred) { return $preferred }
1961	    }
1962	
1963	    foreach ($try in @(@('^gpt-', 'mini|nano|luna'), @('codex', $null))) {
1964	        $r = & $pick $try[0] $try[1]
1965	        if ($r) { return $r }
1966	    }
1967	
1968	    foreach ($preferred in 'gpt-5.6-luna', 'gpt-5.4-mini', 'gpt-5-mini') {
1969	        if ($Model -contains $preferred) { return $preferred }
1970	    }
1971	
1972	    foreach ($try in @(@('^gpt-', $null), @('^gemini-', 'flash'), @('^gemini-', $null))) {
1973	        $r = & $pick $try[0] $try[1]
1974	        if ($r) { return $r }
1975	    }
1976	    (@($Model | Sort-Object))[-1]
1977	}

2110	function copilot-embed {
2111	    [CmdletBinding()]
2112	    param([Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments)] [string[]] $Argv)
2113	    $model = if ($env:AICAP_EMBED_MODEL) { $env:AICAP_EMBED_MODEL } else { 'text-embedding-3-small' }
2114	    $wantJson = $false; $doList = $false
2115	    $rest = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
2116	    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $Argv.Count; $i++) {
2117	        switch -Regex ($Argv[$i]) {
2118	            '^(-m|--model)$' { $model = $Argv[++$i] }
2119	            '^--model=' { $model = $Argv[$i] -replace '^--model=', '' }
2120	            '^--json$' { $wantJson = $true }
2121	            '^(-l|--list)$' { $doList = $true }
2122	            '^(-h|--help)$' { Write-Host "Usage: copilot-embed [--model M] [--json] [TEXT | -]`n       copilot-embed -l"; return }
2123	            default { $rest.Add($Argv[$i]) }
2124	        }
2125	    }
2126	    if (-not (Test-CopilotAlive)) { copilot-proxy start; if (-not (Test-CopilotAlive)) { return } }
2127	
2128	    if ($doList) {
2129	        try { (Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$(Get-CopilotBase)/v1/models" -TimeoutSec 3).data.id | Where-Object { $_ -match 'embed' } | Sort-Object } catch { $null = $_ }
2130	        return
2131	    }
2132	
2133	    $text = if ($rest.Count -gt 0 -and $rest[0] -ne '-') { $rest -join ' ' } elseif (-not [Console]::IsInputRedirected) { Write-Error "copilot-embed: no text — pass an arg or pipe stdin"; return } else { [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() }
2134	    if (-not $text) { Write-Error "copilot-embed: empty input"; return }
2135	
2136	    # input MUST be an array (scalar 400s — fork issue #100).
2137	    $payload = if ($model) { @{ model = $model; input = @($text) } } else { @{ input = @($text) } }
2138	    try {
2139	        $resp = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$(Get-CopilotBase)/v1/embeddings" -Method Post -ContentType 'application/json' `
2140	            -Body ($payload | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5) -TimeoutSec 60 -ErrorAction Stop
2141	    } catch { Write-Error "copilot-embed: request failed — is the proxy up? ($_)"; return }
2142	
2143	    if ($wantJson) { $resp | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8; return }
2144	    $vec = $resp.data[0].embedding
2145	    if (-not $vec) { Write-Error "copilot-embed: empty embedding"; return }
2146	    $vec | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
