```text
1	# copilot-proxy
2	
3	A native PowerShell port of the `copilot-proxy` tool series. It runs the
4	[`@jeffreycao/copilot-api`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@jeffreycao/copilot-api)
5	fork so a **GitHub Copilot subscription** can back **Claude Code** and other
6	Anthropic/OpenAI-compatible clients.
7	
8	The module is deployed to `~/.config/powershell/modules/Copilot` and imported by
9	the PowerShell profile. It requires Bun, Node/npm and a Copilot subscription.
10	
11	## Commands
12	
13	| Command | What it does |
14	|---|---|
15	| `copilot-proxy auth` | one-time GitHub device login (`copilot-api auth login --provider copilot`; stores but does not display the token) |
16	| `copilot-proxy start` / `stop` / `restart` | manage the local proxy (port 4141) |
17	| `copilot-proxy status` | show raw served count and Claude availability |
18	| `copilot-proxy doctor [--live]` | diagnose package, auth, proxy, catalog, roles, upstream and Codex Apps |
19	| `copilot-proxy logs [N]` | tail the proxy log |
20	| `copilot-proxy shim [on\|off]` | toggle the throttle shim (port 4142) |
21	| `copilot-proxy whoami` | account / plan / quota |
22	| `copilot-proxy reinstall` | wipe and reinstall the pinned package |
23	| `copilot-run <cmd...>` | run a command with the proxy env injected |
24	| `claude-copilot` | one-off Claude Code session on the proxy |
25	| `claude-copilot-once` | pin this project, run once, then restore it |
26	| `codex-copilot` / `codex-copilot-once` | zero-persistence Codex session on the Responses proxy |
27	| `copilot-here [on\|off\|status]` | sticky project pin in `.claude/settings.local.json` |
28	| `copilot-model [<id>\|-l\|-c\|--auto]` | switch or inspect the complete role profile |
29	| `copilot-embed [TEXT\|-]` | embed text through `/v1/embeddings` |
30	| `semsearch index \| <QUERY>` | semantic search over local text |
31	
32	## Quick start
33	
34	```powershell
35	copilot-proxy auth                 # once
36	copilot-proxy start
37	copilot-model --auto              # select from the live catalog
38	copilot-model -c                   # inspect Main/Fable/Opus/Sonnet/Haiku
39	copilot-here on                    # sticky project; or use claude-copilot-once
40	codex-copilot                     # Codex; live OpenAI-first model selection
41	```
42	
43	Existing global and project pins are deliberately not migrated by `chezmoi
44	apply`. Run `copilot-model --auto` once after this upgrade. When `copilot-here`
45	is active, that command refreshes the local role set; otherwise it updates the
46	global one-line main-model state.
47	
48	## How routing works
49	
50	```text
51	Claude Code --Anthropic /v1/messages--> copilot-api (localhost:4141)
52	                                          | Claude: native Messages path
53	                                          | GPT: Anthropic -> Responses translation
54	                                          v
55	                                  GitHub Copilot API
56	```
57	
58	The default package is `@jeffreycao/copilot-api@2.1.0`. For GPT ids it translates
59	Claude Code requests to Responses, including `output_config.effort` to
60	`reasoning.effort`. This is required for GPT-5.6 and Claude Code's `ultracode`
61	effort setting; the old `1.13.14` path could replace the requested effort with a
62	hard-coded fallback.
63	
64	The package is installed once under `~/.local/share/copilot-api/pkg`. Windows
65	uses `npm.cmd` first because it understands the Azure Artifacts credential
66	provider in `~/.npmrc`; Bun remains the fallback/runtime. Readiness is based on
67	the installed `package.json` name/version, a verified stamp, and a runnable launch
68	path—not merely an old directory or binlink. A failed install cannot restamp or
69	launch stale package contents. `COPILOT_API_PKG` accepts registry package specs
70	(name or `@scope/name` with an optional version/tag/range); npm aliases and
71	local/git/URL specs are rejected before filesystem cleanup. Warm starts do no
72	package network work.
73	
74	On a corporate mirror, `ETARGET` can mean the exact public version has not synced
75	yet. Check the registry that npm is actually using before deleting the working
76	prefix:
77	
78	```powershell
79	npm config get registry
80	npm view '@jeffreycao/copilot-api@2.1.0' version
81	# Optional comparison where direct public npm is permitted:
82	npm view '@jeffreycao/copilot-api@2.1.0' version --registry https://registry.npmjs.org/
83	```
84	
85	If only the configured mirror is missing the version, wait/request mirror sync or
86	use an approved registry for `copilot-proxy reinstall`. The Windows module also
87	falls back automatically to the exact 2.1.0 runtime files on jsDelivr, verifies a
88	baked SHA-256 for every file, then resolves only its ordinary dependencies through
89	the configured npm registry. This handles a lagging mirror without weakening the
90	pin or bypassing the approved feed for the dependency tree. Do not replace the
91	tested exact pin with `latest`.
92	
93	## Model selection and role profile
94	
95	`copilot-model --auto` requires the live `/v1/models` catalog. It prefers served
96	Claude families (`Fable > Opus > Sonnet > Haiku`), then ranks OpenAI by capability:
97	
98	```text
99	Sol > Terra > GPT-5.5 > GPT-5.4 > GPT-5.3 Codex > Luna > mini > Gemini
100	```
101	
102	Luna follows the older flagships because it is the lightweight tier. This role
103	intent follows OpenAI's [current model guidance](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/latest-model).
104	For the normal Claude-less Copilot catalog, the generated profile is:
105	
106	| Claude Code role | Copilot model |
107	|---|---|
108	| Main / Fable / Opus | `gpt-5.6-sol` |
109	| Sonnet | `gpt-5.6-terra` |
110	| Haiku / background / legacy small-fast | `gpt-5.6-luna` |
111	
112	A manually selected OpenAI main remains Main/Fable/Opus; Terra and Luna are used
113	for the lower roles when served. Missing tiers fall back to the selected main,
114	never to an unserved hard-coded id. Native Claude profiles select the strongest
115	served model in each Claude family.
116	
117	The `[1m]` suffix is a Claude Code-only context hint. It is derived from each
118	model's live `max_context_window_tokens` metadata when the value is at least one
119	million. Raw API clients must use the plain id. Offline manual discovery remains
120	available, but offline `--auto` refuses to write a potentially stale pin.
121	
122	Both `copilot-run` and `copilot-here on` inject the same variables:
123	
124	```text
125	ANTHROPIC_MODEL
126	ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL
127	ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL
128	ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL
129	ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL
130	ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL
131	```
132	
133	`CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL` is intentionally left unset so workflow/frontmatter
134	routing remains authoritative. Restart Claude Code after changing the profile.
135	
136	## Claude Code feature compatibility
137	
138	The useful boundary is local orchestration versus Anthropic cloud services:
139	
140	| Feature | Through Copilot + GPT | Notes |
141	|---|---|---|
142	| CLI, tools, hooks, skills, memory, plugins, MCP, checkpoints, sandboxing | Yes | Local Claude Code features; GPT behavior may differ after prompt/tool translation. |
143	| Subagents and dynamic workflows | Yes | Role variables are provided without overriding workflow-specific subagent routing. See [workflows](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/workflows). |
144	| `ultracode` | Yes on 2.1.0 | It is xhigh effort plus dynamic workflows, not a separate model. |
145	| Thinking/reasoning | Translated | GPT uses Responses reasoning rather than Anthropic-native thinking semantics. |
146	| Web search, fast/auto mode, MCP tool search | Provider-dependent | Availability depends on the Copilot endpoint and gateway translation. |
147	| Ultrareview, Remote Control, Chrome, cloud Code Review, routines, web/mobile/Slack sessions | No | These require Claude.ai authentication/cloud identity; a local API gateway cannot provide it. |
148	
149	See Claude Code's [feature availability](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/feature-availability),
150	[model configuration](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config),
151	[gateway protocol](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/llm-gateway-protocol), and
152	[Ultrareview](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/ultrareview) references.
153	
154	## Network, entitlement and diagnostics
155	
156	- `COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=auto` reads the Windows System Proxy or an explicit proxy
157	  environment variable, scopes it to the child and passes `--proxy-env`. Node
158	  otherwise ignores the WinINET system setting.
159	- The proxy refreshes its model cache periodically; a restart forces an immediate
160	  refresh. `COPILOT_PROXY_START_TIMEOUT` defaults to 45 seconds because a
161	  Clash/mihomo hop can make the initial refresh exceed the old 20-second budget.
162	- GitHub can vary the catalog by account, organization policy, rollout and egress.
163	  Claude IDs in `/v1/models` are therefore **advertised aliases**, not proof that
164	  inference is authorized. No Claude IDs is not by itself a broken proxy; use
165	  `copilot-model --auto` when you explicitly want to select another served pin.
166	  There is no automatic Claude-to-OpenAI replay after a failed request.
167	- `copilot-proxy doctor` compares direct and proxied upstream catalogs, validates
168	  the main model plus every role alias, and reports stale local pins. `--live`
169	  also compares direct/proxied reachability of remote ChatGPT `codex_apps`, then
170	  sends one real request to the effective configured main model (or a clearly
171	  labeled catalog fallback when that pin is absent). It never retries another
172	  model. Only this inference request consumes quota; timeout and TLS failures are
173	  reported separately.
174	- HTTP 402 with `billing_not_configured` is account-wide and nonretryable. Select
175	  an organization or enterprise under **Usage billed to** at
176	  <https://github.com/settings/copilot/features>. Model changes,
177	  `copilot-model --auto`, and shim toggles cannot repair that account setting.
178	- `copilot-here` writes only the gitignored `.claude/settings.local.json`, never
179	  committed project settings. `off` removes every env key owned by the helper and
180	  preserves unrelated settings.
181	- `claude-copilot` and `claude-copilot-once` retain the Windows port's trusted
182	  `--dangerously-skip-permissions` and optional SpecStory behavior. Plain `claude`
183	  is unaffected.
184	- The throttle shim remains byte-identical to the macOS/Linux copy and retries
185	  transient 403/429 bursts while limiting concurrent requests. It deliberately
186	  passes HTTP 402 through once; billing configuration is not a throttle failure.
187	
188	State lives under `~/.local/state/copilot-proxy/`; device login stores the GitHub
189	token at `~/.local/share/copilot-api/github_token` without printing it by default.
190	
191	## Codex through the gateway
192	
193	`codex-copilot` and its identical `codex-copilot-once` alias start the local
194	gateway/shim and pass a `copilot_api` Responses provider through one-invocation
195	Codex `-c` overrides. They do not edit user or project Codex config, so plain
196	`codex` is unaffected. An explicit `-m` / `--model` wins; otherwise the live raw
197	catalog is ranked OpenAI/Codex first (`Sol > Terra > GPT-5.5 > GPT-5.4 > GPT-5.3
198	Codex > Luna > mini`), then Claude, Gemini and other chat models. Disabled and
199	embedding models are excluded.
200	
201	Codex always uses the shim on `localhost:4142`, even when the persisted
202	throttling toggle is off. Besides throttling, that boundary normalizes blank
203	descriptions in Codex `mcp_list_tools` Responses items. GitHub Copilot rejects
204	those with `Invalid 'input[0].tools[0].description': empty string`, while MCP
205	servers and the native Codex path may omit them. The shim fills only those tool
206	definition fields and leaves prompts, schemas, and tool names unchanged.
207	Codex currently zstd-compresses these requests; the shim decodes only the
208	Responses body it must repair, forwards ordinary JSON, and removes the stale
209	`content-encoding` header.
210	
211	This is a separate picker from Claude Code's `copilot-model --auto`: that path
212	remains Claude-first, while only the Codex launcher is OpenAI-first.
213	
214	SpecStory is automatic when installed. The wrapper preserves the effective
215	`codex_cmd` (project config > user config > bare `codex`) before appending
216	provider/model/user arguments; `--no-specstory` runs Codex directly. Claude and
217	Gemini fallback through Responses Lite, which does not support Responses
218	`tool_search`, so native Responses OpenAI models stay ahead of Anthropic.
219	The launcher also enables gateway-backed remote compaction and excludes the
220	`mcp__codex_apps__sites` namespace that depends on unavailable `tool_search`;
221	later explicit `-c` arguments can override either setting per invocation.
222	
223	`codex_apps` itself is not a localhost service and not an Apple-Silicon-only
224	Codex Desktop bridge. It is a remote MCP at
225	`https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/apps`, so startup can fail even while
226	Copilot inference on `localhost:4142` works. Keep Apps enabled and use
227	`copilot-proxy doctor --live` to diagnose that route independently.
228	
229	There is deliberately no Codex equivalent of `copilot-here`: project
230	`.codex/config.toml` cannot override provider definitions, provider selection or
231	auth metadata. The explicit launcher provides project/session scope without
232	changing the user-wide default.
233	
234	### Experimental direct configuration
235	
236	The direct `model_providers.copilot-enterprise` example is documented in the
237	macOS/Linux guide rather than installed. It is not the localhost proxy path, and
238	the pasted `gh auth token` flow is not portable: on the tested EMU account it
239	returned `421`/`403`, while the credential stored by `copilot-proxy auth` plus
240	the normal short-lived Copilot token exchange worked. The supported launcher
241	therefore uses the authenticated local gateway.
242
```

184	description。MCP server 與原生 Codex path 可以省略描述，但 GitHub Copilot 會以
185	`Invalid 'input[0].tools[0].description': empty string` 拒絕請求。shim 只補這些
186	tool definition 欄位，不改 prompt、schema 或 tool name。
187	目前 Codex 會以 zstd 壓縮這些請求；shim 只解壓需要修補的 Responses body，改以
188	普通 JSON 轉送，並移除已不適用的 `content-encoding` header。
189	
190	這是與 Claude Code `copilot-model --auto` 分開的 picker：後者保持
191	Claude-first，只有 Codex launcher 是 OpenAI-first。
192	
193	有安裝 SpecStory 時自動整合。Wrapper 會保留生效的 `codex_cmd`（project config >
194	user config > 裸 `codex`），再附加 provider/model/user arguments；
195	`--no-specstory` 直接執行 Codex。Claude/Gemini fallback 經 Responses Lite，不支援
196	Responses `tool_search`，因此 native Responses OpenAI models 排在 Anthropic 前。
197	Launcher 也會啟用 gateway-backed remote compaction，並排除依賴不可用
198	`tool_search` 的 `mcp__codex_apps__sites` namespace；後續明確傳入的 `-c`
199	仍可在單次呼叫覆寫這兩項。
200	
201	`codex_apps` 本身不是 localhost service，也不是 Apple-Silicon-only Codex Desktop
202	bridge；它是 `https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/apps` 的遠端 MCP。因此即使
203	`localhost:4142` inference 正常，它仍可能啟動失敗。保留 Apps 啟用，並以
204	`copilot-proxy doctor --live` 獨立診斷這條路由。
205	
206	刻意不做 Codex 版 `copilot-here`：project `.codex/config.toml` 不能覆寫 provider
207	definition、provider selection 或 auth metadata。顯式 launcher 能提供 project/session
208	scope，同時不改 user-wide default。
209	
210	### 實驗性 direct 設定
211	
212	Direct `model_providers.copilot-enterprise` 範例只記錄在 macOS/Linux 完整指南，
213	不會安裝。它不是 localhost proxy 路徑，而且貼文中的 `gh auth token` flow 不具可攜性：
214	本次 EMU 帳號實測回 `421`/`403`；`copilot-proxy auth` 保存的 credential 加正常短效
215	Copilot token exchange 則可用。因此正式 launcher 使用已認證的本機 gateway。

1	# copilot-proxy global apply mode for Claude Code and Codex
2	
3	**Status**: deferred (2026-08-12)
4	**Effort**: L
5	**Related**: `TODO.md` · `dot_config/powershell/modules/Copilot/Copilot.psm1`
6	
7	## Context
8	
9	A user-wide mode would make ordinary `claude` and `codex` convenient, but also
10	couple both to a local daemon and mutate runtime-owned settings. Today the
11	one-shot launchers are intentionally zero-persistence.
12	
13	## Investigation
14	
15	Proposed command: `copilot-global on|off|status claude|codex|all`. `on` must
16	require a healthy login-start supervisor, snapshot exact files/keys with hashes,
17	write validated temp files atomically, and mark ownership. Claude receives the
18	full role profile; Codex preserves all unrelated TOML. `off` restores exactly
19	but stops on manual drift. Operations must be idempotent and crash-safe.
20	
21	Test fresh/existing config, repeated cycles, interruption between stages,
22	malformed input, manual drift, state migration, and supervised-proxy failure.
23	Keep the Windows implementation native PowerShell.
24	
25	## Options considered
26	
27	| Option | Pros | Cons |
28	|---|---|---|
29	| Keep one-shot/project launchers | Safe and shipped | Repeated opt-in |
30	| Chezmoi-managed permanent provider | Declarative | Fights runtime state; dead-daemon risk |
31	| Stateful global switch | Good UX with exact restore | Requires supervisor, transactions and ownership semantics |
32	
33	## Current blocker / open questions
34	
35	Windows has no login-start, auto-restarting proxy supervisor yet. A global
36	config without that prerequisite can strand both CLIs after reboot.
37	
38	## Decision (if any)
39	
40	2026-08-12 deferred. Keep one-shot launchers as the supported path; implement
41	only after supervisor/service work lands on both platforms.
42	
43	## References
44	
45	- `docs/copilot-proxy.md`
46	- Parent repo: `backlog/copilot-proxy-global-apply-mode.md`
47

1559	    -h|--help)
1560	      printf '%s\n' "Usage: claude-copilot [--no-specstory] [claude args...]"
1561	      printf '%s\n' "  One-off Claude Code session on the Copilot proxy (no file writes)."
1562	      printf '%s\n' "  Sticky per-project instead: copilot-here on"
1563	      return 0 ;;
1564	  esac
1565	  if [ "$ss" = "auto" ] && command -v specstory >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1566	    if [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; then
1567	      # Rebuild what `-c` clobbers: the configured base command (ITS flags left
1568	      # unquoted so specstory splits them normally) + each of our args quoted.
1569	      local _cc_cmd _cc_arg
1570	      _cc_cmd="$(_copilot_specstory_claude_cmd)"
1571	      for _cc_arg in "$@"; do
1572	        _cc_cmd="$_cc_cmd $(_copilot_shquote "$_cc_arg")"
1573	      done
1574	      copilot-run specstory run claude -c "$_cc_cmd"
1575	    else
1576	      copilot-run specstory run claude
1577	    fi
1578	  else
1579	    copilot-run claude "$@"
1580	  fi
1581	}
1582	
1583	# --- per-project toggle (Layer 2: sticky, gitignored settings.local.json) --------
1584	
1585	# Env keys we own in .claude/settings.local.json (kept in one place so `off`
1586	# removes exactly what `on` added — including the COPILOT_PROXY_QUIET extras,
1587	# regardless of the knob's value at `off` time).
1588	_copilot_here_keys='["ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL","ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN","ANTHROPIC_MODEL","ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL","ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL","ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL","ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL","ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL","CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC","CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER","CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_PROMPT_SUGGESTION","CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AWAY_SUMMARY","DISABLE_NON_ESSENTIAL_MODEL_CALLS"]'
1589	
1590	# The EXACT env object `copilot-here on` would write right now, as JSON.
1591	#
1592	# SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for both `copilot-here on` (what it merges in) and
1593	# _copilot_here_drift (what it compares against). These were two hand-maintained
1594	# copies and they had already diverged: `on` wrote 8 keys while the drift check
1595	# compared only 4, so a pin written by an older `on` — current models but no
1596	# ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL / ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL /
1597	# CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC — reported "no drift" while `on`
1598	# would still have changed it. Add a key here and BOTH sides follow.
1599	#
1600	# Needs jq; every caller already requires it.
1601	_copilot_env_json_for_model() {
1602	  local selected="$1" catalog="${2:-}" profile
1603	  if [ "$#" -ge 2 ]; then
1604	    profile="$(_copilot_model_profile_json "$selected" "$catalog")" || return 1
1605	  else
1606	    profile="$(_copilot_model_profile_json "$selected")" || return 1
1607	  fi
1608	  jq -n \
1609	    --arg base_url "$(_copilot_pinned_base)" \
1610	    --argjson profile "$profile" \
1611	    --arg quiet "${COPILOT_PROXY_QUIET:-0}" '
1612	    {
1613	      ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL: $base_url,
1614	      ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN: "dummy",
1615	      ANTHROPIC_MODEL: $profile.main,
1616	      ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL: $profile.fable,
1617	      ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL: $profile.opus,
1618	      ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL: $profile.sonnet,
1619	      ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL: $profile.haiku,
1620	      ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL: $profile.haiku,
1621	      CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC: "1"
1622	    } + (if $quiet == "1" then {
1623	      CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER: "0",
1624	      CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_PROMPT_SUGGESTION: "false",
1625	      CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AWAY_SUMMARY: "0",
1626	      DISABLE_NON_ESSENTIAL_MODEL_CALLS: "1"
1627	    } else {} end)'
1628	}
1629	
1630	_copilot_env_json() {
1631	  _copilot_env_json_for_model "$(_copilot_default_model)"
1632	}
1633	
1634	# Pin THIS project to the Copilot proxy via ./.claude/settings.local.json —
1635	# the gitignored local layer that overrides the committed .claude/settings.json
1636	# (so claude-plans-here's plansDirectory stays untouched). Plain `claude` then
1637	# uses the proxy here until `copilot-here off`.
1638	# Example:
1639	#   copilot-here on        # pin project to the proxy
1640	#   copilot-here status    # pinned? which model?
1641	#   copilot-here off       # unpin (removes only our env keys)
1642	copilot-here() {
1643	  if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1644	    printf '%s\n' "copilot-here: jq is required" >&2; return 1
1645	  fi
1646	
1647	  local settings=".claude/settings.local.json"
1648	  local action="${1:-status}"
1649	  case "$action" in
1650	    on)
1651	      command mkdir -p .claude
1652	      local base='{}'
1653	      [ -f "$settings" ] && base="$(command cat "$settings")"
1654	      [ -n "$base" ] || base='{}'
1655	      local base_url model want_env
1656	      want_env="$(_copilot_env_json)" || return 1
1657	      base_url="$(printf '%s' "$want_env" | jq -r '.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL')"
1658	      model="$(printf '%s' "$want_env" | jq -r '.ANTHROPIC_MODEL')"
1659	      local tmp; tmp="$(command mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/copilot-here.XXXXXX")" || return 1
1660	      if printf '%s' "$base" | jq --argjson want "$want_env" \
1661	          '.env = ((.env // {}) + $want)' >"$tmp"; then
1662	        command mv -- "$tmp" "$settings"
1663	      else
1664	        command rm -f -- "$tmp"
1665	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-here: jq failed; $settings unchanged" >&2
1666	        return 1
1667	      fi
1668	      # Claude Code only auto-gitignores settings.local.json when IT creates the
1669	      # file — since we created it, belt-and-braces via .git/info/exclude (a
1670	      # per-clone, never-committed ignore, so the proxy toggle leaves nothing to
1671	      # commit — unlike Claude Code's own root-.gitignore entry).
1672	      if command git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1673	        if ! command git check-ignore -q "$settings" 2>/dev/null; then
1674	          local exclude; exclude="$(command git rev-parse --git-dir)/info/exclude"
1675	          # MUST be the un-anchored **/ form, NOT a bare .claude/settings.local.json:
1676	          # a pattern with an internal slash is anchored to the repo ROOT, so it
1677	          # would not ignore the file when THIS project lives in a subdirectory of
1678	          # a larger repo (e.g. skills/foo/.claude/…). **/ matches at any depth —
1679	          # one idempotent line covers root + every nested project.
1680	          printf '%s\n' "**/.claude/settings.local.json" >>"$exclude"
1681	        fi
1682	      fi
1683	      printf '%s\n' "copilot-here: ON — $settings pins Claude Code to $base_url (model: $model)"
1684	      printf '%s\n' "  plain \`claude\` in this project now uses the proxy (restart any running session)"
1685	      _copilot_alive || printf '%s\n' "  ⚠ proxy not running — start it with: copilot-proxy start"
1686	      ;;
1687	    off)
1688	      if [ ! -f "$settings" ]; then
1689	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-here: already off (no $settings)"
1690	        return 0
1691	      fi
1692	      local tmp; tmp="$(command mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/copilot-here.XXXXXX")" || return 1
1693	      # Remove only OUR env keys; drop .env when it empties; keep other content.
1694	      if jq --argjson keys "$_copilot_here_keys" '
1695	          .env = ((.env // {}) | with_entries(select(.key as $k | ($keys | index($k)) == null)))
1696	          | if .env == {} then del(.env) else . end' \
1697	          "$settings" >"$tmp"; then
1698	        if [ "$(jq -r 'if . == {} then "empty" else "kept" end' "$tmp")" = "empty" ]; then
1699	          command rm -f -- "$tmp" "$settings"
1700	          printf '%s\n' "copilot-here: OFF — removed $settings (it held only proxy config)"
1701	        else
1702	          command mv -- "$tmp" "$settings"
1703	          printf '%s\n' "copilot-here: OFF — proxy env removed from $settings (other content kept)"
1704	        fi
1705	        printf '%s\n' "  plain \`claude\` is back on the real Anthropic backend (restart any running session)"
1706	      else
1707	        command rm -f -- "$tmp"
1708	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-here: jq failed; $settings unchanged" >&2
1709	        return 1
1710	      fi
1711	      ;;
1712	    status)
1713	      if [ -f "$settings" ] && [ "$(jq -r '.env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL // empty' "$settings" 2>/dev/null)" != "" ]; then
1714	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-here: ON  (base: $(jq -r '.env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL' "$settings"), model: $(jq -r '.env.ANTHROPIC_MODEL // "(unset)"' "$settings"))"
1715	        local _drift; _drift="$(_copilot_here_drift)"
1716	        [ -n "$_drift" ] && { printf '%s\n' "  ⚠ stale vs current defaults:"; printf '%s\n' "$_drift"; printf '%s\n' "  refresh in place: copilot-here on"; }
1717	        _copilot_alive || printf '%s\n' "  ⚠ proxy not running — start it with: copilot-proxy start"
1718	      else
1719	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-here: off  (enable: copilot-here on; one-off: claude-copilot)"
1720	        return 1
1721	      fi
1722	      ;;
1723	    -h|--help|help)
1724	      printf '%s\n' "Usage: copilot-here [on|off|status]   (toggles ./.claude/settings.local.json)"
1725	      ;;
1726	    *)
1727	      printf '%s\n' "copilot-here: unknown action '$action' (try --help)" >&2
1728	      return 1
1729	      ;;
1730	  esac
1731	}
1732	
1733	# --- one-shot pinned session (Layer 2, auto-reverted) ---------------------------
1734	
1735	# Combine copilot-here (settings.local.json pin — beats inherited env, see Gotchas)
1736	# with claude-copilot's ephemerality: pin THIS project, run ONE specstory-wrapped
1737	# session, then unpin — even on Ctrl-C / kill. The proxy must already be up (we only
1738	# notify; start it with `copilot-proxy start`). If copilot-here is already ON here,
1739	# the existing pin is left untouched on exit (safe to run inside a pinned project).
1740	# Example:
1741	#   claude-copilot-once                 # pin, run, auto-unpin
1742	#   claude-copilot-once -c              # continue last session
1743	#   claude-copilot-once --no-specstory  # raw claude, no markdown auto-save
1744	claude-copilot-once() {
1745	  case "${1:-}" in
1746	    -h|--help)
1747	      printf '%s\n' "Usage: claude-copilot-once [--no-specstory] [claude args...]"
1748	      printf '%s\n' "  Pin THIS project to the proxy (copilot-here on), run one Claude Code"
1749	      printf '%s\n' "  session, then auto-unpin (copilot-here off) — even on Ctrl-C."
1750	      printf '%s\n' "  Needs the proxy already running:  copilot-proxy start"
1751	      return 0 ;;
1752	  esac
1753	
1754	  # 1. Proxy must already be answering — notify only, never auto-start.
1755	  if ! _copilot_alive; then
1756	    printf '%s\n' "claude-copilot-once: proxy not reachable on port $(_copilot_port)." >&2
1757	    printf '%s\n' "  start it first:  copilot-proxy start" >&2
1758	    return 1
1759	  fi
1760	  # copilot-here needs jq — fail early with a clear message.
1761	  if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1762	    printf '%s\n' "claude-copilot-once: jq is required (used by copilot-here)" >&2
1763	    return 1
1764	  fi
1765	
1766	  # 2. Don't clobber an existing pin: only turn OFF what we turn ON.
1767	  local _cco_was_on=0
1768	  if [ -f ".claude/settings.local.json" ] \
1769	     && [ "$(jq -r '.env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL // empty' ".claude/settings.local.json" 2>/dev/null)" != "" ]; then
1770	    _cco_was_on=1
1771	  fi
1772	
1773	  if [ "$_cco_was_on" = "0" ]; then
1774	    copilot-here on || return 1
1775	    # Auto-unpin even on Ctrl-C / kill. Mirror tmux_status_run's INT/TERM/HUP
1776	    # trap + explicit normal-path cleanup; a bare function-scope EXIT trap would
1777	    # fire on the wrong event when bash sources this file.
1778	    trap '_copilot_once_trap' INT TERM HUP
1779	  else
1780	    # Already pinned here. If the pin drifted from current defaults (model bump,
1781	    # proxy moved), offer to refresh it in place; otherwise leave it untouched.
1782	    # Either way it was already ON, so it stays ON on exit (no revert, no trap).
1783	    local _drift; _drift="$(_copilot_here_drift)"
1784	    if [ -n "$_drift" ]; then
1785	      printf '%s\n' "claude-copilot-once: this project's copilot-here pin looks stale:" >&2
1786	      printf '%s\n' "$_drift" >&2
1787	      if _copilot_confirm "  override with current defaults? (keep = default) [y/N]"; then
1788	        copilot-here on || return 1
1789	      else
1790	        printf '%s\n' "claude-copilot-once: kept the existing pin (stays ON on exit)." >&2
1791	      fi
1792	    else
1793	      printf '%s\n' "claude-copilot-once: copilot-here already ON here — leaving the pin in place on exit."
1794	    fi
1795	  fi
1796	
1797	  # 3. One session — specstory-wrapped + arg passthrough (reuses claude-copilot).
1798	  claude-copilot "$@"
1799	  local _rc=$?
1800	
1801	  # 4. Revert only what we enabled.
1802	  if [ "$_cco_was_on" = "0" ]; then
1803	    trap - INT TERM HUP
1804	    copilot-here off
1805	  fi
1806	
1807	  # 5. We never auto-stop the proxy — remind how.
1808	  printf '%s\n' "claude-copilot-once: session ended. Proxy still running on $(_copilot_base)."
1809	  printf '%s\n' "  stop it when done:  copilot-proxy stop"
1810	  return $_rc
1811	}
1812	
1813	# Internal: INT/TERM/HUP handler — unpin, clear trap, re-raise INT so the
1814	# interactive shell sees correct exit semantics (mirrors _tmux_status_run_trap
1815	# in dot_config/shell/60_tmux_status.sh).
1816	_copilot_once_trap() {
1817	  copilot-here off >/dev/null 2>&1
1818	  trap - INT TERM HUP
1819	  printf '\n%s\n' "claude-copilot-once: interrupted — unpinned (copilot-here off). Proxy still up." >&2
1820	  kill -INT $$ 2>/dev/null
1821	}
1822	
1823	# --- pin staleness: detect drift + confirm-to-refresh ---------------------------
1824	
1825	# POSIX y/N prompt. Returns 0 only on an explicit yes; a non-interactive stdin
1826	# (no TTY) returns 1 — the safe default (keep, don't override). We only call this
1827	# right before launching an interactive Claude Code session, so reading stdin is
1828	# fine. NOT `read -q` (zsh-only) — this file is sourced by bash too.
1829	_copilot_confirm() {
1830	  local _ans
1831	  [ -t 0 ] || return 1
1832	  printf '%s ' "${1:-Proceed? [y/N]}" >&2
1833	  IFS= read -r _ans || return 1
1834	  case "$_ans" in
1835	    [yY]|[yY][eE][sS]) return 0 ;;
1836	    *) return 1 ;;
1837	  esac
1838	}
1839	
1840	# Has THIS project's copilot-here pin drifted from what `copilot-here on` would
1841	# write now (default model bumped, proxy port/shim moved, a key added since the
1842	# pin was written)? Prints one "KEY : old -> new" line per drifted key to stdout;
1843	# exit 0 = stale (drift printed), 1 = up-to-date or not pinned. `copilot-here on`
1844	# re-merges exactly these keys, so refreshing a stale pin is just running it again.
1845	#
1846	# Drift is defined as "the set of keys `copilot-here on` would actually CHANGE",
1847	# computed by diffing the live file against _copilot_env_json — not a hand-picked
1848	# subset (that is how three keys silently went unchecked). Note the asymmetry is
1849	# deliberate: keys present in the file but absent from the want-set are NOT drift,
1850	# because `on` merges and never removes them (only `off` does).
1851	_copilot_here_drift() {
1852	  local settings=".claude/settings.local.json"
1853	  [ -f "$settings" ] || return 1
1854	  command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 1
1855	  # ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL is only set while the pin is ON — absent → nothing to do.
1856	  [ -n "$(jq -r '.env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL // empty' "$settings" 2>/dev/null)" ] || return 1
1857	  local want out
1858	  want="$(_copilot_env_json)" || return 1
1859	  out="$(jq -r --argjson want "$want" '
1860	    (.env // {}) as $cur
1861	    | [ $want
1862	        | to_entries[]
1863	        | select($cur[.key] != .value)
1864	        | "  \(.key) : \($cur[.key] // "(unset)") -> \(.value)" ]
1865	    | .[]' "$settings" 2>/dev/null)"
1866	  [ -n "$out" ] || return 1
1867	  printf '%s\n' "$out"
1868	  return 0
1869	}
1870	
1871	# --- model switcher -------------------------------------------------------------
1872	
1873	# The live model catalog is the SSOT for ids, aliases and context limits. Keep
1874	# this separate from _copilot_served_models: doctor wants ids + aliases, while
1875	# role selection wants each raw id's capability metadata.
1876	_copilot_model_catalog() {
1877	  command curl -fsS --max-time 5 "$(_copilot_base)/v1/models" 2>/dev/null
1878	}
1879	
1880	_copilot_catalog_ids() {
1881	  if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1882	    jq -r '.data[]?.id // empty' 2>/dev/null | command sort -u
1883	  else
1884	    command grep -o '"id":"[^"]*"' | command sed 's/"id":"//;s/"//' | command sort -u
1885	  fi
1886	}
1887	
1888	_copilot_strip_context_hint() {
1889	  printf '%s' "${1%\[1m\]}"
1890	}
1891	
1892	# Convert a raw proxy id to the spelling Claude Code should receive. A live
1893	# max_context_window_tokens >= 1M earns [1m]; if the proxy is down, preserve an
1894	# explicitly stored suffix but do not invent one. Raw API clients never use this.
1895	_copilot_model_for_claude() {
1896	  local requested="${1:-}" catalog="${2:-}" raw had_hint=0 context=''
1897	  [ -n "$requested" ] || return 1
1898	  case "$requested" in *"[1m]") had_hint=1 ;; esac
1899	  raw="$(_copilot_strip_context_hint "$requested")"
1900	  if [ "$#" -lt 2 ]; then catalog="$(_copilot_model_catalog 2>/dev/null || true)"; fi
1901	  if [ -n "$catalog" ] && command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1902	    context="$(printf '%s' "$catalog" | jq -r --arg id "$raw" '
1903	      first(.data[]? | select(.id == $id) | .capabilities.limits.max_context_window_tokens) // empty
1904	    ' 2>/dev/null)"
1905	    case "$context" in
1906	      ''|*[!0-9]*) printf '%s' "$raw" ;;
1907	      *) if [ "$context" -ge 1000000 ]; then printf '%s[1m]' "$raw"; else printf '%s' "$raw"; fi ;;
1908	    esac
1909	  elif [ "$had_hint" -eq 1 ]; then
1910	    printf '%s[1m]' "$raw"
1911	  else
1912	    printf '%s' "$raw"
1913	  fi
1914	}
1915	
1916	_copilot_first_served() {
1917	  local models="$1" candidate
1918	  shift
1919	  for candidate in "$@"; do
1920	    if printf '%s\n' "$models" | command grep -qxF "$candidate"; then
1921	      printf '%s' "$candidate"
1922	      return 0
1923	    fi
1924	  done
1925	  return 1
1926	}
1927	
1928	# Pick the best raw served id for the main Claude Code model. Claude stays the
1929	# first choice when entitled. Without Claude, rank OpenAI by capability tier,
1930	# deliberately placing lightweight Luna behind the older flagship/coding tiers.
1931	# Reads newline-separated raw ids on stdin and prints one raw id.
1932	_copilot_pick_best_model() {
1933	  local models preferred c
1934	  models="$(command cat | command sed 's/\[1m\]$//' | command sort -u)"
1935	  [ -n "$models" ] || return 1
1936	
1937	  for preferred in \
1938	    claude-fable-5 \
1939	    claude-opus-5 claude-opus-4-8 claude-opus-4-7 claude-opus-4-6 \
1940	    claude-sonnet-5 claude-sonnet-4-6 claude-sonnet-4-5 \
1941	    claude-opus-4-5 claude-haiku-4-5
1942	  do
1943	    if printf '%s\n' "$models" | command grep -qxF "$preferred"; then
1944	      printf '%s' "$preferred"
1945	      return 0
1946	    fi
1947	  done
1948	  c="$(printf '%s\n' "$models" | command grep -E '^claude-' | command sort | command tail -1)"
1949	  if [ -n "$c" ]; then printf '%s' "$c"; return 0; fi
1950	
1951	  for preferred in \
1952	    gpt-5.6-sol gpt-5.6-terra gpt-5.5 gpt-5.4 gpt-5.3-codex \
1953	    gpt-5.6-luna gpt-5.4-mini gpt-5-mini
1954	  do
1955	    if printf '%s\n' "$models" | command grep -qxF "$preferred"; then
1956	      printf '%s' "$preferred"
1957	      return 0
1958	    fi
1959	  done
1960	
1961	  c="$(printf '%s\n' "$models" | command grep -E '^gpt-' | command grep -viE 'mini|nano|luna' \
1962	        | command sort | command tail -1)"
1963	  if [ -n "$c" ]; then printf '%s' "$c"; return 0; fi
1964	  c="$(printf '%s\n' "$models" | command grep -iE 'codex' | command sort | command tail -1)"
1965	  if [ -n "$c" ]; then printf '%s' "$c"; return 0; fi
1966	  c="$(printf '%s\n' "$models" | command grep -E '^gpt-' | command sort | command tail -1)"
1967	  if [ -n "$c" ]; then printf '%s' "$c"; return 0; fi
1968	
1969	  c="$(printf '%s\n' "$models" | command grep -E '^gemini-' | command grep -viE 'flash' \
1970	        | command sort | command tail -1)"
1971	  if [ -n "$c" ]; then printf '%s' "$c"; return 0; fi
1972	  c="$(printf '%s\n' "$models" | command grep -E '^gemini-' | command sort | command tail -1)"
1973	  if [ -n "$c" ]; then printf '%s' "$c"; return 0; fi
1974	
1975	  printf '%s\n' "$models" | command sort | command tail -1
1976	}
1977	
1978	# Build the full Claude Code role profile for one selected main model. Native
1979	# Claude profiles use the strongest served model in each Claude family. OpenAI
1980	# profiles map quality/balanced/fast roles to Sol/Terra/Luna, with every role
1981	# falling back to the selected main rather than an unserved hard-coded id.
1982	_copilot_model_profile_json() {
1983	  command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 1
1984	  local selected="${1:-$(_copilot_default_model)}" catalog="${2:-}" models raw main
1985	  local fable_raw opus_raw sonnet_raw haiku_raw

```text
1	# 45_copilot_raycast.sh - generate Raycast AI custom providers from the proxy
2	#   (shared bash + zsh). Sibling to 43_copilot_proxy.sh — loads AFTER it, so the
3	#   _copilot_base / _copilot_pinned_base / _copilot_alive helpers already exist.
4	#
5	# Raycast 1.102+ has a "Custom Providers" experiment (Settings → AI →
6	# Experiments) that reads ~/.config/raycast/ai/providers.yaml and routes those
7	# requests DIRECTLY from the Mac — so a localhost base_url works, and every
8	# Copilot model the proxy serves becomes a first-class Raycast AI model (Quick
9	# AI, AI Chat, AI Commands). This is NOT the "Custom API Keys" (BYOK) box: BYOK
10	# routes through Raycast's servers and only accepts a key, never an endpoint.
11	# Custom providers need no Raycast Pro. This file writes that YAML from the LIVE
12	# proxy catalogue, filtered by a probe (see the GOTCHA below).
13	#
14	# Public surface:
15	#   copilot-raycast [status]                  - config path, model count, drift
16	#   copilot-raycast generate [--dry-run] [--all]
17	#                                             - probe + (re)write providers.yaml
18	#                                               (--all also emits the rejected
19	#                                               models, commented out)
20	#   copilot-raycast diff                      - what generate would change
21	#   copilot-raycast probe [MODEL]             - classification table, one or all
22	#   copilot-raycast doctor                    - full diagnostic (house format)
23	#   copilot-raycast edit                      - $EDITOR the config, then validate
24	#
25	# GOTCHA (verified 2026-07): the free model-validation probe. POSTing
26	#   {"model":"<ID>","messages":[]} to /chat/completions is rejected during
27	#   request validation, BEFORE any inference, and moves no usage counter. Three
28	#   responses classify every model:
29	#     "messages must be non-empty"  -> usable via /chat/completions   (KEEP)
30	#     "model_not_supported"         -> not entitled / stale catalog   (DROP)
31	#     "unsupported_api_for_model"   -> exists, but only on /responses (DROP)
32	#   Probing is the ONLY truth: the static /v1/models metadata is wrong in BOTH
33	#   directions. gemini-2.5-pro and gemini-3-flash-preview advertise an EMPTY
34	#   supported_endpoints[] yet work; claude-opus-4-6/4-7/4-8, claude-sonnet-4-6,
35	#   claude-sonnet-4-5 and claude-haiku-4-5 all advertise "/chat/completions",
36	#   model_picker_enabled: true and policy.state "enabled" — and every one of
37	#   them returns model_not_supported. No field in /v1/models predicts this.
38	#
39	# GOTCHA (verified 2026-07): Raycast validates providers.yaml ALL-OR-NOTHING and
40	#   reports NOTHING on failure — one model missing `context` (or a quoted
41	#   `context: "128000"`, which is a type mismatch) silently removes EVERY custom
42	#   provider from the picker, including unrelated ones. So: generate to a temp
43	#   file, `yq`-validate it, and only then move it into place. Corollary: Raycast
44	#   makes zero network calls at config-load time, so an unusable model id looks
45	#   perfectly healthy in the picker and only 400s when you send a message —
46	#   which is exactly why the probe above is not optional.
47	#
48	# Verified 2026-07: `defaults read com.raycast.macos raycastAI_modelRouterModelInfo`
49	#   is a base64 JSON blob of what Raycast ACTUALLY loaded, keyed by provider id.
50	#   That is a zero-UI oracle for "did my file take?" — `status` and `doctor` read
51	#   it, so a silently-rejected config is visible instead of mysterious.
52	#
53	# Temperature heuristic (it cannot be probed): the messages check fires before
54	#   parameter validation, so {"messages":[],"temperature":0.7} still answers
55	#   "messages must be non-empty". Default: temperature unsupported for the
56	#   OpenAI reasoning family (gpt-*, *codex*, o1/o3/o4*) and Microsoft mai-*,
57	#   supported for everything else (Anthropic + Google take it fine here).
58	#   Override wholesale with COPILOT_RAYCAST_TEMP=on|off.
59	#
60	# Env (set in ~/.shellrc.adhoc or ~/.config/{zsh/secrets.zsh,bash/secrets.sh}):
61	#   COPILOT_RAYCAST_CONFIG default: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/raycast/ai/providers.yaml
62	#                                             - the file Raycast watches
63	#   COPILOT_RAYCAST_ID     default: copilot   - providers[].id we own; every
64	#                                               OTHER id in the file is preserved
65	#   COPILOT_RAYCAST_LABEL  default: GitHub Copilot   - providers[].name
66	#   COPILOT_RAYCAST_SUFFIX default: " (Copilot)"     - appended to each model
67	#                                               name so typing "copilot" in the
68	#                                               Raycast picker finds them all
69	#   COPILOT_RAYCAST_TEMP   default: auto      - auto|on|off, see the heuristic
70	#   COPILOT_RAYCAST_JOBS   default: 6         - concurrent probes in the sweep
71	#   COPILOT_RAYCAST_PROBE_BASE default: $(_copilot_base)  - what the sweep POSTs
72	#                                               to; :4141 direct, NOT the shim
73	#   COPILOT_RAYCAST_KEEP   default: 10        - timestamped backups to retain
74	
75	# Skip silently if already sourced (idempotent — safe to dot in sub-shells).
76	[ -n "${_COPILOT_RAYCAST_SOURCED:-}" ] && return 0
77	_COPILOT_RAYCAST_SOURCED=1
78	
79	# Defensive load: if 43_copilot_proxy.sh wasn't sourced first (e.g. someone
80	# dot-sourced this file directly without running rc), pull it in so the shared
81	# _copilot_* helpers exist. Same pattern as 44_copilot_embed.sh.
82	if ! command -v _copilot_base >/dev/null 2>&1 \
83	   && [ -r "$HOME/.config/shell/43_copilot_proxy.sh" ]; then
84	  # shellcheck disable=SC1091
85	  source "$HOME/.config/shell/43_copilot_proxy.sh"
86	fi
87	
88	# --- shared constants / helpers -------------------------------------------------
89	
90	_copilot_raycast_config() { printf '%s' "${COPILOT_RAYCAST_CONFIG:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/raycast/ai/providers.yaml}"; }
91	_copilot_raycast_id()     { printf '%s' "${COPILOT_RAYCAST_ID:-copilot}"; }
92	_copilot_raycast_label()  { printf '%s' "${COPILOT_RAYCAST_LABEL:-GitHub Copilot}"; }
93	_copilot_raycast_suffix() { printf '%s' "${COPILOT_RAYCAST_SUFFIX:- (Copilot)}"; }
94	_copilot_raycast_jobs()   { printf '%s' "${COPILOT_RAYCAST_JOBS:-6}"; }
95	_copilot_raycast_keep()   { printf '%s' "${COPILOT_RAYCAST_KEEP:-10}"; }
96	
97	# Backups are namespaced PER CONFIG. The KEEP rotation is a FIFO over one
98	# directory, so a single shared dir means one
99	#   COPILOT_RAYCAST_CONFIG=/tmp/scratch.yaml copilot-raycast generate
100	# evicts the real config's backups — which is exactly the history you want when
101	# a hand-added provider goes missing. The default path is unchanged so existing
102	# back-ups stay where they are.
103	_copilot_raycast_backups(){
104	  local base cfg
105	  base="${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/copilot-raycast/backups"
106	  cfg="$(_copilot_raycast_config)"
107	  if [ "$cfg" = "${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/raycast/ai/providers.yaml" ]; then
108	    printf '%s' "$base"
109	  else
110	    printf '%s/%s' "$base" \
111	      "$(printf '%s' "$cfg" | command sed 's|^/||; s|[^A-Za-z0-9._-]|_|g')"
112	  fi
113	}
114	
115	# The banner we print above the preserved foreign providers. yq round-trips it
116	# back as a head comment on the first foreign node, so _copilot_raycast_others
117	# MUST strip it again or every generate appends one more copy — see the comment
118	# there. Single source of truth for both the writer and the stripper.
119	_copilot_raycast_others_banner() {
120	  printf '%s' "# --- other providers, preserved from the previous file ---"
121	}
122	_copilot_raycast_prefs()  { printf '%s' "$HOME/Library/Preferences/com.raycast.macos.plist"; }
123	_copilot_raycast_template(){ printf '%s' "$(command dirname "$(_copilot_raycast_config)")/providers.template.yaml"; }
124	
125	# base_url written INTO providers.yaml: the shim when it's enabled. Same
126	# reasoning as _copilot_pinned_base (which this reuses) — the file outlives this
127	# shell, so it must not be gated on currently-alive. The shim matters more here
128	# than anywhere else: Raycast and Claude Code now share one Copilot backend, and
129	# the shim's semaphore + transparent 403/429 retry is what stops a burst of
130	# Quick-AI calls from making Claude Code see "Please run /login".
131	_copilot_raycast_base_url() { printf '%s/v1' "$(_copilot_pinned_base)"; }
132	
133	# ...but the SWEEP deliberately POSTs to the fork directly (:4141). The probe is
134	# ~20 requests fired 6-wide; routing them through the shim would serialise them
135	# behind its 4-permit semaphore for no benefit, because a rejected-at-validation
136	# request never reaches the point the shim's retry logic protects. Override with
137	# COPILOT_RAYCAST_PROBE_BASE if you ever want the sweep throttled too.
138	_copilot_raycast_probe_base() { printf '%s' "${COPILOT_RAYCAST_PROBE_BASE:-$(_copilot_base)}"; }
139	
140	# Sort key: bigger = earlier in providers.yaml. Mirrors _copilot_pick_best_model's
141	# vendor ranking (Claude > Codex > GPT > Gemini) but keeps ALL of them, and adds
142	# a within-family tier so opus lands above sonnet above haiku. Ties are broken by
143	# `sort -Vr` on the id, i.e. newest version first.
144	_copilot_raycast_rank() {
145	  case "$1" in
146	    claude-opus-*)   printf '59' ;;
147	    claude-sonnet-*) printf '58' ;;
148	    claude-haiku-*)  printf '57' ;;
149	    claude-*)        printf '56' ;;
150	    *codex*)         printf '45' ;;
151	    # gemini MUST be matched before any *mini* rule — "ge-mini" contains "mini",
152	    # and a naive `*mini*` arm silently demotes the entire Google family.
153	    gemini-*pro*)    printf '25' ;;
154	    gemini-*flash*)  printf '24' ;;
155	    gemini-*)        printf '23' ;;
156	    gpt-*mini*|o1*mini*|o3*mini*|o4*mini*) printf '34' ;;
157	    gpt-*|o1*|o3*|o4*)                     printf '35' ;;
158	    *)               printf '10' ;;
159	  esac
160	}
161	
162	# Heuristic only — see the header. Echoes "true"/"false".
163	_copilot_raycast_temp() {
164	  case "${COPILOT_RAYCAST_TEMP:-auto}" in
165	    1|on|true|yes)  printf 'true';  return 0 ;;
166	    0|off|false|no) printf 'false'; return 0 ;;
167	  esac
168	  case "$1" in
169	    gpt-*|o1*|o3*|o4*|*codex*|mai-*) printf 'false' ;;
170	    *)                               printf 'true' ;;
171	  esac
172	}
173	
174	# Escape a scalar for a YAML double-quoted string (backslash first, then quote).
175	_copilot_raycast_yesc() {
176	  printf '%s' "$1" | command sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/"/\\"/g'
177	}
178	
179	# --- catalogue + zero-quota probe -----------------------------------------------
180	
181	# Live chat models from the proxy, one TSV row each:
182	#   id \t name \t vendor \t context \t vision \t tools \t reasoning_effort
183	# Pre-filters on capabilities.type == "chat" (drops the three embedding models)
184	# and on the "[1m]" alias, which is Claude Code-only sugar the proxy rejects from
185	# a raw API client. Everything else is decided by the probe, never by metadata.
186	_copilot_raycast_catalog() {
187	  command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 1
188	  command curl -fsS --max-time 10 "$(_copilot_base)/v1/models" 2>/dev/null \
189	    | jq -r '
190	        .data[]
191	        | select(.capabilities.type == "chat")
192	        | [ .id,
193	            # `//` only falls through on null/false, so an EMPTY name would ship
194	            # an empty TSV field — and IFS=<tab> is IFS-whitespace, which
195	            # collapses runs of separators, silently shifting every column right
196	            # of it (name<-vendor, context<-vision, …). Coerce empties too.
197	            (if (.name // "") == "" then
198	               (if (.display_name // "") == "" then .id else .display_name end)
199	             else .name end),
200	            (if (.vendor // "") == "" then "Other" else .vendor end),
201	            (.capabilities.limits.max_context_window_tokens // 0),
202	            (if .capabilities.supports.vision      == true then "1" else "0" end),
203	            (if .capabilities.supports.tool_calls  == true then "1" else "0" end),
204	            (if (.capabilities.supports.reasoning_effort | type) == "array"
205	                and (.capabilities.supports.reasoning_effort | length) > 0
206	             then "1" else "0" end)
207	          ] | @tsv' 2>/dev/null \
208	    | command grep -v '\[1m\]'
209	}
210	
211	# Classify ONE model id. Echoes one of:
212	#   ok | not_supported | responses_only | no_response | unknown
213	# Body is deliberately {"messages":[]} — see the header GOTCHA. One free retry
214	# covers a transient 429/502 from the burst, which would otherwise read as a
215	# permanent "unknown" and silently drop a good model from the file.
216	_copilot_raycast_probe_one() {
217	  local model="$1" body resp i=0
218	  body="$(printf '{"model":"%s","messages":[]}' "$model")"
219	  while [ "$i" -lt 2 ]; do
220	    resp="$(command curl -s --max-time 25 \
221	              -X POST "$(_copilot_raycast_probe_base)/v1/chat/completions" \
222	              -H 'content-type: application/json' -d "$body" 2>/dev/null)"
223	    case "$resp" in
224	      *'messages must be non-empty'*) printf 'ok';             return 0 ;;
225	      *model_not_supported*)          printf 'not_supported';  return 0 ;;
226	      *unsupported_api_for_model*)    printf 'responses_only'; return 0 ;;
227	    esac
228	    i=$((i + 1))
229	    [ "$i" -lt 2 ] && sleep 1
230	  done
231	  case "$resp" in
232	    '') printf 'no_response' ;;
233	    *)  printf 'unknown' ;;
234	  esac
235	}
236	
237	# Probe every id on stdin, at most $(_copilot_raycast_jobs) at a time, writing
238	# "$dir/<id>" per model. Always called as the RHS of a pipeline so it runs in a
239	# subshell: job control is off there, which is what keeps zsh from printing
240	# "[1] 12345" job notices all over an interactive run.
241	_copilot_raycast_sweep() {
242	  local dir="$1" max n=0 m
243	  max="$(_copilot_raycast_jobs)"
244	  # A non-numeric or zero COPILOT_RAYCAST_JOBS made `[ "$n" -ge "$max" ]` print
245	  # "integer expression expected" once per model (or serialise the whole sweep).
246	  case "$max" in ''|*[!0-9]*) max=6 ;; esac
247	  [ "$max" -ge 1 ] || max=6
248	  while IFS= read -r m; do
249	    [ -n "$m" ] || continue
250	    _copilot_raycast_probe_one "$m" >"$dir/$m" 2>/dev/null &
251	    n=$((n + 1))
252	    if [ "$n" -ge "$max" ]; then wait; n=0; fi
253	  done
254	  wait
255	}
256	
257	# Catalogue + verdicts, sorted for emission. One TSV row per chat model:
258	#   rank \t id \t name \t vendor \t context \t vision \t tools \t reasoning \t verdict
259	# This is the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH consumed by generate, diff, status, probe
260	# and doctor — they must never disagree about which models are usable.
261	_copilot_raycast_scan() {
262	  local cat dir
263	  cat="$(_copilot_raycast_catalog)" || return 1
264	  [ -n "$cat" ] || return 1
265	  dir="$(command mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/copilot-raycast.XXXXXX")" || return 1
266	  printf '%s\n' "$cat" | command cut -f1 | _copilot_raycast_sweep "$dir"
267	  local id name vendor ctx vis tools reff verdict
268	  printf '%s\n' "$cat" | while IFS="$(printf '\t')" read -r id name vendor ctx vis tools reff; do
269	    verdict="$(command head -n 1 "$dir/$id" 2>/dev/null)"
270	    [ -n "$verdict" ] || verdict='no_response'
271	    printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' \
272	      "$(_copilot_raycast_rank "$id")" "$id" "$name" "$vendor" \
273	      "$ctx" "$vis" "$tools" "$reff" "$verdict"
274	  done | command sort -k1,1nr -k2,2Vr
275	  command rm -rf -- "$dir"
276	}
277	
278	# --- providers.yaml rendering ---------------------------------------------------
279	
280	# Foreign providers (every id that is not ours) as a YAML sequence, or empty.
281	# yq round-trips them including their comments; without yq we cannot safely
282	# rewrite a file that has any, and _copilot_raycast_render refuses instead.
283	_copilot_raycast_others() {
284	  local cfg; cfg="$(_copilot_raycast_config)"
285	  [ -f "$cfg" ] || return 0
286	  command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0
287	  local raw out
288	  # Two steps on purpose. `yq | awk` in one pipeline would hide yq's exit
289	  # status behind awk's, and "yq could not parse this file" MUST NOT read as
290	  # "there are no other providers" — that is the difference between preserving
291	  # a hand-added provider and silently deleting it. Verified 2026-07: a stray
292	  # tab in providers.yaml made the old one-pipeline version report success
293	  # while dropping a hand-added `myollama` block.
294	  raw="$(COPILOT_RC_ID="$(_copilot_raycast_id)" yq -o=yaml \
295	          '(.providers // []) | map(select(.id != strenv(COPILOT_RC_ID)))' \
296	          "$cfg" 2>/dev/null)" || return 2
297	  # Strip our own banner: yq round-trips it back as a head comment on the first
298	  # foreign node, so without this every generate appends one more copy — the
299	  # file grows without bound and `copilot-raycast diff` can never say "no
300	  # changes" once any foreign provider exists.
301	  out="$(printf '%s\n' "$raw" | command awk -v m="$(_copilot_raycast_others_banner)" \
302	           '{ t = $0; sub(/^[[:space:]]+/, "", t); if (t != m) print }')"
303	  case "$out" in
304	    ''|'[]'|'null') return 0 ;;
305	    *) printf '%s\n' "$out" ;;
306	  esac
307	}
308	
309	# Two sorted id lists in, a human drift report out ('' when they agree). Uses
310	# comm(1) over temp files rather than diff <(…): process substitution is a
311	# bash/zsh extension and this file stays in the POSIX subset.
312	_copilot_raycast_drift() {
313	  local a b
314	  a="$(command mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/copilot-raycast.XXXXXX")" || return 1
315	  b="$(command mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/copilot-raycast.XXXXXX")" || return 1
316	  printf '%s\n' "$1" | command grep -v '^$' | command sort -u >"$a"
317	  printf '%s\n' "$2" | command grep -v '^$' | command sort -u >"$b"
318	  command comm -23 "$a" "$b" | command sed 's/^/    stale in file: /'
319	  command comm -13 "$a" "$b" | command sed 's/^/    missing      : /'
320	  command rm -f -- "$a" "$b"
321	}
322	
323	# Render the COMPLETE providers.yaml to stdout from a scan TSV on stdin.
324	# $1 = 1 to also emit the probe-rejected models, commented out.
325	_copilot_raycast_render() {
326	  local want_all="${1:-0}" tsv cfg pid base others
327	  tsv="$(command cat)"
328	  cfg="$(_copilot_raycast_config)"
329	  pid="$(_copilot_raycast_id)"
330	  base="$(_copilot_raycast_base_url)"
331	  others="$(_copilot_raycast_others)" || {
332	    printf '%s\n' "copilot-raycast: $cfg is not valid YAML — refusing to rewrite it" >&2
333	    printf '%s\n' "  any provider you added by hand would be lost; inspect or move it aside:" >&2
334	    printf '%s\n' "  yq '.' $cfg" >&2
335	    return 1
336	  }
337	
338	  if [ -f "$cfg" ] && ! command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
339	    # Rewriting an existing file blind would silently delete any provider the
340	    # user added by hand, and there is no cheap POSIX way to tell a provider
341	    # entry from a model entry in arbitrary YAML. Refuse instead.
342	    printf '%s\n' "copilot-raycast: yq is required to rewrite an existing $cfg (it preserves other providers)" >&2
343	    printf '%s\n' "  brew install yq   # or move the file aside and re-run" >&2
344	    return 1
345	  fi
346	
347	  local n_ok n_all
348	  n_ok="$(printf '%s\n' "$tsv" | command awk -F'\t' '$9 == "ok"' | command grep -c . || true)"
349	  n_all="$(printf '%s\n' "$tsv" | command grep -c . || true)"
350	
351	  printf '%s\n' "# Raycast AI custom providers — GENERATED by \`copilot-raycast generate\`."
352	  printf '%s\n' "# Hand edits are lost on the next run; back-ups live in"
353	  printf '%s\n' "#   $(_copilot_raycast_backups)"
354	  printf '%s\n' "#"
355	  printf '%s\n' "# Source: $(_copilot_base)/v1/models  ($n_all chat model(s), $n_ok usable)"
356	  printf '%s\n' "# Probed: $(command date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S%z') via $(_copilot_raycast_probe_base)"
357	  printf '%s\n' "#"
358	  printf '%s\n' "# Each id was validated with a zero-quota probe — POST /chat/completions with"
359	  printf '%s\n' "# {\"model\":ID,\"messages\":[]} is rejected before inference, and the error"
360	  printf '%s\n' "# distinguishes usable models from ones the /v1/models catalogue only claims"
361	  printf '%s\n' "# to serve:  \"messages must be non-empty\" = keep, \"model_not_supported\" and"
362	  printf '%s\n' "# \"unsupported_api_for_model\" = drop.  Regenerate: copilot-raycast generate"
363	  printf '\n'
364	  printf '%s\n' "providers:"
365	  printf '  - id: %s\n' "$pid"
366	  printf '    name: "%s"\n' "$(_copilot_raycast_yesc "$(_copilot_raycast_label)")"
367	  printf '    base_url: %s\n' "$base"
368	  printf '%s\n' "    models:"
369	
370	  local rank id name vendor ctx vis tools reff verdict vlast='' dname
371	  printf '%s\n' "$tsv" | while IFS="$(printf '\t')" read -r rank id name vendor ctx vis tools reff verdict; do
372	    [ -n "$id" ] || continue
373	    case "$verdict" in
374	      ok) ;;
375	      *) [ "$want_all" = "1" ] || continue ;;
376	    esac
377	    if [ "$vendor" != "$vlast" ]; then
378	      [ -n "$vlast" ] && printf '\n'
379	      printf '      # --- %s ---\n' "$vendor"
380	      vlast="$vendor"
381	    fi
382	    dname="$(_copilot_raycast_yesc "$name$(_copilot_raycast_suffix)")"
383	    # context MUST be a bare positive integer — a quoted or missing one is a
384	    # Swift type mismatch and takes the WHOLE file down, silently.
385	    case "$ctx" in ''|*[!0-9]*) ctx=128000 ;; esac
386	    [ "$ctx" -gt 0 ] || ctx=128000
387	    if [ "$verdict" != "ok" ]; then
388	      # Commented out on purpose: emitting these for real would 400 at inference
389	      # with nothing shown in the Raycast UI. Kept so a future run can be diffed
390	      # against them when GitHub changes an entitlement.
391	      printf '      # - id: "%s"   # %s\n' "$(_copilot_raycast_yesc "$id")" "$verdict"
392	      printf '      #   name: "%s"\n' "$dname"
393	      printf '      #   context: %s\n' "$ctx"
394	      continue
395	    fi
396	    printf '      - id: "%s"\n' "$(_copilot_raycast_yesc "$id")"
397	    printf '        name: "%s"\n' "$dname"
398	    printf '        context: %s\n' "$ctx"
399	    printf '%s\n' "        abilities:"
400	    printf '          temperature: { supported: %s }\n' "$(_copilot_raycast_temp "$id")"
401	    printf '          vision: { supported: %s }\n' "$([ "$vis" = 1 ] && printf 'true' || printf 'false')"
402	    # No /v1/models field describes system-message support; every Copilot chat
403	    # model accepts one, so this is a constant true.
404	    printf '%s\n' "          system_message: { supported: true }"
405	    printf '          tools: { supported: %s }\n' "$([ "$tools" = 1 ] && printf 'true' || printf 'false')"
406	    printf '          reasoning_effort: { supported: %s }\n' "$([ "$reff" = 1 ] && printf 'true' || printf 'false')"
407	  done
408	
409	  if [ -n "$others" ]; then
410	    printf '\n'
411	    printf '%s\n' "  $(_copilot_raycast_others_banner)"
412	    printf '%s\n' "$others" | command sed 's/^\(.\)/  \1/'
413	  fi
414	}
415	
416	# --- validation + atomic install ------------------------------------------------
417	
418	# Raycast says nothing when it rejects a file, so this is the only gate. Checks
419	# the shape it actually hard-fails on: at least one provider, unique provider
420	# ids, and every model carrying a string id, a string name and an INTEGER
421	# context. Returns 0 (can't tell) when yq is missing — the caller warns.
422	_copilot_raycast_validate() {
423	  command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0
424	  yq -e '
425	    ((.providers | length) > 0)
426	    and (([.providers[].id] | unique | length) == (.providers | length))
427	    and (([.providers[].models[]
428	           | select((.id | tag) == "!!str"
429	                    and (.name | tag) == "!!str"
430	                    and (.context | tag) == "!!int")] | length)
431	         == ([.providers[].models[]] | length))
432	  ' "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1
433	}
434	
435	# Install rendered YAML (stdin) at the config path: validate, back up, move.
436	# One single write — Raycast's file watcher coalesces rapid writes and can skip
437	# a reload entirely, so the back-up deliberately goes to a different directory
438	# rather than sitting next to the file as a second touch.
439	_copilot_raycast_install() {
440	  local cfg dir tmp bdir bk
441	  cfg="$(_copilot_raycast_config)"
442	  dir="$(command dirname "$cfg")"
443	  command mkdir -p "$dir"
444	  # The temp file MUST live next to the target, not in $TMPDIR: `mv` is only an
445	  # atomic rename(2) within one filesystem. Across filesystems it degrades to
446	  # copy-then-unlink, and an interrupted copy leaves a TRUNCATED providers.yaml
447	  # — the exact all-or-nothing failure this whole install path exists to avoid.
448	  # macOS puts $TMPDIR on the data volume with $HOME today, but nothing
449	  # guarantees that (a TMPDIR on an external disk or a RAM disk breaks it).
450	  tmp="$(command mktemp "$dir/.copilot-raycast.XXXXXX")" || {
451	    printf '%s\n' "copilot-raycast: cannot write a temp file in $dir; $cfg unchanged" >&2
452	    return 1
453	  }
454	  command cat >"$tmp"
455	  if [ ! -s "$tmp" ]; then
456	    command rm -f -- "$tmp"
457	    printf '%s\n' "copilot-raycast: rendered nothing; $cfg unchanged" >&2
458	    return 1
459	  fi
460	  if ! _copilot_raycast_validate "$tmp"; then
461	    command rm -f -- "$tmp"
462	    printf '%s\n' "copilot-raycast: generated YAML failed validation; $cfg unchanged" >&2
463	    printf '%s\n' "  a bad file would silently remove EVERY custom provider from Raycast" >&2
464	    return 1
465	  fi
466	  if [ -f "$cfg" ]; then
467	    bdir="$(_copilot_raycast_backups)"
468	    command mkdir -p "$bdir"
469	    bk="$bdir/providers-$(command date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).yaml"
470	    if ! command cp -- "$cfg" "$bk"; then
471	      command rm -f -- "$tmp"
472	      printf '%s\n' "copilot-raycast: backup to $bk failed; $cfg unchanged" >&2
473	      return 1
474	    fi
475	    # Keep the last N generations (same spirit as copilot-proxy's log rotation).
476	    # Restricted to our own providers-*.yaml: a bare `ls -1t "$bdir"` would
477	    # happily rm anything else the user parked in that directory.
478	    local _f
479	    command ls -1t "$bdir" 2>/dev/null \
480	      | command grep -E '^providers-[0-9]{8}-[0-9]{6}\.yaml$' \
481	      | command tail -n +"$(( $(_copilot_raycast_keep) + 1 ))" \
482	      | while IFS= read -r _f; do command rm -f -- "$bdir/$_f"; done
483	  fi
484	  command mv -- "$tmp" "$cfg" || {
485	    command rm -f -- "$tmp"
486	    printf '%s\n' "copilot-raycast: install failed; $cfg unchanged" >&2
487	    return 1
488	  }
489	  [ -n "$bk" ] && printf '%s\n' "copilot-raycast: backup $bk"
490	  return 0
491	}
492	
493	# --- what Raycast actually loaded -----------------------------------------------
494	
495	# Model ids Raycast currently has live for our provider id, newline separated.
496	# Reads raycastAI_modelRouterModelInfo (base64 JSON) from the prefs plist — the
497	# only observable that distinguishes "written" from "accepted".
498	_copilot_raycast_loaded() {
499	  local plist; plist="$(_copilot_raycast_prefs)"
500	  [ -f "$plist" ] || return 1
501	  command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 1
502	  command plutil -extract raycastAI_modelRouterModelInfo raw -o - "$plist" 2>/dev/null \
503	    | command base64 -d 2>/dev/null \
504	    | jq -r --arg id "$(_copilot_raycast_id)" '.[$id][]?.model // empty' 2>/dev/null
505	}
506	
507	# --- public command -------------------------------------------------------------
508	
509	# Generate ~/.config/raycast/ai/providers.yaml from the live proxy catalogue,
510	# keeping only the models a zero-quota probe proves are reachable over
511	# /chat/completions. Bare invocation is read-only (status).
512	# Example:
513	#   copilot-raycast                    # config path, model count, drift vs live
514	#   copilot-raycast probe              # classification table for every chat model
515	#   copilot-raycast generate --dry-run # render to stdout, touch nothing
516	#   copilot-raycast generate           # back up, validate, install
517	#   copilot-raycast diff               # what generate would change
518	copilot-raycast() {
519	  # ${ZSH_VERSION:-} not $ZSH_VERSION: a caller running under `set -u` would
520	  # otherwise get "ZSH_VERSION: unbound variable" and the function would never
521	  # run at all. (43_copilot_proxy.sh / 44_copilot_embed.sh have the same line.)
522	  if [ -n "${ZSH_VERSION:-}" ]; then
523	    emulate -L zsh
524	    setopt localoptions pipefail
525	  else
526	    set -o pipefail
527	  fi
528	
529	  if ! command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
530	    printf '%s\n' "copilot-raycast: curl is required" >&2; return 1
531	  fi
532	  if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
533	    printf '%s\n' "copilot-raycast: jq is required" >&2; return 1
534	  fi
535	
536	  local cfg pid action
537	  cfg="$(_copilot_raycast_config)"
538	  pid="$(_copilot_raycast_id)"
539	  action="${1:-status}"
540	
541	  case "$action" in
542	    generate|gen)
543	      local dry=0 all=0
544	      shift
545	      while [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; do
546	        case "$1" in
547	          -n|--dry-run) dry=1; shift ;;
548	          -a|--all)     all=1; shift ;;
549	          --)           shift; break ;;
550	          -*)
551	            printf '%s\n' "copilot-raycast: unknown flag '$1' (try --help)" >&2; return 1 ;;
552	          *)            break ;;
553	        esac
554	      done
555	      if ! _copilot_alive; then
556	        copilot-proxy start >&2 || return 1
557	      fi
558	      local scan
559	      scan="$(_copilot_raycast_scan)" || {
560	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-raycast: could not read the model catalogue from $(_copilot_base)" >&2
561	        return 1
562	      }
563	      local n_ok
564	      n_ok="$(printf '%s\n' "$scan" | command awk -F'\t' '$9 == "ok"' | command grep -c . || true)"
565	      if [ "$n_ok" -eq 0 ]; then
566	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-raycast: no model passed the probe — refusing to write $cfg" >&2
567	        printf '%s\n' "  copilot-proxy doctor    # entitlement or auth problem, not a config one" >&2
568	        return 1
569	      fi
570	      if [ "$dry" = "1" ]; then
571	        printf '%s\n' "$scan" | _copilot_raycast_render "$all"
572	        return $?
573	      fi
574	      printf '%s\n' "$scan" | _copilot_raycast_render "$all" | _copilot_raycast_install || return 1
575	      printf '%s\n' "copilot-raycast: wrote $n_ok model(s) → $cfg"
576	      printf '%s\n' "  base_url $(_copilot_raycast_base_url)   (Raycast reloads within ~5s)"
577	      printf '%s\n' "  copilot-raycast status   # confirm Raycast actually accepted it"
578	      ;;
579	
580	    diff)
581	      if ! command -v diff >/dev/null 2>&1; then
582	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-raycast: diff(1) is required" >&2; return 1
583	      fi
584	      if ! _copilot_alive; then
585	        copilot-proxy start >&2 || return 1
586	      fi
587	      local scan tmp cur
588	      scan="$(_copilot_raycast_scan)" || {
589	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-raycast: could not read the model catalogue from $(_copilot_base)" >&2
590	        return 1
591	      }
592	      tmp="$(command mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/copilot-raycast.XXXXXX")" || return 1
593	      cur="$(command mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/copilot-raycast.XXXXXX")" || return 1
594	      # The `# Probed:` stamp changes on every run by construction, so normalise
595	      # it on BOTH sides — otherwise `diff` could never report "no changes" and
596	      # would be useless as a drift check.
597	      printf '%s\n' "$scan" | _copilot_raycast_render 0 \
598	        | command sed 's/^# Probed: .*/# Probed: <run timestamp>/' >"$tmp" || {
599	        command rm -f -- "$tmp" "$cur"; return 1
600	      }
601	      if [ ! -f "$cfg" ]; then
602	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-raycast: $cfg does not exist yet — generate would create it:"
603	        command cat "$tmp"
604	        command rm -f -- "$tmp" "$cur"
605	        return 0
606	      fi
607	      command sed 's/^# Probed: .*/# Probed: <run timestamp>/' "$cfg" >"$cur"
608	      if command diff -u "$cur" "$tmp" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
609	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-raycast: no changes ($cfg is current)"
610	        command rm -f -- "$tmp" "$cur"
611	        return 0
612	      fi
613	      command diff -u --label "$cfg" --label "generate" "$cur" "$tmp"
614	      command rm -f -- "$tmp" "$cur"
615	      ;;
616	
617	    probe)
618	      if ! _copilot_alive; then
619	        copilot-proxy start >&2 || return 1
620	      fi
621	      if [ -n "${2:-}" ]; then
622	        printf '%s\n' "$(_copilot_raycast_probe_one "$2")"
623	        return 0
624	      fi
625	      local scan
626	      scan="$(_copilot_raycast_scan)" || {
627	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-raycast: could not read the model catalogue from $(_copilot_base)" >&2
628	        return 1
629	      }
630	      printf '\ncopilot-raycast probe   base %s   %s chat model(s)\n\n' \
631	        "$(_copilot_raycast_probe_base)" "$(printf '%s\n' "$scan" | command grep -c .)"
632	      local rank id name vendor ctx vis tools reff verdict flags label
633	      printf '%s\n' "$scan" | while IFS="$(printf '\t')" read -r rank id name vendor ctx vis tools reff verdict; do
634	        flags=''
635	        [ "$vis" = 1 ]   && flags="$flags vision"
636	        [ "$tools" = 1 ] && flags="$flags tools"
637	        [ "$reff" = 1 ]  && flags="$flags reasoning"
638	        case "$verdict" in
639	          ok)             label='OK' ;;
640	          not_supported)  label='NOT_SUPPORTED' ;;
641	          responses_only) label='RESPONSES_ONLY' ;;
642	          no_response)    label='NO_RESPONSE' ;;
643	          *)              label='UNKNOWN' ;;
644	        esac
645	        printf '  %-14s %-26s %9s %s\n' "$label" "$id" "$ctx" "${flags# }"
646	      done
647	      printf '\n'
648	      printf '%s\n' "  OK              usable via /chat/completions — emitted into providers.yaml"
649	      printf '%s\n' "  NOT_SUPPORTED   catalogue lists it, the account is not entitled to it"
650	      printf '%s\n' "  RESPONSES_ONLY  exists, but only on /responses — Raycast cannot reach it"
651	      printf '\n'
652	      ;;
653	
654	    status)
655	      printf '\ncopilot-raycast   config %s\n\n' "$cfg"
656	      if [ -f "$cfg" ]; then
657	        local in_file n_file
658	        if command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
659	          in_file="$(COPILOT_RC_ID="$pid" yq -r \
660	            '.providers[] | select(.id == strenv(COPILOT_RC_ID)) | .models[].id' "$cfg" 2>/dev/null)"
661	        else
662	          # yq-less fallback. The old `grep -E '^[[:space:]]+- id:'` matched
663	          # EVERY indented `- id:` in the file — the provider entries and other
664	          # providers' models included — so with one hand-added provider it
665	          # reported 12 models instead of 9 and then fed those three phantom ids
666	          # to _copilot_raycast_drift, which told the user to regenerate a file
667	          # that was already correct (verified 2026-07). Track the provider we
668	          # are inside instead. Indentation-based, so it only understands the
669	          # shape this tool writes; that is why yq stays the accurate path.
670	          in_file="$(command awk -v pid="$pid" -v sq="'" '
671	            match($0, /^  - id:[[:space:]]*/) {
672	              v = substr($0, RLENGTH + 1)
673	              gsub(/"/, "", v); gsub(sq, "", v); sub(/[ \t]*$/, "", v)
674	              inp = (v == pid); next
675	            }
676	            inp && match($0, /^      - id:[[:space:]]*/) {
677	              v = substr($0, RLENGTH + 1)
678	              gsub(/"/, "", v); gsub(sq, "", v); sub(/[ \t]*$/, "", v)
679	              print v
680	            }
681	          ' "$cfg")"
682	        fi
683	        n_file="$(printf '%s\n' "$in_file" | command grep -c . || true)"
684	        printf '  %-16s %s\n' "file" "present, $n_file model(s) under provider '$pid'"
685	      else
686	        printf '  %-16s %s\n' "file" "absent"
687	        printf '  %-16s → %s\n' "" "copilot-raycast generate"
688	      fi
689	      local loaded n_loaded
690	      loaded="$(_copilot_raycast_loaded)"
691	      n_loaded="$(printf '%s\n' "$loaded" | command grep -c . || true)"
692	      if [ "$n_loaded" -gt 0 ]; then
693	        printf '  %-16s %s\n' "raycast" "$n_loaded model(s) live in the picker"
694	      else
695	        printf '  %-16s %s\n' "raycast" "no models loaded for '$pid' (rejected config, or Raycast never ran)"
696	      fi
697	      printf '  %-16s %s\n' "base_url" "$(_copilot_raycast_base_url)"
698	      if _copilot_shim_enabled; then
699	        printf '  %-16s %s\n' "shim" "on (:$(_copilot_shim_port))"
700	      else
701	        printf '  %-16s %s\n' "shim" "off — base_url points straight at the fork"
702	      fi
703	      if ! _copilot_alive; then
704	        printf '  %-16s %s\n' "proxy" "not running — cannot check drift"
705	        printf '  %-16s → %s\n' "" "copilot-proxy start"
706	        printf '\n'
707	        return 0
708	      fi
709	      local scan live drift n_live
710	      scan="$(_copilot_raycast_scan)" || { printf '\n'; return 0; }
711	      live="$(printf '%s\n' "$scan" | command awk -F'\t' '$9 == "ok" { print $2 }' | command sort)"
712	      n_live="$(printf '%s\n' "$live" | command grep -c . || true)"
713	      printf '  %-16s %s\n' "live usable" "$n_live model(s) pass the probe"
714	      if [ -f "$cfg" ]; then
715	        drift="$(_copilot_raycast_drift "${in_file:-}" "$live")"
716	        if [ -z "$drift" ]; then
717	          printf '  %-16s %s\n' "drift" "none — the file matches the live catalogue"
718	        else
719	          printf '  %-16s %s\n' "drift" "$(printf '%s\n' "$drift" | command grep -c .) difference(s)"
720	          printf '%s\n' "$drift"
721	          printf '  %-16s → %s\n' "" "copilot-raycast generate"
722	        fi
723	      fi
724	      printf '\n'
725	      ;;
726	
727	    doctor|test)
728	      # Colour only when stdout is a terminal, so `copilot-raycast doctor | tee`
729	      # and CI capture stay readable. printf (not $'..') keeps this sh-portable.
730	      local _g='' _r_='' _y='' _z=''
731	      if [ -t 1 ]; then
732	        _g="$(printf '\033[32m')"; _r_="$(printf '\033[31m')"
733	        _y="$(printf '\033[33m')"; _z="$(printf '\033[0m')"
734	      fi
735	
736	      local _fail=0 _warn=0
737	      _ok()   { printf '  %s✓%s %-16s %s\n' "$_g" "$_z" "$1" "$2"; }
738	      _bad()  { printf '  %s✗%s %-16s %s\n' "$_r_" "$_z" "$1" "$2"; _fail=$((_fail+1)); }
739	      _note() { printf '  %s!%s %-16s %s\n' "$_y" "$_z" "$1" "$2"; _warn=$((_warn+1)); }
740	      _skip() { printf '  · %-16s %s\n' "$1" "$2"; }
741	      _hint() { printf '    %-16s → %s\n' "" "$1"; }
742	
743	      printf '\ncopilot-raycast doctor   base %s   config %s\n\n' \
744	        "$(_copilot_raycast_base_url)" "$cfg"
745	
746	      printf '%s\n' "Prerequisites"
747	      local _tool
748	      for _tool in curl jq yq; do
749	        if command -v "$_tool" >/dev/null 2>&1; then _ok "$_tool" "$(command -v "$_tool")"
750	        elif [ "$_tool" = yq ]; then
751	          _note "$_tool" "not found — no YAML validation, and foreign providers can't be preserved"
752	          _hint "brew install yq"
753	        else _bad "$_tool" "not found"; fi
