652	function script:Invoke-CopilotOptionalHttpProbe {
653	    param(
654	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Uri,
655	        [string] $Via = 'direct'
656	    )
657	
658	    $transport = @{}
659	    if ($Via -eq 'direct') { $transport['NoProxy'] = $true }
660	    elseif ($Via) { $transport['Proxy'] = $Via }
661	
662	    $sw = [System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
663	    try {
664	        $response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $Uri -Method Get -TimeoutSec 12 `
665	            -SkipHttpErrorCheck -Headers @{ 'user-agent' = 'codex-copilot-doctor/1.0' } `
666	            @transport -ErrorAction Stop
667	        $sw.Stop()
668	        [pscustomobject]@{
669	            Reached = $true
670	            Code    = [int]$response.StatusCode
671	            Seconds = [math]::Round($sw.Elapsed.TotalSeconds, 2)
672	            Kind    = $null
673	            Error   = $null
674	        }
675	    } catch {
676	        $sw.Stop()
677	        [pscustomobject]@{
678	            Reached = $false
679	            Code    = 0
680	            Seconds = [math]::Round($sw.Elapsed.TotalSeconds, 2)
681	            Kind    = Get-CopilotProbeFailureKind $_
682	            Error   = ($_.Exception.Message -replace '\s+', ' ').Trim()
683	        }
684	    }
685	}

711	# Resolve the model: $COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL > state file > default.
712	#
713	#   - HYPHENATED ids (claude-opus-4-8), not dotted (claude-opus-4.8): Claude Code
714	#     only recognizes hyphenated family names — dotted ids fall back to a legacy
715	#     "[Opus 4] retired" label AND a 200k context assumption.
716	#   - "[1m]" suffix: Claude Code uses it to size HUD/compaction for a 1M context
717	#     window. ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel derives it from live /v1/models metadata
718	#     for every provider. Claude Code-only: raw API clients use the plain id.
719	function script:Get-CopilotDefaultModel {
720	    if ($env:COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL) { return $env:COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL }
721	    $sf = Get-CopilotModelState
722	    if (Test-Path $sf) { return (Get-Content -First 1 $sf) }
723	    'gpt-5.6-sol[1m]'
724	}

727	# with several catalog views pass one snapshot so all decisions share one response.
728	function script:Get-CopilotServedModels {
729	    param($Catalog)
730	    if (-not $PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('Catalog')) { $Catalog = Get-CopilotModelCatalog }
731	    if (-not $Catalog) { return @() }
732	    $ids = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()

736	    }
737	    $ids | Sort-Object -Unique

761	    param([string] $ConfiguredMain, [string[]] $RawModel)

787	function script:ConvertTo-CopilotCompactText {
788	    param($Value, [int] $MaxLength = 320)
789	    $text = if ($Value -is [string]) { $Value } else {
790	        try { $Value | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 12 -Compress -ErrorAction Stop } catch { [string]$Value }
791	    }
792	    $text = ($text -replace '\s+', ' ').Trim()
793	    if ($text.Length -gt $MaxLength) { return $text.Substring(0, $MaxLength - 3) + '...' }
794	    $text
795	}

797	# Error bodies appear as direct code/message pairs, error.code/error.message, or
798	# another JSON error encoded inside error.message. Normalize all three shapes.
799	function script:Get-CopilotApiError {
800	    param($Body, [int] $Depth = 0)
801	    $raw = ConvertTo-CopilotCompactText $Body
802	    if ($Depth -gt 4) {
803	        return [pscustomobject]@{ Code = $null; Message = $null; Raw = $raw }
804	    }
805	
806	    $object = $Body
807	    if ($Body -is [string]) {
808	        try { $object = $Body | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop }
809	        catch { return [pscustomobject]@{ Code = $null; Message = $null; Raw = $raw } }
810	    }
811	    if (-not $object) { return [pscustomobject]@{ Code = $null; Message = $null; Raw = $raw } }
812	
813	    $container = $object
814	    if ($object.PSObject.Properties['error']) {
815	        $container = $object.error
816	        if ($container -is [string]) {
817	            $nestedError = Get-CopilotApiError -Body $container -Depth ($Depth + 1)
818	            if ($nestedError.Code -or $nestedError.Message) { return $nestedError }
819	        }
820	    }
821	
822	    $code = if ($container.PSObject.Properties['code']) { [string]$container.code } else { $null }
823	    $message = if ($container.PSObject.Properties['message']) { [string]$container.message } else { $null }
824	    if ($message -and $message.TrimStart().StartsWith('{')) {
825	        $nestedMessage = Get-CopilotApiError -Body $message -Depth ($Depth + 1)
826	        if ($nestedMessage.Code -or $nestedMessage.Message) {
827	            return [pscustomobject]@{
828	                Code    = if ($nestedMessage.Code) { $nestedMessage.Code } else { $code }
829	                Message = if ($nestedMessage.Message) { $nestedMessage.Message } else { $message }
830	                Raw     = $raw
831	            }
832	        }
833	    }
834	    [pscustomobject]@{ Code = $code; Message = $message; Raw = $raw }
835	}
836	
837	function script:Classify-CopilotInferenceError {
838	    param([int] $StatusCode, $Body)
839	    $errorInfo = Get-CopilotApiError -Body $Body
840	    $code = ([string]$errorInfo.Code).ToLowerInvariant()
841	    $detailParts = @($errorInfo.Code, $errorInfo.Message) | Where-Object { $_ }
842	    $detail = $detailParts -join ': '
843	    if (-not $detail) { $detail = $errorInfo.Raw }
844	
845	    if ($StatusCode -eq 402 -and $code -eq 'billing_not_configured') {
846	        return [pscustomobject]@{
847	            Kind        = 'BillingNotConfigured'
848	            Code        = $errorInfo.Code
849	            Message     = $errorInfo.Message
850	            Summary     = "account-wide GitHub Copilot billing is not configured: $detail"
851	            Retryable   = $false
852	            AccountWide = $true
853	            Action      = 'https://github.com/settings/copilot/features'
854	            Guidance    = 'Select an organization or enterprise in GitHub''s "Usage billed to" setting. Changing the model, using --auto, or enabling the shim cannot fix this account-wide failure.'
855	        }
856	    }
857	
858	    if ($code -match '^(model_not_supported|model_unsupported|unsupported_model)$') {
859	        return [pscustomobject]@{
860	            Kind        = 'ModelUnsupported'
861	            Code        = $errorInfo.Code
862	            Message     = $errorInfo.Message
863	            Summary     = $detail
864	            Retryable   = $false
865	            AccountWide = $false
866	            Action      = 'Run copilot-model --auto, or copilot-model -l and select a model advertised by the live catalog.'
867	            Guidance    = $null
868	        }
869	    }
870	
871	    [pscustomobject]@{
872	        Kind        = 'HttpError'
873	        Code        = $errorInfo.Code
874	        Message     = $errorInfo.Message
875	        Summary     = $detail
876	        Retryable   = ($StatusCode -eq 429 -or $StatusCode -ge 500)
877	        AccountWide = $false
878	        Action      = $null
879	        Guidance    = $null
880	    }
881	}

883	# Convert a raw proxy id to the spelling Claude Code should receive. A live
884	# max_context_window_tokens >= 1M earns [1m]. Offline, preserve an explicitly
885	# stored suffix but do not invent one.
886	function script:ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel {
887	    param([Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Model, $Catalog)
888	    $hadHint = $Model -match '\[1m\]$'
889	    $raw = Remove-CopilotContextHint $Model
890	    if (-not $PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('Catalog')) { $Catalog = Get-CopilotModelCatalog }
891	    if ($Catalog) {
892	        $entry = $Catalog.data | Where-Object { $_.id -eq $raw } | Select-Object -First 1
893	        $context = $entry.capabilities.limits.max_context_window_tokens
894	        if ($context -and [long]$context -ge 1000000) { return "$raw[1m]" }
895	        return $raw
896	    }
897	    if ($hadHint) { return "$raw[1m]" }
898	    $raw
899	}

907	# Build the complete Claude Code role profile for a selected main model. Native
908	# Claude profiles use the strongest served model in each family. OpenAI profiles
909	# map quality/balanced/fast work to the selected main, Terra and Luna.
910	function script:Get-CopilotModelProfile {
911	    param([string] $Model = (Get-CopilotDefaultModel), $Catalog)
912	    if (-not $PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('Catalog')) { $Catalog = Get-CopilotModelCatalog }
913	    $models = Get-CopilotCatalogIds $Catalog
914	    $raw = Remove-CopilotContextHint $Model
915	    $main = ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel -Model $Model -Catalog $Catalog
916	
917	    $fableRaw = $raw; $opusRaw = $raw; $sonnetRaw = $raw; $haikuRaw = $raw
918	    if ($raw -like 'claude-*') {
919	        $fableRaw = Select-CopilotFirstServed -Model $models -Candidate @('claude-fable-5')
920	        if (-not $fableRaw) { $fableRaw = @($models | Where-Object { $_ -like 'claude-fable-*' } | Sort-Object)[-1] }
921	        if (-not $fableRaw) { $fableRaw = $raw }
922	
923	        $opusRaw = Select-CopilotFirstServed -Model $models -Candidate @(
924	            'claude-opus-5', 'claude-opus-4-8', 'claude-opus-4-7', 'claude-opus-4-6', 'claude-opus-4-5'
925	        )
926	        if (-not $opusRaw) { $opusRaw = @($models | Where-Object { $_ -like 'claude-opus-*' } | Sort-Object)[-1] }
927	        if (-not $opusRaw) { $opusRaw = $raw }
928	
929	        $sonnetRaw = Select-CopilotFirstServed -Model $models -Candidate @(
930	            'claude-sonnet-5', 'claude-sonnet-4-6', 'claude-sonnet-4-5'
931	        )
932	        if (-not $sonnetRaw) { $sonnetRaw = @($models | Where-Object { $_ -like 'claude-sonnet-*' } | Sort-Object)[-1] }
933	        if (-not $sonnetRaw) { $sonnetRaw = $raw }
934	
935	        $haikuRaw = Select-CopilotFirstServed -Model $models -Candidate @('claude-haiku-4-5')
936	        if (-not $haikuRaw) { $haikuRaw = @($models | Where-Object { $_ -like 'claude-haiku-*' } | Sort-Object)[-1] }
937	        if (-not $haikuRaw) { $haikuRaw = $raw }
938	    }
939	    elseif ($raw -like 'gpt-*' -or $raw -match 'codex') {
940	        $sonnetRaw = Select-CopilotFirstServed -Model $models -Candidate @('gpt-5.6-terra')
941	        if (-not $sonnetRaw) { $sonnetRaw = $raw }
942	        $haikuRaw = Select-CopilotFirstServed -Model $models -Candidate @('gpt-5.6-luna', 'gpt-5.4-mini', 'gpt-5-mini')
943	        if (-not $haikuRaw) { $haikuRaw = $raw }
944	    }
945	
946	    [ordered]@{
947	        main   = $main
948	        fable  = ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel -Model $fableRaw -Catalog $Catalog
949	        opus   = ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel -Model $opusRaw -Catalog $Catalog
950	        sonnet = ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel -Model $sonnetRaw -Catalog $Catalog
951	        haiku  = ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel -Model $haikuRaw -Catalog $Catalog
952	    }
953	}

964	# "<model>|<source>" — the model Claude Code would send from this directory.
965	function script:Get-CopilotEffectiveModel {
966	    param([string] $Settings = '.claude/settings.local.json')
967	    $settings = $Settings
968	    if (Test-Path $settings) {
969	        try {
970	            $j = Get-Content -Raw $settings | ConvertFrom-Json
971	            if ($j.env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL) {
972	                $m = $j.env.ANTHROPIC_MODEL
973	                if ($m) { return "$m|project pin: $settings" }
974	                return "|project pin missing ANTHROPIC_MODEL: $settings"
975	            }
976	        } catch { $null = $_ }
977	    }
978	    if ($env:COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL) { return "$($env:COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL)|`$COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL" }
979	    $sf = Get-CopilotModelState
980	    if (Test-Path $sf) { return "$(Get-Content -First 1 $sf)|state file: $sf" }
981	    "$(Get-CopilotDefaultModel)|built-in default"
982	}

984	# The EXACT env block `copilot-here on` / `copilot-run` would apply right now.
985	#
986	# SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for three callers: copilot-run (process env),
987	# `copilot-here on` (what it merges into settings.local.json) and
988	# Get-CopilotHereDrift (what it compares against). These used to be hand-maintained
989	# copies and they diverged — the drift check compared 4 of the 8 keys `on` writes,
990	# so a pin missing ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL / ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL /
991	# CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC reported "no drift" while `on` would
992	# still have changed it. Add a key here and all three follow.
993	#
994	# -Pinned uses the shim base when the shim is enabled but not yet up (what a
995	# written-to-disk pin should say); copilot-run wants the live base instead.
996	function script:Get-CopilotEnvBlock {
997	    param([switch] $Pinned, [string] $Model = (Get-CopilotDefaultModel), $Catalog)
998	    $modelProfile = if ($PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('Catalog')) {
999	        Get-CopilotModelProfile -Model $Model -Catalog $Catalog
1000	    } else {
1001	        Get-CopilotModelProfile -Model $Model
1002	    }
1003	    $block = [ordered]@{
1004	        ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL             = if ($Pinned) { Get-CopilotPinnedBase } else { Get-CopilotClientBase }
1005	        ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN           = 'dummy'
1006	        ANTHROPIC_MODEL                = $modelProfile.main
1007	        ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL  = $modelProfile.fable
1008	        ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL   = $modelProfile.opus
1009	        ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL = $modelProfile.sonnet
1010	        ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL  = $modelProfile.haiku
1011	        ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL     = $modelProfile.haiku
1012	        CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC = '1'
1013	    }
1014	    if ($env:COPILOT_PROXY_QUIET -eq '1') {
1015	        $block.CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER = '0'
1016	        $block.CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_PROMPT_SUGGESTION = 'false'
1017	        $block.CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AWAY_SUMMARY = '0'
1018	        $block.DISABLE_NON_ESSENTIAL_MODEL_CALLS = '1'
1019	    }
1020	    $block
1021	}

1023	# --- shim start/stop ---
1024	function script:Start-CopilotShim {
1025	    if (Test-CopilotShimAlive) { return $true }
1026	    if (-not (Get-Command bun -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
1027	        Write-Error "copilot-proxy: shim needs 'bun' (scoop install bun)"; return $false
1028	    }
1029	    $script = Get-CopilotShimScript
1030	    if (-not (Test-Path $script)) { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: shim script not found at $script"; return $false }
1031	    $env:COPILOT_SHIM_PORT = Get-CopilotShimPort
1032	    $env:COPILOT_SHIM_UPSTREAM = Get-CopilotBase
1033	    $p = Start-Process -FilePath 'bun' -ArgumentList @($script) -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden `
1034	        -RedirectStandardOutput (Get-CopilotShimLog) -RedirectStandardError "$(Get-CopilotShimLog).err"
1035	    $p.Id | Set-Content -Path (Get-CopilotShimPid)
1036	    for ($i = 0; $i -lt 10; $i++) { if (Test-CopilotShimAlive) { return $true }; Start-Sleep 1 }
1037	    Write-Error "copilot-proxy: shim did not come up — check $(Get-CopilotShimLog)"; $false
1038	}
1039	function script:Stop-CopilotShim {
1040	    $pidf = Get-CopilotShimPid
1041	    if (Test-Path $pidf) {
1042	        $pid_ = Get-Content -First 1 $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
1043	        if ($pid_) { Stop-Process -Id $pid_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
1044	        Remove-Item $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
1045	    }
1046	    Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name = 'bun.exe'" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
1047	        Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*copilot-throttle-shim.js*' } |
1048	        ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
1049	}

1051	# ============================================================ copilot-proxy ===
1052	function copilot-proxy {
1053	    [CmdletBinding()]
1054	    param([Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments)] [string[]] $Argv)
1055	
1056	    if (-not (Get-Command bun -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
1057	        Write-Error "copilot-proxy: bun not found (scoop install bun)"; return
1058	    }
1059	
1060	    $port = Get-CopilotPort; $pkg = Get-CopilotPkg
1061	    $logf = Get-CopilotLogFile; $pidf = Get-CopilotPidFile
1062	    $action = if ($Argv -and $Argv.Count -ge 1) { $Argv[0] } else { 'status' }
1063	
1064	    switch ($action) {
1065	        'start' {
1066	            if (Test-CopilotAlive) { Write-Host "copilot-proxy: already running on port $port"; return }
1067	            if (-not (Test-Path (Get-CopilotToken))) {
1068	                Write-Error "copilot-proxy: not authenticated yet — run 'copilot-proxy auth' first."; return
1069	            }
1070	            # Rotate the previous session's log (keep last 3).
1071	            if (Test-Path $logf) {
1072	                Remove-Item "$logf.3" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
1073	                if (Test-Path "$logf.2") { Move-Item -Force "$logf.2" "$logf.3" }
1074	                if (Test-Path "$logf.1") { Move-Item -Force "$logf.1" "$logf.2" }
1075	                Move-Item -Force $logf "$logf.1"
1076	            }
1077	            # Install the pinned package BEFORE launching anything. Resolving it at
1078	            # launch (the old `bunx <pkg> start`) is what used to hang forever behind
1079	            # a socks proxy, with nothing but "Resolving dependencies" in the log.
1080	            if (-not (Install-CopilotPkg)) { return }
1081	            $launch = Get-CopilotPkgLaunch
1082	            if (-not $launch) { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: no runnable copilot-api after install"; return }
1083	
1084	            # Node ignores the Windows System Proxy — it only honours HTTP(S)_PROXY,
1085	            # and the fork additionally needs --proxy-env before its fetch uses them.
1086	            $httpProxy = Resolve-CopilotHttpProxy
1087	            if ($httpProxy) {
1088	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: Node will fetch /models via $httpProxy (--proxy-env; COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=$(if ($env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY) { $env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY } else { 'auto' }))"
1089	            } elseif ($env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY -in 'always', 'on', '1', 'true', 'yes') {
1090	                Write-Warning "copilot-proxy: COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=always but no proxy detected — starting DIRECT (the Claude catalog may be geo-filtered)."
1091	                Write-Host "  hint: enable the Clash/Verge System Proxy, or set COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:7897"
1092	            }
1093	
1094	            $argList = @($launch.Pre + @('start', '--port', $port))
1095	            if ((Get-CopilotPkgFlavor) -eq 'original') {
1096	                $rate = if ($env:COPILOT_PROXY_RATE) { $env:COPILOT_PROXY_RATE } else { '15' }
1097	                # Original package: HTTPS_PROXY alone is enough (it has no --proxy-env).
1098	                $argList += @('--rate-limit', $rate, '--wait')
1099	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: starting ($pkg) on port $port (rate-limit ${rate}s) ..."
1100	            } else {
1101	                if ($httpProxy) { $argList += '--proxy-env' }
1102	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: starting ($pkg) on port $port ..."
1103	            }
1104	
1105	            # Scope the proxy env to the child: set, spawn, restore.
1106	            $proxyVars = 'HTTP_PROXY', 'HTTPS_PROXY', 'http_proxy', 'https_proxy'
1107	            $saved = @{}
1108	            if ($httpProxy) {
1109	                foreach ($v in $proxyVars) { $saved[$v] = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($v); Set-Item "env:$v" $httpProxy }
1110	            }
1111	            try {
1112	                $spArgs = @{
1113	                    FilePath                = $launch.Exe
1114	                    ArgumentList            = $argList
1115	                    PassThru                = $true
1116	                    WindowStyle             = 'Hidden'
1117	                    RedirectStandardOutput  = $logf
1118	                    RedirectStandardError   = "$logf.err"
1119	                }
1120	                if ($launch.Cwd) { $spArgs.WorkingDirectory = $launch.Cwd }
1121	                $p = Start-Process @spArgs
1122	            } finally {
1123	                if ($httpProxy) {
1124	                    foreach ($v in $proxyVars) {
1125	                        if ($null -eq $saved[$v]) { Remove-Item "env:$v" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
1126	                        else { Set-Item "env:$v" $saved[$v] }
1127	                    }
1128	                }
1129	            }
1130	            $p.Id | Set-Content -Path $pidf
1131	            $startTimeout = if ($env:COPILOT_PROXY_START_TIMEOUT) { [int]$env:COPILOT_PROXY_START_TIMEOUT } else { 45 }
1132	            for ($i = 0; $i -lt $startTimeout; $i++) {
1133	                if (Test-CopilotAlive) {
1134	                    if (Get-CopilotShimEnabled) {
1135	                        if (Start-CopilotShim) { Write-Host "copilot-proxy: throttle shim up -> $(Get-CopilotShimBase) (-> $(Get-CopilotBase))" }
1136	                    }
1137	                    Write-Host "copilot-proxy: up -> $(Get-CopilotClientBase)  (logs: copilot-proxy logs)"
1138	                    return
1139	                }
1140	                # Crashed on its own (bad flag, port taken, auth) — don't sit out the
1141	                # remaining seconds pretending we're still waiting.
1142	                if ($p.HasExited) {
1143	                    Remove-Item $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
1144	                    Write-Error "copilot-proxy: server exited during startup — check 'copilot-proxy logs'."; return
1145	                }
1146	                Start-Sleep 1
1147	            }
1148	            # Timed out. REAP what we spawned: the old code returned and left it
1149	            # running, so each retry stacked another orphan and none ever bound the port.
1150	            Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
1151	            Remove-Item $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
1152	            Write-Error "copilot-proxy: did not come up in time — check 'copilot-proxy logs'."
1153	        }
1154	        'stop' {
1155	            Stop-CopilotShim
1156	            if (Test-Path $pidf) {
1157	                $pid_ = Get-Content -First 1 $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
1158	                if ($pid_) { Stop-Process -Id $pid_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
1159	                Remove-Item $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
1160	            }
1161	            Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
1162	                Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like "*copilot-api*--port $port*" } |
1163	                ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
1164	            Start-Sleep 1
1165	            if (Test-CopilotAlive) { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: still answering on $port (another instance?)"; return }
1166	            Write-Host "copilot-proxy: stopped (port $port free)"
1167	        }
1168	        'restart' { copilot-proxy stop; copilot-proxy start }
1169	        'status' {
1170	            if (Test-CopilotAlive) {
1171	                $catalog = Get-CopilotModelCatalog
1172	                $rawIds = Get-CopilotCatalogIds $catalog
1173	                $claude = @($rawIds | Where-Object { $_ -like 'claude-*' })
1174	                $claudeText = if ($claude.Count -gt 0) { $claude -join ' ' } else { 'none' }
1175	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: RUNNING on $(Get-CopilotBase)"
1176	                Write-Host "  models: $($rawIds.Count) served; Claude: $claudeText"
1177	                if (Get-CopilotShimEnabled) {
1178	                    if (Test-CopilotShimAlive) { Write-Host "  shim:   ON, up on $(Get-CopilotShimBase)  -> clients use this" }
1179	                    else { Write-Host "  shim:   ON but DOWN (clients fall back to $(Get-CopilotBase))" }
1180	                } else { Write-Host "  shim:   off  (enable: copilot-proxy shim on)" }
1181	            } else {
1182	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: not running on port $port  (start: copilot-proxy start)"
1183	            }
1184	        }
1185	        { $_ -in 'doctor', 'test' } { Invoke-CopilotDoctor -Live:($Argv -contains '--live') }
1186	        'logs' {
1187	            if ($Argv.Count -ge 2 -and $Argv[1] -eq 'shim') {
1188	                $lf = Get-CopilotShimLog; $n = if ($Argv.Count -ge 3) { [int]$Argv[2] } else { 40 }
1189	            } else {
1190	                $lf = $logf; $n = if ($Argv.Count -ge 2) { [int]$Argv[1] } else { 40 }
1191	                if ($Argv.Count -ge 3 -and $Argv[2] -in '1', '2', '3') { $lf = "$logf.$($Argv[2])" }
1192	            }
1193	            if (Test-Path $lf) { Get-Content -Tail $n $lf }
1194	            elseif (Test-Path "$lf.err") { Get-Content -Tail $n "$lf.err" }
1195	            else { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: no log file at $lf" }
1196	        }
1197	        'auth' {
1198	            # One-time device login -> stores a ghu_ token copilot-api can exchange.
1199	            Write-Host "copilot-proxy: launching copilot-api device login ..."
1200	            if ((Get-CopilotPkgFlavor) -eq 'original') { Invoke-CopilotPkgCommand auth }
1201	            else { Invoke-CopilotPkgCommand auth login --provider copilot }
1202	        }
1203	        'reinstall' {
1204	            # Force a clean re-install of the pinned spec (normally only needed if the
1205	            # prefix got corrupted — a version bump re-installs on its own via the stamp).
1206	            Write-Host "copilot-proxy: removing $(Get-CopilotPkgPrefix) ..."
1207	            Remove-Item -Recurse -Force (Get-CopilotPkgPrefix) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
1208	            if (-not (Install-CopilotPkg)) { return }
1209	            $installed = Get-CopilotPkgMetadata
1210	            Write-Host "copilot-proxy: installed $($installed.Name)@$($installed.Version) (requested $(Get-CopilotPkg)) -> $(Get-CopilotPkgPrefix)"
1211	        }
1212	        { $_ -in 'whoami', 'usage' } {
1213	            if (-not (Test-Path (Get-CopilotToken))) { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: not authenticated — run 'copilot-proxy auth'."; return }
1214	            if ((Get-CopilotPkgFlavor) -eq 'original') {
1215	                Invoke-CopilotPkgCommand check-usage
1216	            }
1217	            elseif (Test-CopilotAlive) {
1218	                try {
1219	                    $u = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$(Get-CopilotBase)/usage" -TimeoutSec 5 -ErrorAction Stop
1220	                    [pscustomobject]@{
1221	                        plan        = if ($u.copilot_plan) { $u.copilot_plan } elseif ($u.access_type_sku) { $u.access_type_sku } else { 'unknown' }
1222	                        quota_reset = $u.quota_reset_date
1223	                        quotas      = $u.quota_snapshots
1224	                    } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6
1225	                } catch { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: /usage query failed: $_" }
1226	            } else {
1227	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: not running — showing auth/debug info instead of quota."
1228	                Invoke-CopilotPkgCommand debug
1229	            }
1230	        }
1231	        'shim' {
1232	            $sf = Get-CopilotShimState
1233	            $sub = if ($Argv.Count -ge 2) { $Argv[1] } else { 'status' }
1234	            switch ($sub) {
1235	                'on' {
1236	                    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Split-Path $sf) | Out-Null
1237	                    'on' | Set-Content $sf
1238	                    if (Test-CopilotAlive) { if (Start-CopilotShim) { Write-Host "copilot-proxy: shim ON -> $(Get-CopilotShimBase) (-> $(Get-CopilotBase))" } }
1239	                    else { Write-Host "copilot-proxy: shim enabled; will start with the proxy." }
1240	                    Write-Host "  NOTE: restart Claude Code so it picks up ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=$(Get-CopilotShimBase)"
1241	                }
1242	                'off' {
1243	                    'off' | Set-Content $sf; Stop-CopilotShim
1244	                    Write-Host "copilot-proxy: shim OFF (clients use $(Get-CopilotBase) directly)"
1245	                }
1246	                default {
1247	                    if (Get-CopilotShimEnabled) {
1248	                        $st = if (Test-CopilotShimAlive) { 'up' } else { 'down' }
1249	                        Write-Host "copilot-proxy: shim ON ($st) on $(Get-CopilotShimBase)"
1250	                    } else { Write-Host "copilot-proxy: shim off" }
1251	                }
1252	            }
1253	        }
1254	        { $_ -in '-h', '--help', 'help' } {
1255	            Write-Host "Usage: copilot-proxy [start|stop|restart|status|doctor [--live]|logs [shim|N [gen]]|shim [on|off|status]|whoami|auth|reinstall]"
1256	            Write-Host "  doctor (alias: test)  diagnose prereqs, package, auth, proxy, Claude catalog, Codex Apps"
1257	            Write-Host "                        (direct vs via proxy), upstream. --live costs 1 quota unit."
1258	            Write-Host "  COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY    auto|always|never|http://127.0.0.1:PORT  (default auto)"
1259	            Write-Host "                        auto attaches --proxy-env when a System/env proxy is found."
1260	            Write-Host "  reinstall             wipe + re-install the pinned package (a version bump"
1261	            Write-Host "                        re-installs on its own; this is for a corrupted prefix)."
1262	        }
1263	        default { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: unknown action '$action' (try --help)" }
1264	    }
1265	}
1266	
1267	# ------------------------------------------------------------------ doctor ----
1268	function script:Invoke-CopilotDoctor {
1269	    param([switch] $Live)
1270	    $port = Get-CopilotPort; $pkg = Get-CopilotPkg
1271	    $fail = 0; $warn = 0
1272	    function OK   ($n, $m) { Write-Host ("  " + [char]0x2713 + " {0,-16} {1}" -f $n, $m) -ForegroundColor Green }
1273	    function BAD  ($n, $m) { Write-Host ("  " + [char]0x2717 + " {0,-16} {1}" -f $n, $m) -ForegroundColor Red; $script:fail++ }
1274	    function NOTE ($n, $m) { Write-Host ("  ! {0,-16} {1}" -f $n, $m) -ForegroundColor Yellow; $script:warn++ }
1275	    function SKIP ($n, $m) { Write-Host ("  " + [char]0x00B7 + " {0,-16} {1}" -f $n, $m) }
1276	    function HINT ($m)     { Write-Host ("    {0,-16} -> {1}" -f '', $m) }
1277	    $script:fail = 0; $script:warn = 0
1278	
1279	    Write-Host "`ncopilot-proxy doctor   port $port   pkg $pkg`n"
1280	
1281	    # This is the doctor's only /v1/models fetch. The same snapshot determines
1282	    # liveness, raw ids, aliases, role checks and the optional live target.
1283	    $catalog = Get-CopilotModelCatalog
1284	    $proxyAlive = $null -ne $catalog
1285	
1286	    Write-Host 'Prerequisites'
1287	    foreach ($t in 'bun', 'node', 'uv') {
1288	        $c = Get-Command $t -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
1289	        if ($c) { OK $t $c.Source } elseif ($t -eq 'uv') { NOTE $t 'not found — semsearch needs it' } else { BAD $t 'not found' }
1290	    }
1291	
1292	    Write-Host "`nPackage"
1293	    # The proxy runs an INSTALLED binary, not `bunx <pkg>` — so a warm start does no
1294	    # network at all. Report live metadata even when it disagrees with the selector.
1295	    $installedMetadata = Get-CopilotPkgMetadata
1296	    $installedStamp = Get-CopilotPkgStampMetadata
1297	    $launch = Get-CopilotPkgLaunch
1298	    if (Test-CopilotPkgReady) {
1299	        OK 'installed' "$($installedMetadata.Name)@$($installedMetadata.Version) (requested $pkg)"
1300	        $how = "$($launch.Exe) $($launch.Pre -join ' ')".Trim()

1	# 43_copilot_proxy.sh - GitHub Copilot agent gateway for Claude Code and Codex
2	#   (shared bash + zsh).
3	#
4	# Runs the maintained copilot-api fork (caozhiyuan/copilot-api, npm
5	# @jeffreycao/copilot-api) so a GitHub Copilot subscription can back Claude Code,
6	# Codex, and any OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible client. The original ericc-ch/copilot-api
7	# is unmaintained (its issue #233 points at the fork) but still works via
8	# COPILOT_API_PKG=copilot-api@0.7.0 — flags differ per package, see
9	# _copilot_pkg_flavor. Both packages share the same token file, so switching
10	# needs no re-auth. Full guide + risks: docs/tools/copilot-claude-proxy.md.
11	#
12	# Public surface:
13	#   copilot-proxy [start|stop|status|restart|doctor|logs|whoami|auth]  - manage the proxy
14	#   copilot-proxy doctor [--live]  - diagnose prereqs/auth/proxy/model-entitlement/
15	#                                upstream; --live sends one real request. The
16	#                                model-entitlement check catches the common
17	#                                "400 model_not_supported" case, where a Copilot
18	#                                plan serves no Anthropic models at all — that
19	#                                looks like a network fault in the logs but is an
20	#                                account-policy fact.
21	#   copilot-run <cmd...>       - run any command with the proxy env injected
22	#                                (auto-starts the proxy first)
23	#   claude-copilot [args...]   - one-off Claude Code session on the proxy
24	#                                (specstory-wrapped when available; zero file writes)
25	#   claude-copilot-once [args...] - one-shot session via the copilot-here pin
26	#                                (settings.local.json; auto-reverted, even on Ctrl-C)
27	#   codex-copilot [args...]    - one-off Codex session on the Responses gateway
28	#   codex-copilot-once [args...] - identical zero-persistence spelling
29	#   copilot-here [on|off|status] - sticky per-project toggle via the gitignored
30	#                                ./.claude/settings.local.json (never touches the
31	#                                committed .claude/settings.json)
32	#   copilot-model [<id>|-l|-c|--auto] - switch the pinned model (edits settings.local.json
33	#                                when copilot-here is on, else the global state file;
34	#                                --auto = Claude, else capability-ranked OpenAI,
35	#                                then Gemini; -c also shows the role profile)
36	#
37	# Settings-layer design (why settings.local.json / env vars, and NOT the
38	# committed .claude/settings.json nor ~/.claude/settings.json):
39	#   - ~/.claude/settings.json is chezmoi-managed (dot_claude/modify_settings.json)
40	#     and would make the proxy always-on for every project.
41	#   - ./.claude/settings.json is committed (claude-plans-here puts plansDirectory
42	#     there) — proxy config must not leak into git.
43	#   - Claude Code precedence (low→high): user < project < settings.local.json
44	#     (gitignored) < CLI flags. GOTCHA (verified 2026-07): current Claude Code
45	#     lets the settings.local.json env block BEAT inherited shell env vars —
46	#     so copilot-run/claude-copilot cannot override a project where
47	#     `copilot-here on` points elsewhere (run `copilot-here off` first).
48	#
49	# Portability notes (POSIX subset, both shells source this file):
50	#   - the pinned package is INSTALLED ONCE into _copilot_pkg_prefix and the proxy
51	#     runs that binary directly. It deliberately does NOT use `bunx` at launch:
52	#     bunx re-resolves the package on every start, and bun stalls forever
53	#     resolving through a socks ALL_PROXY — which wedged `start` at "Resolving
54	#     dependencies" AND kept bun's global cache lock, so every retry hung too.
55	#     See pitfalls/copilot-proxy-start-hangs-at-resolving-dependencies.md.
56	#     Override the spec with COPILOT_API_PKG; force a re-install with
57	#     `copilot-proxy reinstall`.
58	#   - no ZLE/compdef/setopt/glob-qualifiers here (bash would error on source).
59	#
60	# Env (set in ~/.shellrc.adhoc or ~/.config/{zsh/secrets.zsh,bash/secrets.sh}):
61	#   COPILOT_PROXY_PORT   default: 4141        - port the proxy listens on
62	#   COPILOT_PROXY_START_TIMEOUT default: 45   - seconds allowed for the startup
63	#                                               model-catalog fetch
64	#   COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY   default: auto        - Node→GitHub /models egress:
65	#                          auto   = if proxy-status finds Clash/Verge/mihomo (or
66	#                                   macOS System Proxy), start with --proxy-env
67	#                                   + HTTPS_PROXY. Node ignores System Proxy;
68	#                                   TUN/Mixin used to hide this on GFW hosts.
69	#                          always = same, but warn when no local proxy is found
70	#                          never  = never pass --proxy-env (non-GFW machines)
71	#                          http://127.0.0.1:PORT = force that URL
72	#   COPILOT_API_PKG      default: @jeffreycao/copilot-api@2.1.0
73	#                                             - package spec to install (pin/
74	#                                               upgrade; copilot-api@0.7.0 = old
75	#                                               original). Changing it re-installs.
76	#   COPILOT_PROXY_RATE   default: 15          - --rate-limit seconds; ONLY used
77	#                                               by the original package (the fork
78	#                                               has no rate limiter)
79	#   COPILOT_PROXY_QUIET  default: 0           - 1 = inject extra quota-saving env
80	#                                               (fewer background calls, but a
81	#                                               slightly degraded Claude Code UX)
82	
83	# --- shared constants / helpers -------------------------------------------------
84	
85	_copilot_port() { printf '%s' "${COPILOT_PROXY_PORT:-4141}"; }
86	_copilot_pkg()  { printf '%s' "${COPILOT_API_PKG:-@jeffreycao/copilot-api@2.1.0}"; }
87	
88	# CLI flavor from the package spec: the ORIGINAL bare `copilot-api` takes
89	# --rate-limit/--wait and has `check-usage`; the fork (and anything else)
90	# doesn't. Strips a trailing @version, but not the @scope/ prefix.
91	_copilot_pkg_flavor() {
92	  local name; name="$(_copilot_pkg)"
93	  case "$name" in
94	    copilot-api|copilot-api@*) printf 'original' ;;
95	    *) printf 'fork' ;;
96	  esac
97	}
98	_copilot_base() { printf 'http://localhost:%s' "$(_copilot_port)"; }
99	_copilot_logfile() { printf '%s' "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/copilot-api-$(_copilot_port).log"; }
100	_copilot_pidfile() { printf '%s' "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/copilot-api-$(_copilot_port).pid"; }
101	
102	# --- pinned package install (run the binary, never `bunx` at launch) -------------
103	#
104	# Why an install prefix instead of `bunx <pkg> start`: bunx re-resolves the
105	# package on EVERY launch, and bun hangs indefinitely resolving through a socks
106	# ALL_PROXY (curl through the same proxy is fine, which is what makes it so
107	# confusing). The wedged installer then keeps bun's global cache lock, so every
108	# retry hangs identically and stacks another zombie. Installing once and exec'ing
109	# the resulting binary removes the per-start resolve entirely — a warm start does
110	# zero network before it binds the port. Full story:
111	# pitfalls/copilot-proxy-start-hangs-at-resolving-dependencies.md
112	
113	# Package NAME without the trailing @version, keeping any @scope/ prefix.
114	# The naive "${spec%@*}" eats the whole string on a scoped spec with no version
115	# (@jeffreycao/copilot-api -> ""), so test on the scope-stripped copy.
116	_copilot_pkg_name() {
117	  local spec base
118	  spec="$(_copilot_pkg)"
119	  base="${spec#@}"
120	  case "$base" in
121	    *@*) printf '%s' "${spec%@*}" ;;
122	    *)   printf '%s' "$spec" ;;
123	  esac
124	}
125	
126	_copilot_pkg_prefix() { printf '%s' "${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/copilot-api/pkg"; }
127	_copilot_pkg_bin()    { printf '%s' "$(_copilot_pkg_prefix)/node_modules/.bin/copilot-api"; }
128	# Records the spec the prefix currently holds, so bumping COPILOT_API_PKG (or the
129	# pinned default) re-installs instead of silently running the old version.
130	_copilot_pkg_stamp()  { printf '%s' "$(_copilot_pkg_prefix)/.installed-spec"; }
131	
132	# Is the CURRENTLY pinned spec installed and runnable?
133	_copilot_pkg_ready() {
134	  local bin stamp
135	  bin="$(_copilot_pkg_bin)"; stamp="$(_copilot_pkg_stamp)"
136	  [ -x "$bin" ] || return 1
137	  [ -f "$stamp" ] || return 1
138	  [ "$(command head -n 1 "$stamp" 2>/dev/null)" = "$(_copilot_pkg)" ]
139	}
140	
141	# One package-install attempt in $1. $2 = "noproxy" strips the proxy env,
142	# "npm" uses npm without proxy env (a useful fallback when Bun rejects a TUN /
143	# MITM certificate chain), and anything else runs Bun with the ambient env.
144	# $3 = seconds budget, enforced by polling — `timeout(1)` is not in macOS base,
145	# and this file is sourced by both shells. Returns 124 on expiry.
146	#
147	# The kill on expiry is the load-bearing part: a stalled `bun add` left running
148	# keeps bun's global install-cache lock, and THAT is what made every subsequent
149	# start hang too. Never let one escape.
150	_copilot_pkg_install_try() {
151	  local dir="$1" mode="$2" budget="$3" pkg pid i=0 log
152	  pkg="$(_copilot_pkg)"
153	  log="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/copilot-pkg-install-$$.log"
154	  if [ "$mode" = "noproxy" ]; then
155	    ( cd "$dir" 2>/dev/null && command env \
156	        -u ALL_PROXY -u all_proxy -u HTTP_PROXY -u http_proxy \
157	        -u HTTPS_PROXY -u https_proxy \
158	        bun add "$pkg" --no-summary >"$log" 2>&1 ) &
159	  elif [ "$mode" = "npm" ]; then
160	    ( cd "$dir" 2>/dev/null && command env \
161	        -u ALL_PROXY -u all_proxy -u HTTP_PROXY -u http_proxy \
162	        -u HTTPS_PROXY -u https_proxy \
163	        npm install --no-audit --no-fund --save-exact "$pkg" >"$log" 2>&1 ) &
164	  else
165	    ( cd "$dir" 2>/dev/null && command bun add "$pkg" --no-summary >"$log" 2>&1 ) &
166	  fi
167	  pid=$!
168	  while [ "$i" -lt "$budget" ]; do
169	    if ! kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
170	      wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null
171	      local rc=$?
172	      if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ] && [ -s "$log" ]; then
173	        command tail -n 3 "$log" >&2
174	      fi
175	      command rm -f -- "$log"
176	      return "$rc"
177	    fi
178	    sleep 1
179	    i=$((i + 1))
180	  done
181	  # Braces + 2>/dev/null swallow the shell's own async "Killed" job notification:
182	  # we report the timeout ourselves, and a raw job-control message here reads like
183	  # a crash. Kill the whole process group's `bun add` too — the subshell's child
184	  # is the one actually holding the cache lock.
185	  { kill -9 "$pid" 2>/dev/null
186	    command pkill -9 -f "bun add.*$(_copilot_pkg_name)" 2>/dev/null
187	    command pkill -9 -f "npm install.*$(_copilot_pkg_name)" 2>/dev/null
188	    wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null
189	  } 2>/dev/null
190	  command rm -f -- "$log"
191	  return 124
192	}
193	
194	# Ensure the pinned spec is installed. No-op (and no network) once it is.
195	_copilot_ensure_pkg() {
196	  local spec prefix bin
197	  spec="$(_copilot_pkg)"; prefix="$(_copilot_pkg_prefix)"; bin="$(_copilot_pkg_bin)"
198	
199	  _copilot_pkg_ready && return 0
200	
201	  if ! command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then
202	    printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: bun not found (needs bun via mise)." >&2
203	    return 1
204	  fi
205	  command mkdir -p "$prefix" || return 1
206	  # A private package.json keeps `bun add` from walking up and polluting $HOME.
207	  [ -f "$prefix/package.json" ] || printf '%s\n' \
208	    '{"name":"copilot-api-runner","private":true,"version":"0.0.0"}' >"$prefix/package.json"
209	
210	  printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: installing $spec (one-time — later starts skip this) ..."
211	  # Attempt 1 honours the ambient env: on a host where the npm registry is only
212	  # reachable THROUGH the proxy, stripping it would break the install. Attempt 2
213	  # strips it, which is what rescues the socks stall. COPILOT_INSTALL_NOPROXY=1
214	  # skips straight to attempt 2 (saves the 45s stall on a known-bad host).
215	  if [ "${COPILOT_INSTALL_NOPROXY:-0}" = "1" ] \
216	     || ! _copilot_pkg_install_try "$prefix" env 45; then
217	    if [ "${COPILOT_INSTALL_NOPROXY:-0}" != "1" ]; then
218	      printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: install stalled with the proxy env — retrying without it ..." >&2
219	      # Drop bun's cache lock dir before retrying; the killed attempt may have
220	      # left it behind, and a stale lock hangs the retry for the same reason.
221	      command rm -rf -- "${BUN_INSTALL:-$HOME/.bun}/install/cache/.tmp" 2>/dev/null
222	    fi
223	    if ! _copilot_pkg_install_try "$prefix" noproxy 90; then
224	      # Bun and Node do not always use the same CA store. A Clash/TUN node that
225	      # produces UNKNOWN_CERTIFICATE_VERIFICATION_ERROR in Bun can still be
226	      # installed safely by npm with normal TLS verification enabled.
227	      if command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
228	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: Bun install failed — retrying with npm's CA stack ..." >&2
229	        if ! _copilot_pkg_install_try "$prefix" npm 90; then
230	          printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: could not install $spec — run 'copilot-proxy doctor'." >&2
231	          return 1
232	        fi
233	      else
234	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: could not install $spec — run 'copilot-proxy doctor'." >&2
235	        return 1
236	      fi
237	    fi
238	  fi
239	
240	  if [ ! -x "$bin" ]; then
241	    printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: install finished but $bin is missing." >&2
242	    return 1
243	  fi
244	  printf '%s\n' "$spec" >"$(_copilot_pkg_stamp)"
245	}
246	
247	# --- throttle shim (optional, in front of the fork) -----------------------------
248	# A tiny Bun reverse proxy that caps concurrent in-flight upstream requests,
249	# transparently retries 403/429 (GitHub enterprise abuse throttling) BEFORE any
250	# body streams — so downstream agents never see "Please run /login" — and keeps
251	# a streamed response alive with SSE comment frames while an OpenAI reasoning
252	# model thinks (copilot-api withholds headers until the first token and sends no
253	# `ping`, so the socket is otherwise silent for minutes and gets reaped; see
254	# pitfalls/copilot-proxy-openai-model-silent-stall.md). Toggle with
255	# `copilot-proxy shim on|off`; tune via COPILOT_SHIM_{PORT,MAX,RETRIES,
256	# BACKOFF_MS,PING_MS,PING_AFTER_MS,STALL_MS} — the whole COPILOT_SHIM_* env is
257	# inherited by the spawned process, so `export` them before `shim on`.
258	_copilot_shim_port()    { printf '%s' "${COPILOT_SHIM_PORT:-4142}"; }
259	_copilot_shim_base()    { printf 'http://localhost:%s' "$(_copilot_shim_port)"; }
260	_copilot_shim_script()  { printf '%s' "${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/shell/copilot-throttle-shim.js"; }
261	_copilot_shim_logfile() { printf '%s' "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/copilot-shim-$(_copilot_shim_port).log"; }
262	_copilot_shim_pidfile() { printf '%s' "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/copilot-shim-$(_copilot_shim_port).pid"; }
263	_copilot_shim_state()   { printf '%s' "${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/copilot-proxy/shim"; }
264	
265	# Enabled? env COPILOT_PROXY_SHIM overrides a persisted on/off state file.
266	_copilot_shim_enabled() {
267	  case "${COPILOT_PROXY_SHIM:-}" in
268	    1|on|true|yes)  return 0 ;;
269	    0|off|false|no) return 1 ;;
270	  esac
271	  local sf; sf="$(_copilot_shim_state)"
272	  [ -f "$sf" ] && [ "$(command head -n1 "$sf" 2>/dev/null)" = "on" ]
273	}
274	
275	# Is the shim port answering at all? (curl w/o -f: any HTTP reply = exit 0, so a
276	# 502 from a fork-down passthrough still counts as "shim process is up".)
277	_copilot_shim_alive() {
278	  command curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 2 "$(_copilot_shim_base)/v1/models" >/dev/null 2>&1
279	}
280	
281	# Base URL Claude Code should talk to: the shim when it's enabled AND actually
282	# up, otherwise the fork directly (never break just because the shim is down).
283	_copilot_client_base() {
284	  if _copilot_shim_enabled && _copilot_shim_alive; then _copilot_shim_base; else _copilot_base; fi
285	}
286	
287	# Base URL for PERSISTENT pins (copilot-here settings.local.json): the shim when
288	# it's enabled (it's auto-started with the proxy, so it'll be up when in use),
289	# else the fork. Not gated on currently-alive since the file outlives this shell.
290	_copilot_pinned_base() {
291	  if _copilot_shim_enabled; then _copilot_shim_base; else _copilot_base; fi
292	}
293	
294	# Start the shim (idempotent). Points it at the fork; inherits COPILOT_SHIM_*.
295	_copilot_shim_start() {
296	  if _copilot_shim_alive; then return 0; fi
297	  if ! command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then
298	    printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: shim needs 'bun' (via mise) — skipping." >&2
299	    return 1
300	  fi
301	  local script; script="$(_copilot_shim_script)"
302	  if [ ! -f "$script" ]; then
303	    printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: shim script not found at $script" >&2
304	    return 1
305	  fi
306	  COPILOT_SHIM_PORT="$(_copilot_shim_port)" COPILOT_SHIM_UPSTREAM="$(_copilot_base)" \
307	    nohup bun "$script" >"$(_copilot_shim_logfile)" 2>&1 &
308	  printf '%s\n' "$!" >"$(_copilot_shim_pidfile)"
309	  local i=0
310	  while [ "$i" -lt 10 ]; do
311	    _copilot_shim_alive && return 0
312	    sleep 1; i=$((i + 1))
313	  done
314	  printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: shim did not come up — check $(_copilot_shim_logfile)" >&2
315	  return 1
316	}
317	
318	# Stop the shim.
319	_copilot_shim_stop() {
320	  local pidf; pidf="$(_copilot_shim_pidfile)"
321	  if [ -f "$pidf" ]; then
322	    local pid; pid="$(command cat "$pidf" 2>/dev/null)"
323	    [ -n "$pid" ] && kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null
324	    command rm -f -- "$pidf"
325	  fi
326	  command pkill -f "copilot-throttle-shim.js" 2>/dev/null
327	  return 0
328	}
329	
330	# Global default-model state file (used by copilot-run/claude-copilot when the
331	# project has no copilot-here pin). Written by `copilot-model`.
332	_copilot_model_state() {
333	  printf '%s' "${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/copilot-proxy/model"
334	}
335	
336	# Resolve the model for env injection: $COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL > state file > default.
337	#
338	# Model-id shape matters (verified 2026-07):
339	#   - HYPHENATED ids (claude-opus-4-8), not dotted (claude-opus-4.8): Claude
340	#     Code only recognizes hyphenated family names — dotted ids fall back to
341	#     a legacy "[Opus 4] retired" label AND a 200k context assumption.
342	#   - "[1m]" suffix: Claude Code uses it to size HUD/compaction for a 1M context
343	#     window. _copilot_model_for_claude derives it from live /v1/models metadata
344	#     for every provider, rather than guessing from a hard-coded Claude list.
345	#     Claude Code-only: raw API clients must send the plain id.
346	_copilot_default_model() {
347	  if [ -n "${COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL:-}" ]; then
348	    printf '%s' "$COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL"
349	  elif [ -f "$(_copilot_model_state)" ]; then
350	    command head -n 1 "$(_copilot_model_state)"
351	  else
352	    printf '%s' "gpt-5.6-sol[1m]"
353	  fi
354	}
355	
356	# Is the proxy answering on its port?
357	_copilot_alive() {
358	  command curl -fsS --max-time 2 "$(_copilot_base)/v1/models" >/dev/null 2>&1
359	}
360	
361	# --- doctor helpers -------------------------------------------------------------
362	
363	# Every model id the proxy will accept: the raw `.id` PLUS the `.claude_model_id`
364	# alias (which is the one carrying the "[1m]" suffix Claude Code sends). Checking
365	# only `.id` — as _copilot_model_list does — would reject a valid "...[1m]" pin.
366	_copilot_served_models() {
367	  local json
368	  json="$(command curl -fsS --max-time 5 "$(_copilot_base)/v1/models" 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
369	  if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
370	    printf '%s\n' "$json" | jq -r '.data[] | .id, (.claude_model_id // empty)' 2>/dev/null | command sort -u
371	  else
372	    printf '%s\n' "$json" \
373	      | command grep -oE '"(id|claude_model_id)":"[^"]*"' \
374	      | command sed 's/.*":"//;s/"//' | command sort -u
375	  fi
376	}
377	
378	# The model Claude Code would actually send from THIS directory, and where it
379	# came from. Mirrors copilot-model's precedence: project pin > $COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL
380	# > state file > built-in default. Echoes "<model>|<source>" ('|' never occurs in
381	# a model id or a path we emit here).
382	_copilot_effective_model() {
383	  local settings=".claude/settings.local.json" m
384	  if [ -f "$settings" ] && command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 \
385	     && [ "$(jq -r '.env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL // empty' "$settings" 2>/dev/null)" != "" ]; then
386	    m="$(jq -r '.env.ANTHROPIC_MODEL // empty' "$settings" 2>/dev/null)"
387	    if [ -n "$m" ]; then printf '%s|%s' "$m" "project pin: $settings"; return 0; fi
388	  fi
389	  if [ -n "${COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL:-}" ]; then
390	    printf '%s|%s' "$COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL" '$COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL'
391	  elif [ -f "$(_copilot_model_state)" ]; then
392	    printf '%s|%s' "$(command head -n 1 "$(_copilot_model_state)")" "state file: $(_copilot_model_state)"
393	  else
394	    printf '%s|%s' "$(_copilot_default_model)" "built-in default"
395	  fi
396	}
397	
398	# HTTP reachability probe. Any HTTP status means the host answered — an
399	# unauthenticated 400/401 from the Copilot API is a SUCCESSFUL reach. Only a
400	# connect/read failure is a fault. Echoes "<code>|<seconds>", empty on failure.
401	# $2, when non-empty, routes through that proxy (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7891).
402	_copilot_probe() {
403	  local url="$1" via="${2:-}" out
404	  if [ -n "$via" ]; then
405	    out="$(command curl -o /dev/null -s -w '%{http_code}|%{time_total}' --max-time 12 -x "$via" "$url" 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
406	  else
407	    out="$(command curl -o /dev/null -s -w '%{http_code}|%{time_total}' --max-time 12 --noproxy '*' "$url" 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
408	  fi
409	  case "$out" in 000*) return 1 ;; esac
410	  printf '%s' "$out"
411	}
412	
413	# Classify curl failures without treating an HTTP rejection as a transport
414	# failure. Kept separate so the optional codex_apps route can explain timeout,
415	# certificate and generic network failures without conflating them with the
416	# localhost model gateway.
417	_copilot_probe_failure_kind() {
418	  local rc="${1:-1}" msg
419	  msg="$(printf '%s' "${2:-}" | command tr 'A-Z' 'a-z')"
420	  case "$rc" in
421	    28) printf '%s' timeout; return 0 ;;
422	    35|51|53|58|59|60|64|66|77|80|82|83|90|91) printf '%s' tls; return 0 ;;
423	  esac
424	  case "$msg" in
425	    *timed\ out*|*timeout*) printf '%s' timeout ;;
426	    *certificate*|*ssl*|*tls*) printf '%s' tls ;;
427	    *) printf '%s' network ;;
428	  esac
429	}
430	
431	# Probe an optional HTTP endpoint and always emit a structured result:
432	#   reached|HTTP_CODE|SECONDS|
433	#   failed|timeout|SECONDS|short curl error
434	#   failed|tls|SECONDS|short curl error
435	#   failed|network|SECONDS|short curl error
436	# Any non-000 HTTP status is reachability success; auth/handshake rejection is
437	# expected for the unauthenticated codex_apps endpoint probe.
438	_copilot_optional_http_probe() {
439	  local url="$1" via="${2:-}" out rc metrics code elapsed err kind
440	  if [ -n "$via" ]; then
441	    out="$(command curl -o /dev/null -sS -w '\n%{http_code}|%{time_total}' \
442	      --max-time 12 -x "$via" "$url" 2>&1)"; rc=$?
443	  else
444	    out="$(command curl -o /dev/null -sS -w '\n%{http_code}|%{time_total}' \
445	      --max-time 12 --noproxy '*' "$url" 2>&1)"; rc=$?
446	  fi
447	  metrics="$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | command tail -n 1)"
448	  code="${metrics%%|*}"; elapsed="${metrics##*|}"
449	  if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && [ -n "$code" ] && [ "$code" != 000 ]; then
450	    printf 'reached|%s|%s|' "$code" "$elapsed"
451	    return 0
452	  fi
453	  err="$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | command sed '$d' | command tr '\n|' ' /' | command cut -c1-120)"
454	  kind="$(_copilot_probe_failure_kind "$rc" "$err")"
455	  printf 'failed|%s|%s|%s' "$kind" "${elapsed:-0}" "$err"
456	}
457	
458	# Model ids GitHub serves for this account RIGHT NOW.
459	#
460	# Why this exists: copilot-api fetches /models ONCE at startup and caches it for
461	# the whole process lifetime. A degraded OR geo-filtered startup fetch leaves
462	# the proxy serving a truncated list forever, and every request for a missing
463	# model returns a 400 "model_not_supported" that looks exactly like an
464	# entitlement problem. Comparing live-upstream against proxy-cached is the only
465	# way to tell those apart. Verified 2026-07.
466	#
467	# $1 selects the egress path for the curl probe (curl follows the macOS system
468	# proxy by default — which is exactly what made the old doctor mis-diagnose
469	# "entitlement" when System Proxy was ON but Node was going direct):
470	#   (empty)           — curl defaults (may use System Proxy on macOS)
471	#   direct            — --noproxy '*' (true direct egress)
472	#   http://host:port  — force -x that proxy
473	#
474	# Secrets: the ghu_/bearer tokens are passed via `curl -K -` (stdin config), NOT
475	# argv — argv is world-readable via `ps`. Never echo either token.
476	_copilot_upstream_models() {
477	  local via="${1:-}"
478	  local tokfile="$HOME/.local/share/copilot-api/github_token"
479	  [ -f "$tokfile" ] || return 1
480	  command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 1
481	
482	  local ghu ex api ctok up
483	  ghu="$(command head -n 1 "$tokfile" 2>/dev/null)"
484	  [ -n "$ghu" ] || return 1
485	
486	  # Transport: keep as one argv word so zsh doesn't glob `*`.
487	  local xargs=()
488	  case "$via" in
489	    "") ;;
490	    direct) xargs=(--noproxy '*') ;;
491	    http://*|https://*|socks5://*|socks5h://*) xargs=(-x "$via") ;;
492	    *) return 1 ;;
493	  esac
494	
495	  # bash arrays work when this file is sourced from bash; zsh too. Avoid
496	  # unquoted $* expansion of `--noproxy *`.
497	  ex="$(printf 'header = "Authorization: token %s"\n' "$ghu" \
498	        | command curl -fsS --max-time 10 -K - \
499	            -H 'user-agent: GitHubCopilotChat/0.26.7' \
500	            "${xargs[@]}" \
501	            https://api.github.com/copilot_internal/v2/token 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
502	
503	  api="$(printf '%s' "$ex" | jq -r '.endpoints.api // "https://api.githubcopilot.com"' 2>/dev/null)"
504	  ctok="$(printf '%s' "$ex" | jq -r '.token // empty' 2>/dev/null)"
505	  [ -n "$ctok" ] || return 1
506	
507	  up="$(printf 'header = "Authorization: Bearer %s"\n' "$ctok" \
508	        | command curl -fsS --max-time 12 -K - \
509	            -H 'user-agent: GitHubCopilotChat/0.26.7' \
510	            -H 'copilot-integration-id: vscode-chat' \
511	            "${xargs[@]}" \
512	            "$api/models" 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
513	
514	  printf '%s' "$up" | jq -r '.data[]?.id // empty' 2>/dev/null | command sort -u
515	}
516	
517	# Resolve the HTTP(S) proxy URL that Node should use for GitHub /models.
518	# Prints a URL or nothing. Never prints secrets. Relies on 50_networking.sh
519	# helpers when available; falls back to macOS System Proxy / common ports.
520	#
521	# COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY:
522	#   auto|always|never|<url>
523	_copilot_resolve_http_proxy() {
524	  local mode="${COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY:-auto}"
525	  case "$mode" in
526	    never|off|0|false|no) return 0 ;;
527	    http://*|https://*|socks5://*|socks5h://*)
528	      printf '%s' "$mode"
529	      return 0
530	      ;;
531	    always|auto|on|1|true|yes|"") ;;
532	    *)
533	      printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: unknown COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY='$mode' (use auto|always|never|http://...)" >&2
534	      return 0
535	      ;;
536	  esac
537	
538	  # Prefer the shared detector (Clash Verge / mihomo / CFW / System Proxy).
539	  if command -v __net_detect_proxy >/dev/null 2>&1; then
540	    if __net_detect_proxy 2>/dev/null \
541	       && [ -n "${_NET_PROXY_CACHE:-}" ] \
542	       && [ "$_NET_PROXY_CACHE" != "none" ]; then
543	      printf '%s' "$_NET_PROXY_CACHE"
544	      return 0
545	    fi
546	  fi
547	
548	  # Fallback when 50_networking.sh isn't sourced yet (rare; file order is 43→50).
549	  local sys
550	  sys="$(_copilot_system_proxy)"
551	  if [ -n "$sys" ]; then
552	    printf '%s' "http://$sys"
553	    return 0
554	  fi
555	  return 0
556	}
557	
558	# Normalise a model id for cross-source comparison: lowercase, dots -> dashes
559	# (upstream says claude-opus-4.8, the proxy says claude-opus-4-8), drop the
560	# Claude Code-only "[1m]" suffix. Reads ids on stdin, one per line.
561	_copilot_norm_models() {
562	  command tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' | command sed 's/\[1m\]$//; s/\./-/g' | command sort -u
563	}
564	
565	# macOS system HTTP proxy as "host:port", empty when disabled/not macOS.
566	_copilot_system_proxy() {
567	  command -v scutil >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0
568	  command scutil --proxy 2>/dev/null | command awk '
569	    /HTTPEnable/ { en=$3 } /HTTPProxy/ { h=$3 } /HTTPPort/ { p=$3 }
570	    END { if (en == 1 && h != "" && p != "") printf "%s:%s", h, p }'
571	}
572	
573	# PIDs of bun package-installer processes still resolving copilot-api, one per
574	# line (empty when none). bun stalls indefinitely resolving through a socks
575	# ALL_PROXY (even when curl to the same registry is fine), and a stalled
576	# `bun add` keeps bun's global install-cache lock — which wedges every later
577	# install too. _copilot_pkg_install_try now bounds and kills its own attempts, so
578	# this should stay empty; it remains as a safety net for a stall we didn't spawn
579	# (a hand-run `bunx @jeffreycao/copilot-api`, or a zombie left by the pre-install
580	# design that resolved on every launch). A live `bun add … copilot-api` is never
581	# normal at rest — install is a one-shot — so a match is a clean signal.
582	# Verified 2026-07: five stacked zombies from five retries, none ever bound the port.
583	_copilot_stale_installers() {
584	  command pgrep -f 'bun add.*copilot-api' 2>/dev/null
585	}
586	
587	# --- proxy manager --------------------------------------------------------------
588	
589	# Manage the copilot-api proxy. Subcommands: start|stop|status|restart|logs|auth.
590	# Example:
591	#   copilot-proxy start          # background-start on $COPILOT_PROXY_PORT
592	#   copilot-proxy status         # is it up? which models?
593	copilot-proxy() {
594	  if [ -n "$ZSH_VERSION" ]; then
595	    emulate -L zsh
596	    setopt localoptions pipefail
597	  else
598	    set -o pipefail
599	  fi
600	
601	  if ! command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then
602	    printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: bun not found (needs bun via mise)." >&2
603	    return 1
604	  fi
605	
606	  local port pkg logf pidf
607	  port="$(_copilot_port)"; pkg="$(_copilot_pkg)"
608	  logf="$(_copilot_logfile)"; pidf="$(_copilot_pidfile)"
609	
610	  local action="${1:-status}"
611	  case "$action" in
612	    start)
613	      if _copilot_alive; then
614	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: already running on port $port" >&2
615	        return 0
616	      fi
617	      # First run needs `copilot-proxy auth` to store a ghu_ token; warn if absent.
618	      if [ ! -f "$HOME/.local/share/copilot-api/github_token" ]; then
619	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: not authenticated yet — run 'copilot-proxy auth' first." >&2
620	        return 1
621	      fi
622	      # Rotate the previous session's log (keep last 3) so a restart doesn't wipe
623	      # it — the start commands below truncate ($logf) via `>`. logf.1 = previous
624	      # session, logf.2/.3 = older. Debugging a transient (e.g. 403) survives.
625	      if [ -f "$logf" ]; then
626	        command rm -f "$logf.3" 2>/dev/null
627	        [ -f "$logf.2" ] && command mv -f "$logf.2" "$logf.3"
628	        [ -f "$logf.1" ] && command mv -f "$logf.1" "$logf.2"
629	        command mv -f "$logf" "$logf.1"
630	      fi
631	      # Install the pinned package BEFORE backgrounding anything. Resolving it at
632	      # launch (the old `bunx <pkg> start`) is what used to hang forever behind a
633	      # socks proxy, with nothing but "Resolving dependencies" in the log.
634	      _copilot_ensure_pkg || return 1
635	      local bin srv_pid http_proxy_url use_proxy_env=0
636	      bin="$(_copilot_pkg_bin)"
637	      http_proxy_url="$(_copilot_resolve_http_proxy)"
638	      if [ -n "$http_proxy_url" ]; then
639	        use_proxy_env=1
