1053	            _skip "apps via proxy" "$_av failure; direct route already works"
1054	          else
1055	            _note "apps via proxy" "$_av failure after ${_at}s${_ae:+ — $_ae}"
1056	          fi
1057	        fi
1058	
1059	        if [ "$_direct_apps_ok" -eq 0 ] && [ "$_via_apps_ok" -eq 1 ]; then
1060	          _note "apps routing" "ChatGPT Apps works only through the explicit HTTP proxy"
1061	          _hint "launch Codex with HTTP_PROXY=$_http_proxy HTTPS_PROXY=$_http_proxy (and NO_PROXY=localhost,127.0.0.1,::1)"
1062	        elif [ "$_direct_apps_ok" -eq 0 ] && [ "$_via_apps_ok" -eq 0 ]; then
1063	          _hint "this affects Apps/Connectors only; /status can still show localhost model inference working"
1064	          _hint "timeout → inspect Clash/TUN rules; tls → inspect certificate interception / custom CA"
1065	        fi
1066	      fi
1067	
1068	      printf '\n%s\n' "Live probe"
1069	      if [ "$_live" -ne 1 ]; then
1070	        _skip "skipped" "pass --live to send one real request (consumes 1 quota unit)"
1071	      elif ! _copilot_alive; then
1072	        _skip "skipped" "proxy is not running"
1073	      elif [ -z "${_served:-}" ]; then
1074	        _skip "skipped" "no served model to probe with"
1075	      else
1076	        # Pick a chat model, never an embedding one, and never a "[1m]" alias:
1077	        # that suffix is Claude Code-only sugar and the proxy rejects it from a
1078	        # raw API client (see _copilot_default_model's notes).
1079	        local _probe_model _body
1080	        _probe_model="$(printf '%s\n' "$_served" \
1081	          | command grep -vi 'embedding' | command grep -v '\[1m\]' | command head -n 1)"
1082	        _body="$(printf '{"model":"%s","max_tokens":1,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}' "$_probe_model")"
1083	        # Probe the base CLIENTS use (the shim when it's up), so the live check
1084	        # exercises the same chain Claude Code does.
1085	        if _r="$(command curl -o /dev/null -s -w '%{http_code}|%{time_total}' --max-time 60 \
1086	                   -X POST "$(_copilot_client_base)/v1/messages?beta=true" \
1087	                   -H 'content-type: application/json' -d "$_body" 2>/dev/null)"; then
1088	          _code="${_r%%|*}"; _t="${_r##*|}"
1089	          case "$_code" in
1090	            2*) _ok "round-trip" "$_probe_model → HTTP $_code in ${_t}s" ;;
1091	            000) _bad "round-trip" "$_probe_model → no response (timeout/reset)"
1092	                 _hint "this is the streaming-fault class; suspect the local proxy chain" ;;
1093	            *)  _bad "round-trip" "$_probe_model → HTTP $_code in ${_t}s"
1094	                _hint "copilot-proxy logs 40" ;;
1095	          esac
1096	        else
1097	          _bad "round-trip" "request failed outright"
1098	        fi
1099	      fi
1100	
1101	      printf '\n'
1102	      if [ "$_fail" -gt 0 ]; then
1103	        printf '%s\n\n' "$_fail failed, $_warn warning(s)"
1104	        unset -f _ok _bad _note _skip _hint 2>/dev/null
1105	        return 1
1106	      fi
1107	      printf '%s\n\n' "all checks passed ($_warn warning(s))"
1108	      unset -f _ok _bad _note _skip _hint 2>/dev/null
1109	      ;;
1110	    logs)
1111	      # logs [N] [gen]  — tail the fork log; gen 1..3 = a rotated prev session.
1112	      # logs shim [N]    — tail the throttle shim's log instead.
1113	      local _lf _n
1114	      if [ "${2:-}" = "shim" ]; then
1115	        _lf="$(_copilot_shim_logfile)"; _n="${3:-40}"
1116	      else
1117	        _lf="$logf"; _n="${2:-40}"
1118	        case "${3:-}" in 1|2|3) _lf="$logf.$3" ;; esac
1119	      fi
1120	      if [ -f "$_lf" ]; then command tail -n "$_n" "$_lf"; else
1121	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: no log file at $_lf" >&2; return 1; fi
1122	      ;;
1123	    auth)
1124	      # One-time device login → stores a ghu_ token copilot-api can exchange.
1125	      _copilot_ensure_pkg || return 1
1126	      printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: launching copilot-api device login ..."
1127	      if [ "$(_copilot_pkg_flavor)" = "original" ]; then
1128	        "$(_copilot_pkg_bin)" auth
1129	      else
1130	        "$(_copilot_pkg_bin)" auth --provider copilot
1131	      fi
1132	      ;;
1133	    reinstall)
1134	      # Force a clean re-install of the pinned spec (normally only needed if the
1135	      # prefix got corrupted — a version bump re-installs on its own via the stamp).
1136	      printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: removing $(_copilot_pkg_prefix) ..."
1137	      command rm -rf -- "$(_copilot_pkg_prefix)"
1138	      _copilot_ensure_pkg || return 1
1139	      printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: installed $(_copilot_pkg) → $(_copilot_pkg_bin)"
1140	      ;;
1141	    whoami|usage)
1142	      # Real login check: exchanges the stored token against GitHub and prints
1143	      # the account / plan / quota. Fails loudly if the token is missing/expired.
1144	      if [ ! -f "$HOME/.local/share/copilot-api/github_token" ]; then
1145	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: not authenticated — run 'copilot-proxy auth' first." >&2
1146	        return 1
1147	      fi
1148	      if [ "$(_copilot_pkg_flavor)" = "original" ]; then
1149	        _copilot_ensure_pkg || return 1
1150	        "$(_copilot_pkg_bin)" check-usage
1151	      elif _copilot_alive; then
1152	        # Fork has no check-usage subcommand; its /usage endpoint serves the
1153	        # GitHub quota payload (same data as the bundled /usage-viewer).
1154	        if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1155	          command curl -fsS --max-time 5 "$(_copilot_base)/usage" | jq '{
1156	            plan: (.copilot_plan // .access_type_sku // "unknown"),
1157	            quota_reset: (.quota_reset_date // null),
1158	            quotas: ((.quota_snapshots // {}) | map_values(
1159	              if type == "object" then
1160	                {remaining, entitlement, percent_remaining, unlimited}
1161	              else . end))
1162	          }'
1163	        else
1164	          command curl -fsS --max-time 5 "$(_copilot_base)/usage"
1165	        fi
1166	      else
1167	        # Proxy down → the fork's `debug` still validates auth state / paths.
1168	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: not running — showing auth/debug info instead of quota." >&2
1169	        _copilot_ensure_pkg || return 1
1170	        "$(_copilot_pkg_bin)" debug
1171	      fi
1172	      ;;
1173	    shim)
1174	      # shim [on|off|status] — persist the toggle, and start/stop it live if the
1175	      # fork is already running.
1176	      local sf; sf="$(_copilot_shim_state)"
1177	      case "${2:-status}" in
1178	        on)
1179	          command mkdir -p "$(command dirname "$sf")"; printf 'on\n' >"$sf"
1180	          if _copilot_alive; then
1181	            _copilot_shim_start && printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: shim ON → $(_copilot_shim_base) (→ $(_copilot_base))"
1182	          else
1183	            printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: shim enabled; will start with the proxy ('copilot-proxy start')."
1184	          fi
1185	          printf '%s\n' "  NOTE: restart Claude Code so it picks up ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=$(_copilot_shim_base)"
1186	          ;;
1187	        off)
1188	          printf 'off\n' >"$sf"; _copilot_shim_stop
1189	          printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: shim OFF (clients use $(_copilot_base) directly)"
1190	          printf '%s\n' "  NOTE: restart Claude Code to point back at $(_copilot_base)"
1191	          ;;
1192	        status|*)
1193	          if _copilot_shim_enabled; then
1194	            printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: shim ON ($(_copilot_shim_alive && echo up || echo down)) on $(_copilot_shim_base)"
1195	          else
1196	            printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: shim off"
1197	          fi
1198	          ;;
1199	      esac
1200	      ;;
1201	    -h|--help|help)
1202	      printf '%s\n' "Usage: copilot-proxy [start|stop|restart|status|doctor [--live]|logs [shim|N [gen]]|shim [on|off|status]|whoami|auth|reinstall]"
1203	      printf '%s\n' "  doctor (alias: test)  diagnose prereqs, auth, proxy, Claude catalog (direct vs via"
1204	      printf '%s\n' "                        Clash), upstream reachability and Codex Apps."
1205	      printf '%s\n' "                        --live probes Apps and costs 1 inference quota unit."
1206	      printf '%s\n' "  COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY    auto|always|never|http://127.0.0.1:PORT  (default auto)"
1207	      printf '%s\n' "                        auto attaches --proxy-env when proxy-status finds a local proxy."
1208	      printf '%s\n' "  reinstall             wipe + re-install the pinned package (a version bump"
1209	      printf '%s\n' "                        re-installs on its own; this is for a corrupted prefix)."
1210	      ;;
1211	    *)
1212	      printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: unknown action '$action' (try --help)" >&2
1213	      return 1
1214	      ;;
1215	  esac
1216	}
1217	
1218	# --- session wrapper (Layer 1: one-off, zero file writes) ------------------------
1219	
1220	# Run any command with the copilot-proxy env injected (per-process only —
1221	# nothing is written to disk). Auto-starts the proxy when it isn't answering.
1222	# GOTCHA (verified 2026-07): current Claude Code lets the settings.local.json
1223	# env block beat inherited shell env, so this does NOT win inside a project
1224	# where `copilot-here on` pins something else — `copilot-here off` first.
1225	# Example:
1226	#   copilot-run claude                      # raw Claude Code on the proxy
1227	#   copilot-run specstory run claude        # specstory-wrapped session
1228	copilot-run() {
1229	  if [ "$#" -eq 0 ]; then
1230	    printf '%s\n' "Usage: copilot-run <cmd> [args...]   (injects ANTHROPIC_* proxy env)" >&2
1231	    return 1
1232	  fi
1233	  if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1234	    printf '%s\n' "copilot-run: jq is required to build the model role profile" >&2
1235	    return 1
1236	  fi
1237	  if ! _copilot_alive; then
1238	    copilot-proxy start || return 1
1239	  fi
1240	  # If the shim is enabled but not up (e.g. toggled on after the proxy started),
1241	  # bring it up now so ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL below resolves to it.
1242	  if _copilot_shim_enabled && ! _copilot_shim_alive; then _copilot_shim_start; fi
1243	  local profile model fable opus sonnet haiku
1244	  profile="$(_copilot_model_profile_json "$(_copilot_default_model)")" || return 1
1245	  model="$(printf '%s' "$profile" | jq -r '.main')"
1246	  fable="$(printf '%s' "$profile" | jq -r '.fable')"
1247	  opus="$(printf '%s' "$profile" | jq -r '.opus')"
1248	  sonnet="$(printf '%s' "$profile" | jq -r '.sonnet')"
1249	  haiku="$(printf '%s' "$profile" | jq -r '.haiku')"
1250	  # Opt-in quota savers (COPILOT_PROXY_QUIET=1): prepended as NAME=VALUE args
1251	  # to `env`. Off by default — they degrade the Claude Code UX a little.
1252	  if [ "${COPILOT_PROXY_QUIET:-0}" = "1" ]; then
1253	    set -- \
1254	      CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER="0" \
1255	      CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_PROMPT_SUGGESTION="false" \
1256	      CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AWAY_SUMMARY="0" \
1257	      DISABLE_NON_ESSENTIAL_MODEL_CALLS="1" \
1258	      "$@"
1259	  fi
1260	  # `command env` (not bare var-prefix) so the vars are strictly per-process:
1261	  # POSIX var-prefix on a *function* call would leak into the current shell.
1262	  command env \
1263	    ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL="$(_copilot_client_base)" \
1264	    ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN="dummy" \
1265	    ANTHROPIC_MODEL="$model" \
1266	    ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL="$fable" \
1267	    ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL="$opus" \
1268	    ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL="$sonnet" \
1269	    ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL="$haiku" \
1270	    ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL="$haiku" \
1271	    CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC="1" \
1272	    "$@"
1273	}
1274	
1275	# Pick the best model for Codex from the raw gateway catalog. This is
1276	# deliberately NOT _copilot_pick_best_model: Claude Code prefers native Claude
1277	# when entitled, while Codex should stay on a native Responses-capable OpenAI
1278	# model as long as one is served. Claude/Gemini remain useful last-resort
1279	# Responses Lite fallbacks.
1280	_copilot_codex_pick_best_model() {
1281	  local models preferred c
1282	  models="$(command cat | command sed 's/\[1m\]$//' | command sort -u)"
1283	  [ -n "$models" ] || return 1
1284	
1285	  for preferred in \
1286	    gpt-5.6-sol gpt-5.6-terra gpt-5.5 gpt-5.4 gpt-5.3-codex \
1287	    gpt-5.6-luna gpt-5.4-mini gpt-5-mini
1288	  do
1289	    if printf '%s\n' "$models" | command grep -qxF "$preferred"; then
1290	      printf '%s' "$preferred"
1291	      return 0
1292	    fi
1293	  done
1294	  c="$(printf '%s\n' "$models" | command grep -E '^gpt-' | command grep -viE 'mini|nano|luna' \
1295	        | command sort | command tail -1)"
1296	  if [ -n "$c" ]; then printf '%s' "$c"; return 0; fi
1297	  c="$(printf '%s\n' "$models" | command grep -iE 'codex' | command sort | command tail -1)"
1298	  if [ -n "$c" ]; then printf '%s' "$c"; return 0; fi
1299	  c="$(printf '%s\n' "$models" | command grep -E '^gpt-' | command sort | command tail -1)"
1300	  if [ -n "$c" ]; then printf '%s' "$c"; return 0; fi
1301	
1302	  for preferred in \
1303	    claude-fable-5 \
1304	    claude-opus-5 claude-opus-4-8 claude-opus-4-7 claude-opus-4-6 \
1305	    claude-sonnet-5 claude-sonnet-4-6 claude-sonnet-4-5 \
1306	    claude-opus-4-5 claude-haiku-4-5
1307	  do
1308	    if printf '%s\n' "$models" | command grep -qxF "$preferred"; then
1309	      printf '%s' "$preferred"
1310	      return 0
1311	    fi
1312	  done
1313	  c="$(printf '%s\n' "$models" | command grep -E '^claude-' | command sort | command tail -1)"
1314	  if [ -n "$c" ]; then printf '%s' "$c"; return 0; fi
1315	
1316	  c="$(printf '%s\n' "$models" | command grep -E '^gemini-' | command grep -viE 'flash' \
1317	        | command sort | command tail -1)"
1318	  if [ -n "$c" ]; then printf '%s' "$c"; return 0; fi
1319	  c="$(printf '%s\n' "$models" | command grep -E '^gemini-' | command sort | command tail -1)"
1320	  if [ -n "$c" ]; then printf '%s' "$c"; return 0; fi
1321	
1322	  printf '%s\n' "$models" | command sort | command tail -1
1323	}
1324	
1325	# Effective SpecStory Codex command, matching SpecStory's own precedence.
1326	# `specstory run ... -c` replaces this command wholesale, so callers must append
1327	# to this value rather than fall back to a bare `codex` and silently lose the
1328	# configured reasoning / sandbox flags.
1329	_copilot_specstory_codex_cmd() {
1330	  local f cmd=''
1331	  for f in ".specstory/cli/config.toml" "$HOME/.specstory/cli/config.toml"; do
1332	    [ -f "$f" ] || continue
1333	    cmd="$(command sed -n \
1334	      -e "s/^[[:space:]]*codex_cmd[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*\"\([^\"]*\)\".*/\1/p" \
1335	      -e "s/^[[:space:]]*codex_cmd[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*'\([^']*\)'.*/\1/p" \
1336	      "$f" 2>/dev/null | command head -n 1)"
1337	    if [ -n "$cmd" ]; then break; fi
1338	  done
1339	  printf '%s' "${cmd:-codex}"
1340	}
1341	
1342	# Codex stores one global models_cache.json without provider namespacing. A
1343	# custom Copilot gateway refresh can therefore replace the first-party metadata
1344	# catalog with the gateway's much smaller adapter subset, making a bundled model
1345	# such as gpt-5.6-sol fall back to generic metadata. Pin this launcher to the
1346	# catalog bundled with the installed Codex binary instead. The binary version is
1347	# part of the path, so upgrades regenerate automatically while repeat launches
1348	# avoid another `codex debug models --bundled` subprocess.
1349	_copilot_codex_catalog_file() {
1350	  command -v codex >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 1
1351	  command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 1
1352	
1353	  local raw_version version cache_dir catalog_file tmp
1354	  raw_version="$(command codex --version 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
1355	  version="$(printf '%s' "$raw_version" | command sed 's/[^[:alnum:]._-]/_/g')"
1356	  [ -n "$version" ] || return 1
1357	
1358	  cache_dir="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/copilot-proxy/codex-models"
1359	  catalog_file="$cache_dir/$version.json"
1360	  if [ -s "$catalog_file" ] \
1361	     && jq -e '.models | type == "array" and length > 0' "$catalog_file" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1362	    printf '%s' "$catalog_file"
1363	    return 0
1364	  fi
1365	
1366	  command mkdir -p "$cache_dir" || return 1
1367	  tmp="$(command mktemp "$cache_dir/.catalog.XXXXXX")" || return 1
1368	  if command codex debug models --bundled >"$tmp" 2>/dev/null \
1369	     && jq -e '.models | type == "array" and length > 0' "$tmp" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1370	    command mv -- "$tmp" "$catalog_file"
1371	    printf '%s' "$catalog_file"
1372	  else
1373	    command rm -f -- "$tmp"
1374	    return 1
1375	  fi
1376	}
1377	
1378	# One-off Codex session backed by the local Copilot gateway. Provider settings
1379	# are CLI overrides only: plain `codex`, ~/.codex/config.toml and project config
1380	# remain untouched. The alias-like sibling below exists for Claude wrapper
1381	# muscle memory; both names have identical zero-persistence semantics.
1382	codex-copilot() {
1383	  local ss="auto" arg explicit_model=0 model='' catalog='' models=''
1384	  case "${1:-}" in
1385	    --no-specstory) ss="never"; shift ;;
1386	    --specstory)    shift ;;
1387	    -h|--help)
1388	      printf '%s\n' "Usage: codex-copilot [--no-specstory] [codex args...]"
1389	      printf '%s\n' "  One-off Codex session on the local Copilot Responses gateway."
1390	      printf '%s\n' "  Auto model: OpenAI/Codex > Claude > Gemini > other served chat models."
1391	      printf '%s\n' "  Alias: codex-copilot-once"
1392	      return 0 ;;
1393	  esac
1394	
1395	  if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1396	    printf '%s\n' "codex-copilot: jq is required for live model selection" >&2
1397	    return 1
1398	  fi
1399	  if ! _copilot_alive; then copilot-proxy start || return 1; fi
1400	  # Codex needs the shim even when burst throttling is persistently disabled:
1401	  # GitHub's Responses validator rejects empty MCP tool descriptions that the
1402	  # native OpenAI endpoint accepts. Starting it here does not change shim state.
1403	  if ! _copilot_shim_alive; then _copilot_shim_start || return 1; fi
1404	
1405	  catalog="$(_copilot_model_catalog)" || {
1406	    printf '%s\n' "codex-copilot: could not read the live gateway model catalog" >&2
1407	    return 1
1408	  }
1409	  for arg in "$@"; do
1410	    case "$arg" in -m|--model|-m=*|--model=*) explicit_model=1 ;; esac
1411	  done
1412	  if [ "$explicit_model" -eq 0 ]; then
1413	    models="$(printf '%s' "$catalog" | jq -r '
1414	      .data[]?
1415	      | select((.policy.state // "enabled") != "disabled")
1416	      | select(.model_picker_enabled != false)
1417	      | select((.capabilities.type // "chat") != "embeddings")
1418	      | .id // empty' 2>/dev/null | command sort -u)"
1419	    model="$(printf '%s\n' "$models" | _copilot_codex_pick_best_model)" || {
1420	      printf '%s\n' "codex-copilot: no usable chat model in the live gateway catalog" >&2
1421	      return 1
1422	    }
1423	    set -- -m "$model" "$@"
1424	    case "$model" in
1425	      claude-*|gemini-*)
1426	        printf '%s\n' "codex-copilot: --auto -> $model (Responses Lite; tool_search unavailable)" >&2 ;;
1427	      *) printf '%s\n' "codex-copilot: --auto -> $model" >&2 ;;
1428	    esac
1429	  fi
1430	
1431	  # Keep these overrides per-process/per-invocation. `name = OpenAI` is an
1432	  # upstream gateway requirement; the dummy key only satisfies Codex's provider
1433	  # auth contract and is ignored by our unauthenticated localhost listener.
1434	  local base cmd context='' compact=''
1435	  base="$(_copilot_shim_base)"
1436	  cmd="$(_copilot_specstory_codex_cmd)"
1437	  if [ -n "$model" ]; then
1438	    context="$(printf '%s' "$catalog" | jq -r --arg id "$model" '
1439	      first(.data[]? | select(.id == $id) | .capabilities.limits.max_context_window_tokens) // empty' 2>/dev/null)"
1440	    compact="$(printf '%s' "$catalog" | jq -r --arg id "$model" '
1441	      first(.data[]? | select(.id == $id) | .capabilities.limits.max_prompt_tokens) // empty' 2>/dev/null)"
1442	  fi
1443	  # Prepend discovered metadata; any explicit user `-c` remains later in argv
1444	  # and therefore retains normal Codex CLI precedence.
1445	  if [ -n "$compact" ]; then set -- -c "model_auto_compact_token_limit=$compact" "$@"; fi
1446	  if [ -n "$context" ]; then set -- -c "model_context_window=$context" "$@"; fi
1447	
1448	  local bundled_catalog='' provider_args=""
1449	  if bundled_catalog="$(_copilot_codex_catalog_file)"; then
1450	    # Prepend so an explicit later user -c retains normal Codex precedence.
1451	    set -- -c "model_catalog_json=\"$bundled_catalog\"" "$@"
1452	  else
1453	    printf '%s\n' "codex-copilot: warning: could not build the bundled Codex model catalog; metadata may fall back" >&2
1454	  fi
1455	  # Build a shell-safe command fragment for SpecStory; direct execution below
1456	  # uses the original argv and does not round-trip through a string.
1457	  for arg in \
1458	    -c 'model_provider="copilot_api"' \
1459	    -c 'model_providers.copilot_api.name="OpenAI"' \
1460	    -c "model_providers.copilot_api.base_url=\"$base\"" \
1461	    -c 'model_providers.copilot_api.env_key="GITHUB_COPILOT_API_KEY"' \
1462	    -c 'model_providers.copilot_api.requires_openai_auth=true' \
1463	    -c 'model_providers.copilot_api.supports_websockets=false' \
1464	    -c 'model_providers.copilot_api.wire_api="responses"' \
1465	    -c 'model_providers.copilot_api.request_max_retries=3' \
1466	    -c 'model_providers.copilot_api.stream_max_retries=1' \
1467	    -c 'model_providers.copilot_api.stream_idle_timeout_ms=300000' \

1493	codex-copilot-once() { codex-copilot "$@"; }
1494	
1495	# --- specstory `-c` passthrough (why the base command must come from config) ----
1496	#
1497	# specstory's `-c/--command` REPLACES the provider's configured command — it does
1498	# NOT append to it. The shipped config says as much: "Use of these is equivalent
1499	# to -c \"custom command\"" — same slot, last write wins. So a hardcoded
1500	# `-c "claude $*"` silently drops every flag in `claude_cmd` the moment
1501	# claude-copilot has args to pass through.
1502	#
1503	# Symptom that found this (verified 2026-07, specstory 2.5.0): with
1504	# `claude_cmd = "claude --dangerously-skip-permissions"` in the specstory config,
1505	# a bare `claude-copilot-once` took the no-`-c` branch and correctly ran in
1506	# bypass-permissions mode, but `claude-copilot-once --resume X` took the `-c`
1507	# branch and fell back to ~/.claude/settings.json's permissions.defaultMode
1508	# ("auto"). Same wrapper, opposite permission mode, no warning either way.
1509	#
1510	# Deriving the base command from the config keeps specstory the single source of
1511	# truth for BOTH branches: change `claude_cmd` there and both paths follow.
1512	# `--no-specstory` deliberately does NOT inherit it (opting out of specstory
1513	# means opting out of its config too).
1514	
1515	# Effective `claude_cmd`, honouring specstory's own precedence:
1516	#   project ./.specstory/cli/config.toml > user ~/.specstory/cli/config.toml
1517	#   > bare `claude`
1518	# Matches UNCOMMENTED assignments only — both shipped configs carry a commented
1519	# `# claude_cmd = "claude"` example, and matching that would re-introduce the very
1520	# bug this exists to fix. Handles TOML's double- and single-quoted strings.
1521	_copilot_specstory_claude_cmd() {
1522	  local f cmd=''
1523	  for f in ".specstory/cli/config.toml" "$HOME/.specstory/cli/config.toml"; do
1524	    [ -f "$f" ] || continue
1525	    cmd="$(command sed -n \
1526	      -e "s/^[[:space:]]*claude_cmd[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*\"\([^\"]*\)\".*/\1/p" \
1527	      -e "s/^[[:space:]]*claude_cmd[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*'\([^']*\)'.*/\1/p" \
1528	      "$f" 2>/dev/null | command head -n 1)"
1529	    if [ -n "$cmd" ]; then break; fi
1530	  done
1531	  printf '%s' "${cmd:-claude}"
1532	}
1533	
1534	# Single-quote ONE argument for embedding in specstory's `-c` command STRING.
```

168	#
169	# pkg_name feeds the pkill pattern that reaps a stalled `bun add`. The naive
170	# "${spec%@*}" returns EMPTY for a scoped spec with no version, which would turn
171	# the reap into `pkill -f 'bun add.*'` — a pattern that matches every bun install
172	# on the box. Hence the scope-stripped test inside the helper, and these cases.

436	  # path — a non-streaming caller would choke on injected comment frames.

439	  [ "$(printf '%s' "$output" | jq -r '.truthy')" = "false" ]

450	  cat >"$TMP/keepalive.js" <<'JS'
451	const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
452	const up = Bun.serve({ port: 0, idleTimeout: 60, async fetch(req) {
453	  const u = new URL(req.url);
454	  await sleep(Number(u.searchParams.get("delay") ?? 0));
455	  if (u.searchParams.get("mode") === "status")
456	    return new Response('{"error":"nope"}', { status: 400, headers: { "content-type": "application/json" } });
457	  return new Response("event: message_start\ndata: {}\n\nevent: message_stop\ndata: {}\n\n",
458	    { headers: { "content-type": "text/event-stream" } });
459	} });
460	process.env.COPILOT_SHIM_PORT = "0";
461	process.env.COPILOT_SHIM_UPSTREAM = `http://localhost:${up.port}`;

463	process.env.COPILOT_SHIM_PING_AFTER_MS = "100";

466	const shim = startServer();

468	  const r = await fetch(`http://localhost:${shim.port}/v1/messages${q}`, { method: "POST",
469	    headers: { "content-type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ model: "m", stream }) });
470	  const body = await r.text();
471	  return { status: r.status, ct: r.headers.get("content-type"),
472	    pings: (body.match(/^: /gm) ?? []).length,
473	    events: (body.match(/^event: (\S+)/gm) ?? []).map((s) => s.slice(7)) };
474	};
475	const out = {
476	  slow:    await call("?delay=800"),
477	  fast:    await call("?delay=0"),
478	  plain:   await call("?delay=800&mode=status", false),
479	  lateErr: await call("?delay=800&mode=status"),
480	};
481	console.log(JSON.stringify(out));
482	shim.stop(true); up.stop(true);

```text
1	# copilot-proxy
2	
3	A native PowerShell port of the `copilot-proxy` tool series. It runs the
4	[`@jeffreycao/copilot-api`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@jeffreycao/copilot-api)
5	fork so a **GitHub Copilot subscription** can back **Claude Code** and other
6	Anthropic/OpenAI-compatible clients.
7	
8	The module is deployed to `~/.config/powershell/modules/Copilot` and imported by
9	the PowerShell profile. It requires Bun, Node/npm and a Copilot subscription.
10	
11	## Commands
12	
13	| Command | What it does |
14	|---|---|
15	| `copilot-proxy auth` | one-time GitHub device login (`copilot-api auth login --provider copilot`; stores but does not display the token) |
16	| `copilot-proxy start` / `stop` / `restart` | manage the local proxy (port 4141) |
17	| `copilot-proxy status` | show raw served count and Claude availability |
18	| `copilot-proxy doctor [--live]` | diagnose package, auth, proxy, catalog, roles, upstream and Codex Apps |
19	| `copilot-proxy logs [N]` | tail the proxy log |
20	| `copilot-proxy shim [on\|off]` | toggle the throttle shim (port 4142) |
21	| `copilot-proxy whoami` | account / plan / quota |
22	| `copilot-proxy reinstall` | wipe and reinstall the pinned package |
23	| `copilot-run <cmd...>` | run a command with the proxy env injected |
24	| `claude-copilot` | one-off Claude Code session on the proxy |
25	| `claude-copilot-once` | pin this project, run once, then restore it |
26	| `codex-copilot` / `codex-copilot-once` | zero-persistence Codex session on the Responses proxy |
27	| `copilot-here [on\|off\|status]` | sticky project pin in `.claude/settings.local.json` |
28	| `copilot-model [<id>\|-l\|-c\|--auto]` | switch or inspect the complete role profile |
29	| `copilot-embed [TEXT\|-]` | embed text through `/v1/embeddings` |
30	| `semsearch index \| <QUERY>` | semantic search over local text |
31	
32	## Quick start
33	
34	```powershell
35	copilot-proxy auth                 # once
36	copilot-proxy start
37	copilot-model --auto              # select from the live catalog
38	copilot-model -c                   # inspect Main/Fable/Opus/Sonnet/Haiku
39	copilot-here on                    # sticky project; or use claude-copilot-once
40	codex-copilot                     # Codex; live OpenAI-first model selection
41	```
42	
43	Existing global and project pins are deliberately not migrated by `chezmoi
44	apply`. Run `copilot-model --auto` once after this upgrade. When `copilot-here`
45	is active, that command refreshes the local role set; otherwise it updates the
46	global one-line main-model state.
47	
48	## How routing works
49	
50	```text
51	Claude Code --Anthropic /v1/messages--> copilot-api (localhost:4141)
52	                                          | Claude: native Messages path
53	                                          | GPT: Anthropic -> Responses translation
54	                                          v
55	                                  GitHub Copilot API
56	```
57	
58	The default package is `@jeffreycao/copilot-api@2.1.0`. For GPT ids it translates
59	Claude Code requests to Responses, including `output_config.effort` to
60	`reasoning.effort`. This is required for GPT-5.6 and Claude Code's `ultracode`
61	effort setting; the old `1.13.14` path could replace the requested effort with a
62	hard-coded fallback.
63	
64	The package is installed once under `~/.local/share/copilot-api/pkg`. Windows
65	uses `npm.cmd` first because it understands the Azure Artifacts credential
66	provider in `~/.npmrc`; Bun remains the fallback/runtime. Readiness is based on
67	the installed `package.json` name/version, a verified stamp, and a runnable launch
68	path—not merely an old directory or binlink. A failed install cannot restamp or
69	launch stale package contents. `COPILOT_API_PKG` accepts registry package specs
70	(name or `@scope/name` with an optional version/tag/range); npm aliases and
71	local/git/URL specs are rejected before filesystem cleanup. Warm starts do no
72	package network work.
73	
74	On a corporate mirror, `ETARGET` can mean the exact public version has not synced
75	yet. Check the registry that npm is actually using before deleting the working
76	prefix:
77	
78	```powershell
79	npm config get registry
80	npm view '@jeffreycao/copilot-api@2.1.0' version
81	# Optional comparison where direct public npm is permitted:
82	npm view '@jeffreycao/copilot-api@2.1.0' version --registry https://registry.npmjs.org/
83	```
84	
85	If only the configured mirror is missing the version, wait/request mirror sync or
86	use an approved registry for `copilot-proxy reinstall`. The Windows module also
87	falls back automatically to the exact 2.1.0 runtime files on jsDelivr, verifies a
88	baked SHA-256 for every file, then resolves only its ordinary dependencies through
89	the configured npm registry. This handles a lagging mirror without weakening the
90	pin or bypassing the approved feed for the dependency tree. Do not replace the
91	tested exact pin with `latest`.
92	
93	## Model selection and role profile
94	
95	`copilot-model --auto` requires the live `/v1/models` catalog. It prefers served
96	Claude families (`Fable > Opus > Sonnet > Haiku`), then ranks OpenAI by capability:
97	
98	```text
99	Sol > Terra > GPT-5.5 > GPT-5.4 > GPT-5.3 Codex > Luna > mini > Gemini
100	```
101	
102	Luna follows the older flagships because it is the lightweight tier. This role
103	intent follows OpenAI's [current model guidance](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/latest-model).
104	For the normal Claude-less Copilot catalog, the generated profile is:
105	
106	| Claude Code role | Copilot model |
107	|---|---|
108	| Main / Fable / Opus | `gpt-5.6-sol` |
109	| Sonnet | `gpt-5.6-terra` |
110	| Haiku / background / legacy small-fast | `gpt-5.6-luna` |
111	
112	A manually selected OpenAI main remains Main/Fable/Opus; Terra and Luna are used
113	for the lower roles when served. Missing tiers fall back to the selected main,
114	never to an unserved hard-coded id. Native Claude profiles select the strongest
115	served model in each Claude family.
116	
117	The `[1m]` suffix is a Claude Code-only context hint. It is derived from each
118	model's live `max_context_window_tokens` metadata when the value is at least one
119	million. Raw API clients must use the plain id. Offline manual discovery remains
120	available, but offline `--auto` refuses to write a potentially stale pin.
121	
122	Both `copilot-run` and `copilot-here on` inject the same variables:
123	
124	```text
125	ANTHROPIC_MODEL
126	ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL
127	ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL
128	ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL
129	ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL
130	ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL
131	```
132	
133	`CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL` is intentionally left unset so workflow/frontmatter
134	routing remains authoritative. Restart Claude Code after changing the profile.
135	
136	## Claude Code feature compatibility
137	
138	The useful boundary is local orchestration versus Anthropic cloud services:
139	
140	| Feature | Through Copilot + GPT | Notes |
141	|---|---|---|
142	| CLI, tools, hooks, skills, memory, plugins, MCP, checkpoints, sandboxing | Yes | Local Claude Code features; GPT behavior may differ after prompt/tool translation. |
143	| Subagents and dynamic workflows | Yes | Role variables are provided without overriding workflow-specific subagent routing. See [workflows](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/workflows). |
144	| `ultracode` | Yes on 2.1.0 | It is xhigh effort plus dynamic workflows, not a separate model. |
145	| Thinking/reasoning | Translated | GPT uses Responses reasoning rather than Anthropic-native thinking semantics. |
146	| Web search, fast/auto mode, MCP tool search | Provider-dependent | Availability depends on the Copilot endpoint and gateway translation. |
147	| Ultrareview, Remote Control, Chrome, cloud Code Review, routines, web/mobile/Slack sessions | No | These require Claude.ai authentication/cloud identity; a local API gateway cannot provide it. |
148	
149	See Claude Code's [feature availability](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/feature-availability),
150	[model configuration](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config),
151	[gateway protocol](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/llm-gateway-protocol), and
152	[Ultrareview](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/ultrareview) references.
153	
154	## Network, entitlement and diagnostics
155	
156	- `COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=auto` reads the Windows System Proxy or an explicit proxy
157	  environment variable, scopes it to the child and passes `--proxy-env`. Node
158	  otherwise ignores the WinINET system setting.
159	- The proxy refreshes its model cache periodically; a restart forces an immediate
160	  refresh. `COPILOT_PROXY_START_TIMEOUT` defaults to 45 seconds because a
161	  Clash/mihomo hop can make the initial refresh exceed the old 20-second budget.
162	- GitHub can vary the catalog by account, organization policy, rollout and egress.
163	  Claude IDs in `/v1/models` are therefore **advertised aliases**, not proof that
164	  inference is authorized. No Claude IDs is not by itself a broken proxy; use
165	  `copilot-model --auto` when you explicitly want to select another served pin.
166	  There is no automatic Claude-to-OpenAI replay after a failed request.
167	- `copilot-proxy doctor` compares direct and proxied upstream catalogs, validates
168	  the main model plus every role alias, and reports stale local pins. `--live`
169	  also compares direct/proxied reachability of remote ChatGPT `codex_apps`, then
170	  sends one real request to the effective configured main model (or a clearly
171	  labeled catalog fallback when that pin is absent). It never retries another
172	  model. Only this inference request consumes quota; timeout and TLS failures are
173	  reported separately.
174	- HTTP 402 with `billing_not_configured` is account-wide and nonretryable. Select
175	  an organization or enterprise under **Usage billed to** at
176	  <https://github.com/settings/copilot/features>. Model changes,
177	  `copilot-model --auto`, and shim toggles cannot repair that account setting.
178	- `copilot-here` writes only the gitignored `.claude/settings.local.json`, never
179	  committed project settings. `off` removes every env key owned by the helper and
180	  preserves unrelated settings.
181	- `claude-copilot` and `claude-copilot-once` retain the Windows port's trusted
182	  `--dangerously-skip-permissions` and optional SpecStory behavior. Plain `claude`
183	  is unaffected.
184	- The throttle shim remains byte-identical to the macOS/Linux copy and retries
185	  transient 403/429 bursts while limiting concurrent requests. It deliberately
186	  passes HTTP 402 through once; billing configuration is not a throttle failure.
187	
188	State lives under `~/.local/state/copilot-proxy/`; device login stores the GitHub
189	token at `~/.local/share/copilot-api/github_token` without printing it by default.
190	
191	## Codex through the gateway
192	
193	`codex-copilot` and its identical `codex-copilot-once` alias start the local
194	gateway/shim and pass a `copilot_api` Responses provider through one-invocation
195	Codex `-c` overrides. They do not edit user or project Codex config, so plain
196	`codex` is unaffected. An explicit `-m` / `--model` wins; otherwise the live raw
197	catalog is ranked OpenAI/Codex first (`Sol > Terra > GPT-5.5 > GPT-5.4 > GPT-5.3
198	Codex > Luna > mini`), then Claude, Gemini and other chat models. Disabled and
199	embedding models are excluded.
200	
201	Codex always uses the shim on `localhost:4142`, even when the persisted
202	throttling toggle is off. Besides throttling, that boundary normalizes blank
203	descriptions in Codex `mcp_list_tools` Responses items. GitHub Copilot rejects
204	those with `Invalid 'input[0].tools[0].description': empty string`, while MCP
205	servers and the native Codex path may omit them. The shim fills only those tool
206	definition fields and leaves prompts, schemas, and tool names unchanged.
207	Codex currently zstd-compresses these requests; the shim decodes only the
208	Responses body it must repair, forwards ordinary JSON, and removes the stale
209	`content-encoding` header.
210	
211	This is a separate picker from Claude Code's `copilot-model --auto`: that path
212	remains Claude-first, while only the Codex launcher is OpenAI-first.
213	
214	SpecStory is automatic when installed. The wrapper preserves the effective
215	`codex_cmd` (project config > user config > bare `codex`) before appending
216	provider/model/user arguments; `--no-specstory` runs Codex directly. Claude and
217	Gemini fallback through Responses Lite, which does not support Responses
218	`tool_search`, so native Responses OpenAI models stay ahead of Anthropic.
219	The launcher also enables gateway-backed remote compaction and excludes the
220	`mcp__codex_apps__sites` namespace that depends on unavailable `tool_search`;
221	later explicit `-c` arguments can override either setting per invocation.
222	
223	`codex_apps` itself is not a localhost service and not an Apple-Silicon-only
224	Codex Desktop bridge. It is a remote MCP at
225	`https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/apps`, so startup can fail even while
226	Copilot inference on `localhost:4142` works. Keep Apps enabled and use
227	`copilot-proxy doctor --live` to diagnose that route independently.
228	
229	There is deliberately no Codex equivalent of `copilot-here`: project
230	`.codex/config.toml` cannot override provider definitions, provider selection or
231	auth metadata. The explicit launcher provides project/session scope without
232	changing the user-wide default.
233	
234	### Experimental direct configuration
235	
236	The direct `model_providers.copilot-enterprise` example is documented in the
237	macOS/Linux guide rather than installed. It is not the localhost proxy path, and
238	the pasted `gh auth token` flow is not portable: on the tested EMU account it
239	returned `421`/`403`, while the credential stored by `copilot-proxy auth` plus
240	the normal short-lived Copilot token exchange worked. The supported launcher
241	therefore uses the authenticated local gateway.
242

935	        It 'keeps the Unix and Windows shim implementations byte-identical' {
936	            $unixShim = '/Users/david/.local/share/chezmoi/dot_config/shell/copilot-throttle-shim.js'
937	            if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $unixShim)) { Set-ItResult -Skipped -Because 'Unix sibling checkout is unavailable'; return }
938	            $windowsShim = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..' 'dot_config' 'powershell' 'copilot-throttle-shim.js'

940	                Should -Be (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 $unixShim).Hash
941	        }
942	
943	        It 'fills blank MCP descriptions without adding one to a native tool' {
944	            if (-not (Get-Command bun -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Set-ItResult -Skipped -Because 'bun is unavailable'; return }
945	            $env:COPILOT_SHIM_TEST_PATH = (Resolve-Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..' 'dot_config' 'powershell' 'copilot-throttle-shim.js')).Path
946	            try {
947	                $json = & bun -e @'
948	import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
949	const { normalizeResponsesToolDescriptions: n } = await import(pathToFileURL(process.env.COPILOT_SHIM_TEST_PATH));
950	const p = { tools: [{ type: "web_search" }], input: [{ type: "plugin_tools", tools: [{ name: "alpha", description: "" }] }] };
951	const r = n(p);
952	console.log(JSON.stringify({ r, p }));
953	'@
954	                $result = $json | ConvertFrom-Json
955	                $result.r.changed | Should -Be 1

AGENTS.md:53:- **copilot-proxy** — `dot_config/powershell/modules/Copilot/` is a native PowerShell port of the parent's `43_copilot_proxy.sh` / `44_copilot_embed.sh` (runs the copilot-api fork so GitHub Copilot can back Claude Code and Codex). Reuses the Bun `copilot-throttle-shim.js` verbatim.
AGENTS.md:55:- **Rime input method** — `installInputMethod`-gated, and the one config surface **shared with the parent repo**. The engine-level YAML lives in `.chezmoitemplates/rime/` (`default.custom.yaml`, `luna_pinyin.custom.yaml`) and is kept **byte-identical** to `daviddwlee84/dotfiles`'s copy of the same path — `diff -r` between the two dirs is the drift check, so edit one and copy to the other in the same session. Each platform is a one-line `{{ template "rime/…" . }}` renderer: `AppData/Roaming/Rime/` here, `private_Library/Rime/` (Squirrel) and `dot_config/ibus/rime/` (ibus-rime) there. Only `weasel.custom.yaml` is Windows-specific (`style/` is Weasel's own, `app_options` keys on the EXE name vs. Squirrel's bundle ids, and `global_ascii` doesn't exist on Squirrel). Plain managed files, **not** a `modify_` overlay: Rime persists runtime state to `user.yaml`, never back into `*.custom.yaml`. Two gotchas: a bare silent winget install registers **简体** (hence `--custom '/T'` in `Install-Weasel` — see `pitfalls/weasel-silent-install-registers-simplified-chinese.md`), and config edits need a redeploy, which `run_onchange_after_50_rime_deploy.ps1` does via `WeaselDeployer.exe /deploy`.
AGENTS.md:76:- Any edit under `.chezmoitemplates/rime/` → copy the file verbatim into the parent repo's `.chezmoitemplates/rime/` (`chezmoi source-path` there, usually `~/.local/share/chezmoi`). They must stay byte-identical; verify with `diff -r`. Frontend-only changes (`weasel.custom.yaml`) do **not** cross over.

docs/shells/aliases.md:825:| `copilot-raycast [status\|generate [--dry-run] [--all]\|diff\|probe [MODEL]\|doctor\|edit]` | function | `dot_config/shell/45_copilot_raycast.sh` | Generate Raycast's AI **Custom Providers** file (`~/.config/raycast/ai/providers.yaml`) from the live proxy catalogue, so every Copilot model shows up in Quick AI / AI Chat / AI Commands. Each model id is filtered by a **zero-quota probe** — `POST /chat/completions` with `{"messages":[]}` is rejected before inference, and the error separates usable models (`messages must be non-empty`) from ones `/v1/models` only *claims* to serve (`model_not_supported`, `unsupported_api_for_model`); no field in the static metadata predicts this. `base_url` follows `_copilot_pinned_base` (the throttle shim when it is on), the sweep POSTs to `:4141` direct. Writes are backed up to `~/.local/state/copilot-raycast/backups/`, `yq`-validated and atomically moved — a malformed file makes Raycast **silently** drop *every* custom provider. Other providers in the file are preserved verbatim (needs `yq`). `status`/`doctor` read `raycastAI_modelRouterModelInfo` from Raycast's prefs to show what it actually loaded. Needs `jq` + `curl`; `yq` for validation/preservation. Env: `COPILOT_RAYCAST_{CONFIG,ID,LABEL,SUFFIX,TEMP,JOBS,PROBE_BASE,KEEP}` |
docs/shells/aliases.zh-TW.md:667:| `copilot-raycast [status\|generate [--dry-run] [--all]\|diff\|probe [MODEL]\|doctor\|edit]` | function | `dot_config/shell/45_copilot_raycast.sh` | 從即時的代理 (proxy) 模型清單產生 Raycast 的 AI **Custom Providers** 設定檔（`~/.config/raycast/ai/providers.yaml`），讓每個 Copilot 模型都出現在 Quick AI / AI Chat / AI Commands。每個 model id 都經過**零額度探針 (zero-quota probe)** 過濾——帶 `{"messages":[]}` 打 `POST /chat/completions` 會在推論 (inference) 前就被拒絕，而錯誤訊息可區分真正可用的模型（`messages must be non-empty`）與 `/v1/models` 只是「宣稱」有提供的模型（`model_not_supported`、`unsupported_api_for_model`）；靜態 metadata 裡沒有任何欄位能預測這件事。`base_url` 沿用 `_copilot_pinned_base`（throttle shim 開著時指向 shim），但掃描本身直接打 `:4141`。寫入前會備份到 `~/.local/state/copilot-raycast/backups/`、用 `yq` 驗證後才原子性 (atomic) 搬移——格式壞掉的檔案會讓 Raycast **無聲地**丟掉*所有* custom provider。檔案裡其他 provider 會原樣保留（需要 `yq`）。`status`/`doctor` 會讀 Raycast prefs 裡的 `raycastAI_modelRouterModelInfo`，顯示 Raycast 實際載入了什麼。需要 `jq` + `curl`；`yq` 用於驗證與保留。環境變數：`COPILOT_RAYCAST_{CONFIG,ID,LABEL,SUFFIX,TEMP,JOBS,PROBE_BASE,KEEP}` |

1837	# y/N prompt. Returns $true only on an explicit yes; a non-interactive host
1838	# returns $false — the safe default (keep, don't override). Only called right
1839	# before launching an interactive Claude Code session, so reading input is fine.
1840	function script:Confirm-CopilotAction {
1841	    param([string] $Message = 'Proceed? [y/N]')

1847	# Has THIS project's copilot-here pin drifted from what `copilot-here on` would
1848	# write now (default model bumped, proxy moved, a key added since the pin was
1849	# written)? Returns one "  KEY : old -> new" line per drifted key, or nothing.
1850	#
1851	# Drift is defined as "the set of keys `copilot-here on` would actually CHANGE",
1852	# computed by diffing the live file against Get-CopilotEnvBlock — not a hand-picked
1853	# subset (that is how three keys silently went unchecked). The asymmetry is
1854	# deliberate: keys present in the file but absent from the want-set are NOT drift,
1855	# because `on` merges and never removes them (only `off` does).
1856	function script:Get-CopilotHereDrift {
1857	    $settings = '.claude/settings.local.json'
1858	    if (-not (Test-Path $settings)) { return @() }
1859	    try { $obj = Get-Content -Raw $settings | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { return @() }
1860	    # ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL is only set while the pin is ON — absent -> nothing to do.
1861	    if (-not $obj.env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL) { return @() }
1862	
1863	    $want = Get-CopilotEnvBlock -Pinned
1864	    $out = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
1865	    foreach ($k in $want.Keys) {
1866	        $cur = if ($obj.env.PSObject.Properties[$k]) { $obj.env.$k } else { '(unset)' }
1867	        if ($cur -ne $want[$k]) { $out.Add("  $k : $cur -> $($want[$k])") }
1868	    }
1869	    $out
1870	}

1872	function copilot-here {
1873	    [CmdletBinding()]
1874	    param([Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments)] [string[]] $Argv)
1875	    $settings = '.claude/settings.local.json'
1876	    $action = if ($Argv -and $Argv.Count -ge 1) { $Argv[0] } else { 'status' }
1877	    switch ($action) {
1878	        'on' {
1879	            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path '.claude' | Out-Null
1880	            $obj = if (Test-Path $settings) { try { Get-Content -Raw $settings | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { [pscustomobject]@{} } } else { [pscustomobject]@{} }
1881	            if (-not $obj.PSObject.Properties['env']) { $obj | Add-Member -NotePropertyName env -NotePropertyValue ([pscustomobject]@{}) }
1882	            # Single source of truth, shared with copilot-run and the drift check.
1883	            $envSet = Get-CopilotEnvBlock -Pinned
1884	            $model = $envSet.ANTHROPIC_MODEL
1885	            foreach ($k in $envSet.Keys) {
1886	                if ($obj.env.PSObject.Properties[$k]) { $obj.env.$k = $envSet[$k] }
1887	                else { $obj.env | Add-Member -NotePropertyName $k -NotePropertyValue $envSet[$k] }
1888	            }
1889	            $obj | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $settings -Encoding utf8
1890	            # Belt-and-braces gitignore via .git/info/exclude (un-anchored **/ form).
1891	            $gitDir = git rev-parse --git-dir 2>$null
1892	            if ($gitDir) {
1893	                git check-ignore -q $settings 2>$null
1894	                if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
1895	                    $exclude = Join-Path $gitDir 'info/exclude'
1896	                    Add-Content -Path $exclude -Value '**/.claude/settings.local.json'
1897	                }
1898	            }
1899	            Write-Host "copilot-here: ON — $settings pins Claude Code to $(Get-CopilotBase) (model: $model)"
1900	            if (-not (Test-CopilotAlive)) { Write-Host "  WARNING proxy not running — start it: copilot-proxy start" }
1901	        }
1902	        'off' {
1903	            if (-not (Test-Path $settings)) { Write-Host "copilot-here: already off (no $settings)"; return }
1904	            try { $obj = Get-Content -Raw $settings | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { Write-Error "copilot-here: $settings is not valid JSON"; return }
1905	            if ($obj.env) {
1906	                foreach ($k in $script:CopilotHereKeys) { if ($obj.env.PSObject.Properties[$k]) { $obj.env.PSObject.Properties.Remove($k) } }
1907	                if (-not $obj.env.PSObject.Properties) { $obj.PSObject.Properties.Remove('env') }
1908	            }
1909	            if (-not $obj.PSObject.Properties.Name) {
1910	                Remove-Item $settings -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
1911	                Write-Host "copilot-here: OFF — removed $settings (it held only proxy config)"
1912	            } else {
1913	                $obj | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $settings -Encoding utf8
1914	                Write-Host "copilot-here: OFF — proxy env removed from $settings (other content kept)"
1915	            }
1916	        }
1917	        'status' {
1918	            if (Test-Path $settings) {
1919	                try { $obj = Get-Content -Raw $settings | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { $obj = $null }
1920	                if ($obj.env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL) {
1921	                    Write-Host "copilot-here: ON  (base: $($obj.env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL), model: $($obj.env.ANTHROPIC_MODEL))"
1922	                    $drift = Get-CopilotHereDrift
1923	                    if ($drift) {
1924	                        Write-Host '  ! stale vs current defaults:'
1925	                        $drift | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ }
1926	                        Write-Host '  refresh in place: copilot-here on'
1927	                    }
1928	                    if (-not (Test-CopilotAlive)) { Write-Host "  WARNING proxy not running — start it: copilot-proxy start" }
1929	                    return
1930	                }
1931	            }
1932	            Write-Host "copilot-here: off  (enable: copilot-here on; one-off: claude-copilot)"
1933	        }
1934	        default { Write-Host "Usage: copilot-here [on|off|status]" }
1935	    }
1936	}

1938	# Pick the best raw served id for the main Claude Code model. Claude remains the
1939	# first choice when entitled. Without Claude, rank OpenAI by capability tier and
1940	# deliberately place lightweight Luna behind older flagship/coding tiers.
1941	function script:Select-CopilotBestModel {
1942	    param([string[]] $Model)
1943	    if (-not $Model -or $Model.Count -eq 0) { return $null }
1944	    $Model = @($Model | ForEach-Object { Remove-CopilotContextHint $_ } | Sort-Object -Unique)
1945	
1946	    foreach ($preferred in 'claude-fable-5',
1947	                           'claude-opus-5', 'claude-opus-4-8', 'claude-opus-4-7', 'claude-opus-4-6',
1948	                           'claude-sonnet-5', 'claude-sonnet-4-6', 'claude-sonnet-4-5',
1949	                           'claude-opus-4-5', 'claude-haiku-4-5') {
1950	        if ($Model -contains $preferred) { return $preferred }
1951	    }
1952	    $pick = { param($re, $exclude)
1953	        $c = @($Model | Where-Object { $_ -match $re -and (-not $exclude -or $_ -notmatch $exclude) } | Sort-Object)
1954	        if ($c.Count -gt 0) { $c[-1] } else { $null }
1955	    }
1956	    $r = & $pick '^claude-' $null
1957	    if ($r) { return $r }
1958	
1959	    foreach ($preferred in 'gpt-5.6-sol', 'gpt-5.6-terra', 'gpt-5.5', 'gpt-5.4', 'gpt-5.3-codex') {
1960	        if ($Model -contains $preferred) { return $preferred }
1961	    }
1962	
1963	    foreach ($try in @(@('^gpt-', 'mini|nano|luna'), @('codex', $null))) {
1964	        $r = & $pick $try[0] $try[1]
1965	        if ($r) { return $r }
1966	    }
1967	
1968	    foreach ($preferred in 'gpt-5.6-luna', 'gpt-5.4-mini', 'gpt-5-mini') {
1969	        if ($Model -contains $preferred) { return $preferred }
1970	    }
1971	
1972	    foreach ($try in @(@('^gpt-', $null), @('^gemini-', 'flash'), @('^gemini-', $null))) {
1973	        $r = & $pick $try[0] $try[1]
1974	        if ($r) { return $r }
1975	    }
1976	    (@($Model | Sort-Object))[-1]
1977	}

2110	function copilot-embed {
2111	    [CmdletBinding()]

2120	            '^--json$' { $wantJson = $true }

2122	            '^(-h|--help)$' { Write-Host "Usage: copilot-embed [--model M] [--json] [TEXT | -]`n       copilot-embed -l"; return }
2123	            default { $rest.Add($Argv[$i]) }
2124	        }
2125	    }
2126	    if (-not (Test-CopilotAlive)) { copilot-proxy start; if (-not (Test-CopilotAlive)) { return } }
2127	
2128	    if ($doList) {

2130	        return

2133	    $text = if ($rest.Count -gt 0 -and $rest[0] -ne '-') { $rest -join ' ' } elseif (-not [Console]::IsInputRedirected) { Write-Error "copilot-embed: no text — pass an arg or pipe stdin"; return } else { [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() }
2134	    if (-not $text) { Write-Error "copilot-embed: empty input"; return }
2135	
2136	    # input MUST be an array (scalar 400s — fork issue #100).
2137	    $payload = if ($model) { @{ model = $model; input = @($text) } } else { @{ input = @($text) } }
2138	    try {
2139	        $resp = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$(Get-CopilotBase)/v1/embeddings" -Method Post -ContentType 'application/json' `
2140	            -Body ($payload | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5) -TimeoutSec 60 -ErrorAction Stop
2141	    } catch { Write-Error "copilot-embed: request failed — is the proxy up? ($_)"; return }
2142	
2143	    if ($wantJson) { $resp | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8; return }
2144	    $vec = $resp.data[0].embedding
2145	    if (-not $vec) { Write-Error "copilot-embed: empty embedding"; return }

1543	# One-off Claude Code session backed by the Copilot proxy. Nothing on disk

1548	# the configured `claude_cmd` (see the block above — `-c` REPLACES that command,

1550	# Example:
1551	#   claude-copilot                 # specstory run claude (proxy env)
1552	#   claude-copilot -c              # continue last session
1553	#   claude-copilot --no-specstory  # raw claude, no markdown auto-save
1554	claude-copilot() {
1555	  local ss="auto"
1556	  case "${1:-}" in
1557	    --no-specstory) ss="never"; shift ;;
1558	    --specstory)    shift ;;
1559	    -h|--help)
1560	      printf '%s\n' "Usage: claude-copilot [--no-specstory] [claude args...]"
1561	      printf '%s\n' "  One-off Claude Code session on the Copilot proxy (no file writes)."
1562	      printf '%s\n' "  Sticky per-project instead: copilot-here on"
1563	      return 0 ;;
1564	  esac
1565	  if [ "$ss" = "auto" ] && command -v specstory >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1566	    if [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; then
1567	      # Rebuild what `-c` clobbers: the configured base command (ITS flags left
1568	      # unquoted so specstory splits them normally) + each of our args quoted.
1569	      local _cc_cmd _cc_arg
1570	      _cc_cmd="$(_copilot_specstory_claude_cmd)"
1571	      for _cc_arg in "$@"; do
1572	        _cc_cmd="$_cc_cmd $(_copilot_shquote "$_cc_arg")"
1573	      done
1574	      copilot-run specstory run claude -c "$_cc_cmd"
1575	    else
1576	      copilot-run specstory run claude
1577	    fi
1578	  else
1579	    copilot-run claude "$@"
1580	  fi
1581	}
1582	
1583	# --- per-project toggle (Layer 2: sticky, gitignored settings.local.json) --------
1584	
1585	# Env keys we own in .claude/settings.local.json (kept in one place so `off`
1586	# removes exactly what `on` added — including the COPILOT_PROXY_QUIET extras,
1587	# regardless of the knob's value at `off` time).
1588	_copilot_here_keys='["ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL","ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN","ANTHROPIC_MODEL","ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL","ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL","ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL","ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL","ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL","CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC","CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER","CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_PROMPT_SUGGESTION","CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AWAY_SUMMARY","DISABLE_NON_ESSENTIAL_MODEL_CALLS"]'
1589	
1590	# The EXACT env object `copilot-here on` would write right now, as JSON.
1591	#
1592	# SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for both `copilot-here on` (what it merges in) and
1593	# _copilot_here_drift (what it compares against). These were two hand-maintained
1594	# copies and they had already diverged: `on` wrote 8 keys while the drift check
1595	# compared only 4, so a pin written by an older `on` — current models but no
1596	# ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL / ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL /
1597	# CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC — reported "no drift" while `on`
1598	# would still have changed it. Add a key here and BOTH sides follow.
1599	#
1600	# Needs jq; every caller already requires it.
1601	_copilot_env_json_for_model() {
1602	  local selected="$1" catalog="${2:-}" profile
1603	  if [ "$#" -ge 2 ]; then
1604	    profile="$(_copilot_model_profile_json "$selected" "$catalog")" || return 1
1605	  else
1606	    profile="$(_copilot_model_profile_json "$selected")" || return 1
1607	  fi
1608	  jq -n \
1609	    --arg base_url "$(_copilot_pinned_base)" \
1610	    --argjson profile "$profile" \
1611	    --arg quiet "${COPILOT_PROXY_QUIET:-0}" '
1612	    {
1613	      ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL: $base_url,
1614	      ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN: "dummy",
1615	      ANTHROPIC_MODEL: $profile.main,
1616	      ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL: $profile.fable,
1617	      ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL: $profile.opus,
1618	      ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL: $profile.sonnet,
1619	      ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL: $profile.haiku,
1620	      ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL: $profile.haiku,
1621	      CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC: "1"
1622	    } + (if $quiet == "1" then {
1623	      CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER: "0",
1624	      CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_PROMPT_SUGGESTION: "false",
1625	      CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AWAY_SUMMARY: "0",
1626	      DISABLE_NON_ESSENTIAL_MODEL_CALLS: "1"
1627	    } else {} end)'
1628	}
1629	
1630	_copilot_env_json() {
1631	  _copilot_env_json_for_model "$(_copilot_default_model)"
1632	}
1633	
1634	# Pin THIS project to the Copilot proxy via ./.claude/settings.local.json —
1635	# the gitignored local layer that overrides the committed .claude/settings.json
1636	# (so claude-plans-here's plansDirectory stays untouched). Plain `claude` then
1637	# uses the proxy here until `copilot-here off`.
1638	# Example:
1639	#   copilot-here on        # pin project to the proxy
1640	#   copilot-here status    # pinned? which model?
1641	#   copilot-here off       # unpin (removes only our env keys)
1642	copilot-here() {
1643	  if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1644	    printf '%s\n' "copilot-here: jq is required" >&2; return 1
1645	  fi
1646	
1647	  local settings=".claude/settings.local.json"
1648	  local action="${1:-status}"
1649	  case "$action" in
1650	    on)
1651	      command mkdir -p .claude
1652	      local base='{}'
1653	      [ -f "$settings" ] && base="$(command cat "$settings")"
1654	      [ -n "$base" ] || base='{}'
1655	      local base_url model want_env
1656	      want_env="$(_copilot_env_json)" || return 1
1657	      base_url="$(printf '%s' "$want_env" | jq -r '.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL')"
1658	      model="$(printf '%s' "$want_env" | jq -r '.ANTHROPIC_MODEL')"
1659	      local tmp; tmp="$(command mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/copilot-here.XXXXXX")" || return 1
1660	      if printf '%s' "$base" | jq --argjson want "$want_env" \
1661	          '.env = ((.env // {}) + $want)' >"$tmp"; then
1662	        command mv -- "$tmp" "$settings"
1663	      else
1664	        command rm -f -- "$tmp"
1665	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-here: jq failed; $settings unchanged" >&2
1666	        return 1
1667	      fi
1668	      # Claude Code only auto-gitignores settings.local.json when IT creates the
1669	      # file — since we created it, belt-and-braces via .git/info/exclude (a
1670	      # per-clone, never-committed ignore, so the proxy toggle leaves nothing to
1671	      # commit — unlike Claude Code's own root-.gitignore entry).
1672	      if command git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1673	        if ! command git check-ignore -q "$settings" 2>/dev/null; then
1674	          local exclude; exclude="$(command git rev-parse --git-dir)/info/exclude"
1675	          # MUST be the un-anchored **/ form, NOT a bare .claude/settings.local.json:
1676	          # a pattern with an internal slash is anchored to the repo ROOT, so it
1677	          # would not ignore the file when THIS project lives in a subdirectory of
1678	          # a larger repo (e.g. skills/foo/.claude/…). **/ matches at any depth —
1679	          # one idempotent line covers root + every nested project.
1680	          printf '%s\n' "**/.claude/settings.local.json" >>"$exclude"
1681	        fi
1682	      fi
1683	      printf '%s\n' "copilot-here: ON — $settings pins Claude Code to $base_url (model: $model)"
1684	      printf '%s\n' "  plain \`claude\` in this project now uses the proxy (restart any running session)"
1685	      _copilot_alive || printf '%s\n' "  ⚠ proxy not running — start it with: copilot-proxy start"
1686	      ;;
1687	    off)
1688	      if [ ! -f "$settings" ]; then
1689	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-here: already off (no $settings)"
1690	        return 0
1691	      fi
1692	      local tmp; tmp="$(command mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/copilot-here.XXXXXX")" || return 1
1693	      # Remove only OUR env keys; drop .env when it empties; keep other content.
1694	      if jq --argjson keys "$_copilot_here_keys" '
1695	          .env = ((.env // {}) | with_entries(select(.key as $k | ($keys | index($k)) == null)))
1696	          | if .env == {} then del(.env) else . end' \
1697	          "$settings" >"$tmp"; then
1698	        if [ "$(jq -r 'if . == {} then "empty" else "kept" end' "$tmp")" = "empty" ]; then
1699	          command rm -f -- "$tmp" "$settings"
1700	          printf '%s\n' "copilot-here: OFF — removed $settings (it held only proxy config)"
1701	        else
1702	          command mv -- "$tmp" "$settings"
1703	          printf '%s\n' "copilot-here: OFF — proxy env removed from $settings (other content kept)"
1704	        fi
1705	        printf '%s\n' "  plain \`claude\` is back on the real Anthropic backend (restart any running session)"
1706	      else
1707	        command rm -f -- "$tmp"
1708	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-here: jq failed; $settings unchanged" >&2
1709	        return 1
1710	      fi
1711	      ;;
1712	    status)
1713	      if [ -f "$settings" ] && [ "$(jq -r '.env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL // empty' "$settings" 2>/dev/null)" != "" ]; then
1714	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-here: ON  (base: $(jq -r '.env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL' "$settings"), model: $(jq -r '.env.ANTHROPIC_MODEL // "(unset)"' "$settings"))"
1715	        local _drift; _drift="$(_copilot_here_drift)"
1716	        [ -n "$_drift" ] && { printf '%s\n' "  ⚠ stale vs current defaults:"; printf '%s\n' "$_drift"; printf '%s\n' "  refresh in place: copilot-here on"; }
1717	        _copilot_alive || printf '%s\n' "  ⚠ proxy not running — start it with: copilot-proxy start"
1718	      else
1719	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-here: off  (enable: copilot-here on; one-off: claude-copilot)"
1720	        return 1
1721	      fi
1722	      ;;
1723	    -h|--help|help)
1724	      printf '%s\n' "Usage: copilot-here [on|off|status]   (toggles ./.claude/settings.local.json)"
1725	      ;;
1726	    *)
1727	      printf '%s\n' "copilot-here: unknown action '$action' (try --help)" >&2
1728	      return 1
1729	      ;;
1730	  esac
1731	}
1732	
1733	# --- one-shot pinned session (Layer 2, auto-reverted) ---------------------------
1734	
1735	# Combine copilot-here (settings.local.json pin — beats inherited env, see Gotchas)
1736	# with claude-copilot's ephemerality: pin THIS project, run ONE specstory-wrapped
1737	# session, then unpin — even on Ctrl-C / kill. The proxy must already be up (we only
1738	# notify; start it with `copilot-proxy start`). If copilot-here is already ON here,
1739	# the existing pin is left untouched on exit (safe to run inside a pinned project).
1740	# Example:
1741	#   claude-copilot-once                 # pin, run, auto-unpin
1742	#   claude-copilot-once -c              # continue last session
1743	#   claude-copilot-once --no-specstory  # raw claude, no markdown auto-save
1744	claude-copilot-once() {
1745	  case "${1:-}" in
1746	    -h|--help)
1747	      printf '%s\n' "Usage: claude-copilot-once [--no-specstory] [claude args...]"
1748	      printf '%s\n' "  Pin THIS project to the proxy (copilot-here on), run one Claude Code"
1749	      printf '%s\n' "  session, then auto-unpin (copilot-here off) — even on Ctrl-C."
1750	      printf '%s\n' "  Needs the proxy already running:  copilot-proxy start"
1751	      return 0 ;;
1752	  esac
1753	
1754	  # 1. Proxy must already be answering — notify only, never auto-start.
1755	  if ! _copilot_alive; then
1756	    printf '%s\n' "claude-copilot-once: proxy not reachable on port $(_copilot_port)." >&2
1757	    printf '%s\n' "  start it first:  copilot-proxy start" >&2
1758	    return 1
1759	  fi
1760	  # copilot-here needs jq — fail early with a clear message.
1761	  if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1762	    printf '%s\n' "claude-copilot-once: jq is required (used by copilot-here)" >&2
1763	    return 1
1764	  fi
1765	
1766	  # 2. Don't clobber an existing pin: only turn OFF what we turn ON.
1767	  local _cco_was_on=0
1768	  if [ -f ".claude/settings.local.json" ] \
1769	     && [ "$(jq -r '.env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL // empty' ".claude/settings.local.json" 2>/dev/null)" != "" ]; then
1770	    _cco_was_on=1
1771	  fi
1772	
1773	  if [ "$_cco_was_on" = "0" ]; then
1774	    copilot-here on || return 1
1775	    # Auto-unpin even on Ctrl-C / kill. Mirror tmux_status_run's INT/TERM/HUP
1776	    # trap + explicit normal-path cleanup; a bare function-scope EXIT trap would
1777	    # fire on the wrong event when bash sources this file.
1778	    trap '_copilot_once_trap' INT TERM HUP
1779	  else
1780	    # Already pinned here. If the pin drifted from current defaults (model bump,
1781	    # proxy moved), offer to refresh it in place; otherwise leave it untouched.
1782	    # Either way it was already ON, so it stays ON on exit (no revert, no trap).
1783	    local _drift; _drift="$(_copilot_here_drift)"
1784	    if [ -n "$_drift" ]; then
1785	      printf '%s\n' "claude-copilot-once: this project's copilot-here pin looks stale:" >&2
1786	      printf '%s\n' "$_drift" >&2
1787	      if _copilot_confirm "  override with current defaults? (keep = default) [y/N]"; then
1788	        copilot-here on || return 1
1789	      else
1790	        printf '%s\n' "claude-copilot-once: kept the existing pin (stays ON on exit)." >&2
1791	      fi
1792	    else
1793	      printf '%s\n' "claude-copilot-once: copilot-here already ON here — leaving the pin in place on exit."
1794	    fi
1795	  fi
1796	
1797	  # 3. One session — specstory-wrapped + arg passthrough (reuses claude-copilot).
1798	  claude-copilot "$@"
1799	  local _rc=$?
1800	
1801	  # 4. Revert only what we enabled.
1802	  if [ "$_cco_was_on" = "0" ]; then
1803	    trap - INT TERM HUP
1804	    copilot-here off
1805	  fi
1806	
1807	  # 5. We never auto-stop the proxy — remind how.
1808	  printf '%s\n' "claude-copilot-once: session ended. Proxy still running on $(_copilot_base)."
1809	  printf '%s\n' "  stop it when done:  copilot-proxy stop"
1810	  return $_rc
1811	}
1812	
1813	# Internal: INT/TERM/HUP handler — unpin, clear trap, re-raise INT so the
1814	# interactive shell sees correct exit semantics (mirrors _tmux_status_run_trap
1815	# in dot_config/shell/60_tmux_status.sh).
1816	_copilot_once_trap() {
1817	  copilot-here off >/dev/null 2>&1
1818	  trap - INT TERM HUP
1819	  printf '\n%s\n' "claude-copilot-once: interrupted — unpinned (copilot-here off). Proxy still up." >&2
1820	  kill -INT $$ 2>/dev/null
1821	}
1822	
1823	# --- pin staleness: detect drift + confirm-to-refresh ---------------------------
1824	
1825	# POSIX y/N prompt. Returns 0 only on an explicit yes; a non-interactive stdin
1826	# (no TTY) returns 1 — the safe default (keep, don't override). We only call this
1827	# right before launching an interactive Claude Code session, so reading stdin is
1828	# fine. NOT `read -q` (zsh-only) — this file is sourced by bash too.
1829	_copilot_confirm() {
1830	  local _ans
1831	  [ -t 0 ] || return 1
1832	  printf '%s ' "${1:-Proceed? [y/N]}" >&2
1833	  IFS= read -r _ans || return 1
1834	  case "$_ans" in
1835	    [yY]|[yY][eE][sS]) return 0 ;;
1836	    *) return 1 ;;
1837	  esac
1838	}
1839	
1840	# Has THIS project's copilot-here pin drifted from what `copilot-here on` would
1841	# write now (default model bumped, proxy port/shim moved, a key added since the
1842	# pin was written)? Prints one "KEY : old -> new" line per drifted key to stdout;
1843	# exit 0 = stale (drift printed), 1 = up-to-date or not pinned. `copilot-here on`
1844	# re-merges exactly these keys, so refreshing a stale pin is just running it again.
1845	#
1846	# Drift is defined as "the set of keys `copilot-here on` would actually CHANGE",
1847	# computed by diffing the live file against _copilot_env_json — not a hand-picked
1848	# subset (that is how three keys silently went unchecked). Note the asymmetry is
1849	# deliberate: keys present in the file but absent from the want-set are NOT drift,
1850	# because `on` merges and never removes them (only `off` does).
1851	_copilot_here_drift() {
1852	  local settings=".claude/settings.local.json"
1853	  [ -f "$settings" ] || return 1
1854	  command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 1
1855	  # ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL is only set while the pin is ON — absent → nothing to do.
1856	  [ -n "$(jq -r '.env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL // empty' "$settings" 2>/dev/null)" ] || return 1
1857	  local want out
1858	  want="$(_copilot_env_json)" || return 1
1859	  out="$(jq -r --argjson want "$want" '
1860	    (.env // {}) as $cur
1861	    | [ $want
1862	        | to_entries[]
1863	        | select($cur[.key] != .value)
1864	        | "  \(.key) : \($cur[.key] // "(unset)") -> \(.value)" ]
1865	    | .[]' "$settings" 2>/dev/null)"
1866	  [ -n "$out" ] || return 1
1867	  printf '%s\n' "$out"
1868	  return 0
1869	}
1870	
1871	# --- model switcher -------------------------------------------------------------
1872	
1873	# The live model catalog is the SSOT for ids, aliases and context limits. Keep
1874	# this separate from _copilot_served_models: doctor wants ids + aliases, while
1875	# role selection wants each raw id's capability metadata.
1876	_copilot_model_catalog() {
1877	  command curl -fsS --max-time 5 "$(_copilot_base)/v1/models" 2>/dev/null
1878	}
1879	
1880	_copilot_catalog_ids() {
1881	  if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1882	    jq -r '.data[]?.id // empty' 2>/dev/null | command sort -u
1883	  else
1884	    command grep -o '"id":"[^"]*"' | command sed 's/"id":"//;s/"//' | command sort -u
1885	  fi
1886	}
1887	
1888	_copilot_strip_context_hint() {
1889	  printf '%s' "${1%\[1m\]}"
1890	}
1891	
1892	# Convert a raw proxy id to the spelling Claude Code should receive. A live
1893	# max_context_window_tokens >= 1M earns [1m]; if the proxy is down, preserve an
1894	# explicitly stored suffix but do not invent one. Raw API clients never use this.
1895	_copilot_model_for_claude() {
1896	  local requested="${1:-}" catalog="${2:-}" raw had_hint=0 context=''
1897	  [ -n "$requested" ] || return 1
1898	  case "$requested" in *"[1m]") had_hint=1 ;; esac
1899	  raw="$(_copilot_strip_context_hint "$requested")"
1900	  if [ "$#" -lt 2 ]; then catalog="$(_copilot_model_catalog 2>/dev/null || true)"; fi
1901	  if [ -n "$catalog" ] && command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1902	    context="$(printf '%s' "$catalog" | jq -r --arg id "$raw" '
1903	      first(.data[]? | select(.id == $id) | .capabilities.limits.max_context_window_tokens) // empty
1904	    ' 2>/dev/null)"
1905	    case "$context" in
1906	      ''|*[!0-9]*) printf '%s' "$raw" ;;
1907	      *) if [ "$context" -ge 1000000 ]; then printf '%s[1m]' "$raw"; else printf '%s' "$raw"; fi ;;
1908	    esac
1909	  elif [ "$had_hint" -eq 1 ]; then
1910	    printf '%s[1m]' "$raw"
1911	  else
1912	    printf '%s' "$raw"
1913	  fi
1914	}
1915	
1916	_copilot_first_served() {
1917	  local models="$1" candidate
1918	  shift
1919	  for candidate in "$@"; do
1920	    if printf '%s\n' "$models" | command grep -qxF "$candidate"; then
1921	      printf '%s' "$candidate"
1922	      return 0
1923	    fi
1924	  done
1925	  return 1
1926	}
1927	
1928	# Pick the best raw served id for the main Claude Code model. Claude stays the
1929	# first choice when entitled. Without Claude, rank OpenAI by capability tier,
1930	# deliberately placing lightweight Luna behind the older flagship/coding tiers.
1931	# Reads newline-separated raw ids on stdin and prints one raw id.
1932	_copilot_pick_best_model() {
1933	  local models preferred c
1934	  models="$(command cat | command sed 's/\[1m\]$//' | command sort -u)"
1935	  [ -n "$models" ] || return 1
1936	
1937	  for preferred in \
1938	    claude-fable-5 \
1939	    claude-opus-5 claude-opus-4-8 claude-opus-4-7 claude-opus-4-6 \
1940	    claude-sonnet-5 claude-sonnet-4-6 claude-sonnet-4-5 \
1941	    claude-opus-4-5 claude-haiku-4-5
1942	  do
1943	    if printf '%s\n' "$models" | command grep -qxF "$preferred"; then
1944	      printf '%s' "$preferred"
1945	      return 0
1946	    fi
1947	  done
1948	  c="$(printf '%s\n' "$models" | command grep -E '^claude-' | command sort | command tail -1)"
1949	  if [ -n "$c" ]; then printf '%s' "$c"; return 0; fi
1950	
1951	  for preferred in \
1952	    gpt-5.6-sol gpt-5.6-terra gpt-5.5 gpt-5.4 gpt-5.3-codex \
1953	    gpt-5.6-luna gpt-5.4-mini gpt-5-mini
1954	  do
1955	    if printf '%s\n' "$models" | command grep -qxF "$preferred"; then
1956	      printf '%s' "$preferred"
1957	      return 0
1958	    fi
1959	  done
1960	
1961	  c="$(printf '%s\n' "$models" | command grep -E '^gpt-' | command grep -viE 'mini|nano|luna' \
1962	        | command sort | command tail -1)"
1963	  if [ -n "$c" ]; then printf '%s' "$c"; return 0; fi
1964	  c="$(printf '%s\n' "$models" | command grep -iE 'codex' | command sort | command tail -1)"
1965	  if [ -n "$c" ]; then printf '%s' "$c"; return 0; fi
1966	  c="$(printf '%s\n' "$models" | command grep -E '^gpt-' | command sort | command tail -1)"
1967	  if [ -n "$c" ]; then printf '%s' "$c"; return 0; fi
1968	
1969	  c="$(printf '%s\n' "$models" | command grep -E '^gemini-' | command grep -viE 'flash' \
1970	        | command sort | command tail -1)"
1971	  if [ -n "$c" ]; then printf '%s' "$c"; return 0; fi
1972	  c="$(printf '%s\n' "$models" | command grep -E '^gemini-' | command sort | command tail -1)"
1973	  if [ -n "$c" ]; then printf '%s' "$c"; return 0; fi
1974	
1975	  printf '%s\n' "$models" | command sort | command tail -1
1976	}
1977	
1978	# Build the full Claude Code role profile for one selected main model. Native
1979	# Claude profiles use the strongest served model in each Claude family. OpenAI

294	    if ([System.IO.Directory]::Exists($packageDir) -or $remainingBin.Count -gt 0) {

301	# One package-install attempt in -Dir, bounded by -BudgetSeconds. npm is preferred
302	# because it supports Azure Artifacts' credential-provider token in ~/.npmrc;
303	# Bun does not. -NoProxy strips the proxy env for the child. Returns $true only
304	# when matching metadata and a runnable launch path exist afterwards.
305	#
306	# Success is judged from the FILESYSTEM, not $p.ExitCode: a Start-Process -PassThru
307	# object reports ExitCode 0 even for a child that exited non-zero (verified — the
308	# .Handle-caching workaround does not help either), so trusting it would let a
309	# failed install write the .installed-spec stamp and silently pin a broken prefix.
310	#
311	# The kill on expiry is the load-bearing part: a stalled `bun add` left running
312	# keeps bun's global install-cache lock, and THAT is what made every subsequent
313	# start hang too. Never let one escape.
314	function script:Invoke-CopilotPkgInstallTry {
315	    param([string] $Dir, [switch] $NoProxy, [int] $BudgetSeconds)
316	
317	    if (-not (Clear-CopilotPkgInstallTarget)) { return $false }
318	    $proxyVars = 'ALL_PROXY', 'all_proxy', 'HTTP_PROXY', 'http_proxy', 'HTTPS_PROXY', 'https_proxy'
319	    $npm = Get-Command npm.cmd -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
320	    $installer = if ($npm) {
321	        @{ File = $npm.Source; Args = @('install', '--no-save', '--no-audit', '--no-fund', (Get-CopilotPkg)) }
322	    } else {
323	        Write-Warning 'copilot-proxy: npm.cmd not found; falling back to Bun (authenticated Azure Artifacts feeds require npm).'
324	        @{ File = 'bun'; Args = @('add', (Get-CopilotPkg), '--no-summary') }
325	    }
326	    $saved = @{}
327	    if ($NoProxy) {
328	        foreach ($v in $proxyVars) { $saved[$v] = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($v); Remove-Item "env:$v" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
329	    }
330	    try {
331	        $p = Start-Process -FilePath $installer.File -ArgumentList $installer.Args `
332	            -WorkingDirectory $Dir -PassThru -NoNewWindow -ErrorAction Stop
333	        if ($p.WaitForExit($BudgetSeconds * 1000)) { return (Test-CopilotPkgInstalled) }
334	        Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
335	        # The subshell's child is the one actually holding the install lock.
336	        $name = [regex]::Escape((Get-CopilotPkgName))
337	        Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
338	            Where-Object { $_.Name -in 'bun.exe', 'node.exe' -and $_.CommandLine -match '\b(add|install)\b' -and $_.CommandLine -match $name } |
339	            ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
340	        return $false
341	    } catch {
342	        Write-Error "copilot-proxy: could not launch package installer ($_)"; return $false
343	    } finally {
344	        if ($NoProxy) {
345	            foreach ($v in $proxyVars) {
346	                if ($null -eq $saved[$v]) { Remove-Item "env:$v" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
347	                else { Set-Item "env:$v" $saved[$v] }
348	            }
349	        }
350	    }
351	}

1524	            $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "$(Get-CopilotBase)/v1/messages?beta=true" -Method Post `

1529	            } else {
